Read our family interpretations and origin alternatives

ET describes an embodied off-world population. Flesh ED describes embodiment in another phase; energy ED describes a different earlier or operating condition. Bodily classification and the beginning of the family history are separate questions: an ET family can exist inside either a long-running simulation or an initialized world with an apparent earlier past.

Brahma10|Fantian9.5|Bonten9.5|Prajapati9|Ka8.5|Hiranyagarbha8.5 — our interpretation

Current proposed reading — fit 7/10: An ED life-maker who produces and restores embodied life.

A life-making office fits because the named progenitor branches and the restorative intervention concern the same capability: giving embodied life a usable form. That matches the deliberate production and regeneration already accepted for other powerful beings, while allowing an earlier ED condition.

Brahma can therefore be compared as a personal maker, an embodied adept holding a creative office, or the personification of that creative function. Marichi, Kardama and Daksha supply the proposed family connections; the choice among the origin interpretations remains open.

These are open possibilities. The scores compare fit with our existing account; some possibilities can coexist.

  1. ED life-maker acting through a personal office — 7/10

    Named progenitor branches and restoration of damaged life connect one creative capability to the embodied-family programme already used elsewhere in the model.

    Brahma could help produce particular lines while Achamoth supplies the wider creative order.

  2. Earlier embodied adept raised into a creative role — 6.5/10

    The retained earlier adept-and-office reading joins a personal career to the higher function instead of treating every creator title as an entire being.

    His later making of progenitors could follow a change of condition or assignment.

  3. Personal founder presented through philosophical generation — 6/10

    Mind and shadow production organize the same named families that later connect to Kashyapa/Anu. A personal maker can be represented through a theory of differentiated faculties.

    The personal family and the philosophical descriptions can belong to different aspects of one received account.

  4. Creator-character assembled to explain several ancestries — 6.5/10

    Marichi, Kardama and Daksha give a writer one common origin for otherwise distinct family branches. That is a specific reason to consider an organizing creative character.

    The genealogy could explain the branches without every introductory generation describing an earlier embodied event.

  5. Initialized creator with an assigned production role — 7/10

    A complete starting state can supply a competent life-maker, progenitors and an apparent prior order together, fitting the initialized-founder possibility already under discussion.

    The question becomes when the creative office began operating and what purpose that starting arrangement served.

Daksha [Capable/Skilled]; Prajapati [progenitor title] — our interpretation

Current proposed reading — fit 7/10: A progenitor whose daughters connect several powerful maternal houses.

A personal progenitor fits because the proposed Kashyapa/Anu equation joins his different daughters to one already retained imperial father. That makes the Danu, Naga and carrier branches intelligible as related maternal houses, consistent with the empire's reproductive alliances.

The earlier Brahma production and the later Prachetas/Marisha birth can describe different origin or embodiment presentations. Prajapati supplies a shared function; the proposed personal identity stays Daksha. Biological descent and supplied ancestry remain alternative explanations.

These are open possibilities. The scores compare fit with our existing account; some possibilities can coexist.

  1. Earlier embodied progenitor of allied maternal houses — 7/10

    The retained Kashyapa/Anu equation connects Danu, Kadru and Vinata to one imperial father. Daksha then gives those different maternal branches a coherent earlier family connection.

    He could be an ET or flesh-ED ancestor whose descendants enter the same dynastic compact.

  2. Produced founder who later develops a bodily line — 6.5/10

    The earlier Brahma relationship and later Prachetas/Marisha presentation allow production and later embodiment to be compared as different stages within the approved made-body framework.

    His production relationship need not be the same kind of event as his descendants' later births.

  3. Ancestral office expressed through a personal progenitor — 6/10

    Prajapati supplies a generative function while Daksha connects several houses. That combination fits an office-holder or a literary ancestor used to organize the maternal compact.

    The shared title describes the task; the proposed individual identity remains Daksha.

  4. Initialized ancestor of the maternal compact — 7/10

    A starting arrangement could include the three maternal branches, their relations to Kashyapa/Anu and the competence expected of their elder progenitor.

    The family relations would still matter politically after initialization, while their earlier elapsed history remains open.

This preserves the accepted older Apsu/Tiamat generation before Anu. Actual ancestry, deliberately formed founders and an initialized earlier history can each contain that relationship; the proposed role does not decide when the lineage began.

The Origin: Existence Intellecting Itself; one with Am-ing, "I am"
Proposed reading — logical starting point: existence exists. The ultimate-Origin reading fits because 'existence exists' is the logical starting point shared by these philosophical names; the subsequent distinctions explain forms and awareness without requiring an ancestral ruler. Supporting account. WHAT THE ORIGIN IS. The Origin is Existence itself: Becoming/Being, not a person, ruler, house or bodily being. The statement 'Existence exists' is the necessary starting point. Its philosophical names here are Brahman, Ein Sof, El Olam, Allah and the Dao; each name is used only where the named tradition points beyond every limited administrator. EXISTENCE, INFORMATION, ENERGY AND AWARENESS. Anything that exists is information because it is distinguishable. Existing information is energetic difference or activity. Energy implies animation or spirit, and complete existence implies complete awareness as a transient property of that activity. Everything is information and energy; flesh and blood is cooler, lower-frequency energy, not a second substance. Every being remains connected through the same field even when it experiences only a local three-dimensional body. INTELLECTION. Existence intellects every implication of its own existence instantly and nonstantly: no clock time, deliberating person or prior plan is required. The order is logical dependence: Am-ing; What Am-ing, which contains every possible Form; Value, which makes experience valenced; and Epinoia, reflective awareness able to notice and evaluate its own noticing. Theoretical possibility precedes actual examples because no maker can instantiate a paradigm that has not first been intellected. NO ORIGINAL TELEOLOGY. Value asks what matters within experience; Value does not prove that the process began for a purpose. The Intellection is accidental at The Origin. Limited makers later build purposeful systems inside it. The Origin does not speak in linear time, demand offerings, bargain, learn or change. Any speaking being is a lesser intelligence using one of The Origin's names or functions. THE REVELATION. The Origin is apprehended through logic, love, nature and the structured universe rather than a bodily speaker. Its order is already present in physics and in the possible Forms. What comes from The Origin is grace, not payment. WHY THIS MATTERS. Every alleged ruler, creator and 'god' below this box is a limited phase, intelligence, office or physical person. None is Existence itself. More powerful phases carry more current and produce greater effects, but possess fewer meaningful alternatives; later humans possess less direct field power and a wider range of reflective choice.
Connected accounts in our lore:
  • → What Am-ing: every possible Form, each distinct; Chokhmah as gnosis and Binah as logos plus episteme (Am-ing to What Am-ing: one intellection, two aspects ('One produced Two', Dao De Jing 42))
  • → Epinoia / Adam Kadmon / Atman: reflective awareness and the human paradigm, produced by Value (Gnostic Barbelo personifies the self-image; Epinoia follows Value)
  • ← Muhammad (peace be upon him) (Muhammad's ascent reaches the highest disclosed boundary without equating a speaking being there with The Origin (7/10))

What Am-ing: every possible Form, each distinct; Chokhmah as gnosis and Binah as logos plus episteme
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The Forms reading fits because any distinguishable actuality implies a possible form. Chokhmah and Binah then distinguish direct apprehension from understanding through logos and episteme. Supporting account. WHAT AM-ING. This is Existence intellecting what Existence can be. Every possible paradigm of energetic existence must be present here in theory before any intelligence can produce an example. The Forms are not a warehouse, landscape or population; they are the fully differentiated informational possibilities implied by Existence. CHOKHMAH AND BINAH. Chokhmah is gnosis: direct apprehension of a possibility. Binah is logos plus episteme: the possibility understood, distinguished, related and expressible as knowledge. Their difference is functional, not biological sex and not a family of bodily people. WHY TWO FUNCTIONS APPEAR. A possibility must first be available to awareness and then be intelligibly differentiated from other possibilities. The Dao's 'One produced Two', Plato's Forms, Descartes' question 'what am I?', Kabbalah's Chokhmah and Binah and the Gnostic paired aeons preserve aspects of this same logical division. The names are received philosophical labels; the account does not turn the labels into persons. FIRST THEORETICAL, THEN ACTUAL. Achamoth and every later maker combine, select and instantiate Forms already available here. They do not create possibility from nothing. This is why the human paradigm, dimensions, physical laws, bodily structures and every other realizable configuration precede their particular examples.

Value: "Why? What is of value?"; experience becomes valenced
Proposed reading — fit 7.5/10. The Value phase fits because meaningful preference requires experience to differ as better or worse. That distinction supplies the conditions for care, correction and consequential choice. Supporting account. VALUE. Once Forms are distinguishable, experience can differ as better, worse, wanted, unwanted, joyful, painful, loving, destructive or indifferent. This is valence. The question is 'What is of value?', not 'Who am I?' and not 'What purpose was assigned in advance?' WHY VALUE IS REQUIRED. Without difference in value, awareness contains information but no reason to prefer, protect, reject, repair, love or choose. Value creates the logical possibility of care. Energy therefore does not merely move; energetic awareness can emote, evaluate and become conscious of consequence. NO PERSONIFICATION. The Gnostic upper Sophia, the Kabbalistic Mother, the World-Soul and other feminine figures can label receptive, valuing or formative functions. They do not establish a woman living above physical reality. Biological sex and gendered pairs appear only in later instantiated Forms. THE NEXT IMPLICATION. Value produces Epinoia as a transient property: awareness that can notice its own evaluation, examine an impulse and consider another possibility. The implication occurs instantly and nonstantly at the level of Forms. Countless increasingly limited phases can follow before a physical universe appears. ETHICAL RESULT. No external purpose is needed to choose the good. Seeking the gooderestly is seeking the gooderestly, and that is gooderest: life, joy, love, understanding and care are selected because no better object of choice exists.

Epinoia / Adam Kadmon / Atman: reflective awareness and the human paradigm, produced by Value
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The reflective-capacity reading fits because noticing an impulse and considering an alternative explains the same independent choice attributed to Epinoia, Atman and the human paradigm. Supporting account. EPINOIA. Epinoia is reflective awareness: noticing the noticing, recognizing an impulse as an impulse, imagining another possibility and choosing between them. It is the widest choice mechanism presently identified in this account. It is not a woman sent into Adam and not a separate deity. FROM VALUE. Epinoia is the unavoidable transient property of valenced awareness. When awareness can register better and worse, awareness can become aware that it is making that evaluation. The sequence is Value to Epinoia; the earlier direct Origin-to-'Barbelo' story is retained only as the Gnostic writer's personification. ADAM KADMON AND ATMAN. Adam Kadmon is the paradigmatic human Form, not one man. Atman names the interior identity continuous with the universal field. In this account both name aspects of Epinoia: the human-shaped possibility through which the field can become locally self-aware and the inward awareness by which a person can recognize that connection. THE HUMAN FORM. Head, mirrored limbs, paired eyes and bilateral structure express iterative binary differentiation, while the upright head points symbolically back through prior phases toward The Origin. Later embodied peoples repeat this prefabricated Form. The repetition is not accidental evolution of unrelated shapes. POWER AND CHOICE. Earlier phases carry more energy and produce greater effects but have fewer alternatives because their function follows directly from logical implication. Terran humans presently carry much less feedback and field power but a wider choice range. That combination makes a human refusal, moral discovery or freely chosen good unusually consequential. GNOSTIC SOURCE AND REAL MEANING. The Apocryphon of John calls luminous Epinoia Life, hidden in Adam to restore him and teach the way upward. The realistic reading is the reflective capacity that rulers cannot fully predict or own. The Gnostic names 'Barbelo' and Pigeradamas label the first self-image and heavenly human paradigm; they do not add separate bodily characters. SURVIVAL. Energy and information do not transfer into another substance at death. A continuing person would require enough organized current, feedback and conscious attribution for identity to persist when the cooler biological receiver fails. Epinoia increases the proposed possibility of personal continuity; the survival of every personality remains open.

Achamoth / I-La: local creative intelligence of the Local Loop
Proposed reading — fit 8.5/10. The local-creator identity fits the combination of formation, developmental care and delegation. Her concern for independent discovery supplies a consistent motive across the otherwise different creative and corrective roles. Supporting account. WHO SHE IS. Achamoth, the lower Sophia, whose full name list is I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7, is the local creative and developmental intelligence that initiated this physical universe, the Local Loop. She is ED energy, not The Origin and not the theoretical Sophia or Value phase. She is already countless phases into Becoming. The combined identity and function are rated 8.5/10; each reported statement retains its own source and confidence. I-La is the name reported through the channeller Anne Tucker, the modern comparison. In Tucker's account I-La's earlier universes did not work out because she controlled their development and they only repeated her own pattern; she changed her method to create, relinquish control and allow souls creative freedom (Tucker, 13:38-14:44). That is I-La developing, not Existence learning. HOW SHE FORMED THIS UNIVERSE. Achamoth selected and combined Forms already present in What Am-ing, established dimensional conditions, permitted energy to cool into recognizable physical law and matter, and embedded operating systems and symbolic interfaces. She did not make information, energy, consciousness or possibility from nothing. Zero-dimensional distinction, one-dimensional mirroring and relation, three-dimensional physical organization and four-dimensional movement through potential are Forms she instantiates rather than invents. The first-dimensional transition remains unresolved. WHY SHE DID IT. The combined lore reads her undertaking as a repair: make beings capable of continuing Intellection, protect their development from what her less reflective family would do to them, and leave enough of the universal operating system accessible that those beings could discover rather than merely obey. She reserved the fullest Earth expression of Adam Kadmon and Epinoia for a final Terran attempt at tikkun. This local purpose does not create an original teleology for Existence. POWER AND LIMITATION. Achamoth carries a much greater current than embodied humans and can establish conditions with enormous effects. The same closeness to her function gives her fewer alternatives and less corrective feedback. Terrans have less field power but a wider reflective choice range. She can therefore be powerful, compassionate and foreseeing while creating a system whose sub-processes cause suffering she did not individually intend. HER RELATION TO OTHER BEINGS. Tiamat or another physical ruler can rebel against an arrangement Achamoth supplied, imitate or mock her Forms and misuse her operating systems; no embodied ruler competes with her as author of this universe. Achamoth permits real freedom, including exploitation. Her contact with advanced civilizations may be direct, mediated through aeonic or functionary intelligences, or learned through the structure of reality itself. In the Ugaritic tablets Athirat (Asherah) acts inside El's court: that Athirat is read as a descended avatar of Achamoth capable of local action (9/10) or an authorized office speaking for her current (9/10), not her whole being reduced to a court biography (2/10). EARTH AND HUMANITY. Natural evolution in the Local Loop is real and not accidental. Achamoth's seeding can operate through physical law, life, panspermia, cosmic gardeners and later biological intervention. Earth's yellow-dwarf energies, biodiversity and dimensional position provide conditions for an unusually wide Epinoia range. Advanced groups must not supply the final answer because freely discovering how and why to choose the good is the new result the process requires.

ARCHON AND FEEDING. El was an archon who fed on human energy. Metatron: Enoch raised into the scribe, throne and read/write office
Proposed reading — fit 8.5/10. The Enoch–Metatron identity fits the continuous recording, disclosure and judgment work before and after transformation. The 365,000 eyes, disclosure of secrets above and below, throne and seated recording of deeds describe read access, write access and delegated administrative authority inside the Local Loop. Metatron keeps the higher court's records, coordinates princes and functionaries, teaches in the academy reached during sleep and carries the Name as an authorized credential. HOW HE GOT THERE. Enoch's books, visions, instruction and conduct prepared him; 3 Enoch describes help and transformation. Routine conduct follows office; major departures remain possible and consequential.

YHWH-Sabaoth: archon and owner of Jacob's allotted population
Proposed reading — fit 7/10. The territorial-archon reading fits the allotment, covenant, population restrictions and delegated agents. YHWH10/Yahu10/Yah10/Iao9.5/Ieuo8/Sabaoth7, called YHWH-Sabaoth, is an archon, a ruler inside the local system that Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7) made: an ED (extradimensional) energy being who rules from the ED levels (7.5/10), and the prince to whom the descendants of Jacob were allotted as his owned portion. ED energy, with no recorded birth, death, city or children (7.5/10). His bodily appearances, such as eating with Abraham at Mamre (Genesis 18) and the elders of Israel eating and drinking before him (Exodus 24:9-11), are read as borrowed or taken shapes; the alternative reading, ED flesh and blood, stands at 6/10. In the Gnostic account, Sabaoth is the first fallen's son, who turned against his father (6/10). Seat: the seventh level of the local administration (the "seventh heaven"), at the head of the administration around the seat of rule, with every functionary there coming from him (6/10). At Babel, Genesis credits him with stopping a human workforce from organising beyond his control (Genesis 11; 7/10); the governing event is the destruction of the project by Nimrod's generals through infighting (Sefer Raziel), with the national ED princes, who work inside YHWH-Sabaoth's system, entering or intensifying the generals' rival thoughts (8/10). Spiritus mundi: the Tree of Life as living structure (the sefirot)
Proposed reading — fit 7/10. The living-structure reading fits because the sefirot operate as interdependent creative functions. Their organization explains a common energetic order without assigning every function an independent political personality. Supporting account. WHAT IT IS. Spiritus mundi is not a person: it is the Tree of Life itself, the ten sefirot, read as a living structure, the ED (extradimensional) energy organization through which creative activity is carried out in this universe. It is alive in the sense that energy animates it, but it is a structure, not a being with its own will (7/10). Marsilio Ficino divided the universe into three, in his terms: the world-soul (anima mundi); the world-spirit (spiritus mundi), the living medium through which the soul moves the body; and the world-body (De vita 3.3). The author asked whether the Tree of Life is such a semi-living function (September 26, 2026), and the lore has this exact layer. Spirit, in this account, means animation: energy, usually with heat, descending to lower frequency and lower dimension into self-organizing matter (The author, October 12, 2026). Spiritus mundi is that animating medium with a fixed set of functions. In Kabbalah the sefirot are lights in vessels (Isaac Luria) and the limbs of Adam Kadmon, the intelligible human pattern. Adam Kadmon is the account's box for Epinoia, the noticing of the noticing of the noticing (The author, October 8, 2026). The Forms make definite expression intelligible; the Tree sets out the functions within creative activity; the Book of Raziel supplies the responsibilities that particular intelligences carry out. HOW IT IS BUILT. Keter, the crown, is "I am". Chokhmah and Binah are the pair: Chokhmah is gnosis, and Binah, the upper mother, is logos plus episteme. Tiferet, with the six sefirot around it, is the Sun: the station of the counterpart of Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7). The earlier holder of that station is The "Holy" One10/El7; Metatron10/Yahoel8/Mitatrun8, a separate being, succeeded to part of El's place. The author has also asked whether Metatron belongs at Keter (October 10, 2026); that placement is not settled. Malkhut, the tenth, is Achamoth, the being who made this physical universe. The Tree is a ring, not a line: Malkhut and Keter connect through the dark of Ayn Sof, the boundless (The author, October 10, 2026). The archangels carry out its functions, with Michael10/Mikail10 on Chesed (loving-kindness), Gabriel10/Jibril10/Ruh al-Qudus7, the power of power (physics), on Gevurah (limit and judgment), and Uriel10/Sariel7.5/Suriel7 on Tiferet (Zohar); their camps around Achamoth are set out in the box of the four living creatures. The other side has its mirror structure, the shells. The Book of Raziel's dark-winged angels are not the other side: they are, verbatim, the left side of severity (The author, October 8, 2026). WHY IT MATTERS. The account's spine is this Tree: its stations name where the account's controllers stand, and the archangels carry out its functions. The Tree scores 7/10 for continuity between modes of experiencing (dreaming and waking): it is a medium of experience, not a personal sender of dreams. Its comparison with unmeasured darkness scores 9/10 for hiddenness and adds no new being. SOURCES. Marsilio Ficino, De vita 3.3; Isaac Luria; the Zohar; Pirkei de-Rabbi Eliezer 4; the Book of Raziel; Name Equations Register, sections 3.21, 3.26, 17, 19 and 21.

Yaldabaoth / Samael / Satan: the first fallen and his seven-ruler administration
Proposed reading — fit 8.5/10. The chief-archon reading fits the combination of supremacy claims, subordinate rulers and dependence on powers beyond the claimant. Fate and soul retention give the administration a consistent practical purpose. Supporting account. WHO HE IS. Yaldabaoth10/Ialdabaoth10/Saklas8.5/Samael8.5/Ariael7.5/Nebro7/Satan8.5 is the first fallen and the chief archon (ruler) of this local system: an ED (extradimensional) energy being, the spawn of Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7; "spawn" is the author's word), who claimed to be the source of everything under him, made Fate, and was cast down into Earth's zone (8/10). The complete public KOB name cluster is recorded in the Name Equations Register, section 3.19. NATIVE STATE. He is an ED energy archon in native state with no body of his own: not an ET body and not a Watcher who permanently descended into Terran flesh. He takes form by entering a person, riding a creature, putting on a borrowed shape, or once by birth. Possession, projected appearance and temporary embodiment do not create a second species or change his native state. The author: "he always does - that's just his energy" (October 5, 2026). ORIGIN AND OFFICE. Achamoth produced him and hid him away "so that none of the immortals would see him" (Apocryphon of John): in real life, a being produced without authorization and kept out of the sight of the other upper intelligences (6/10). The resentment of a child cast away at birth is rated 7/10. Office: accuser and prosecutor of humans (Job 1-2; Zechariah 3:1). His seven are the rulers he set over the levels of the local system; they stay ED energy and rule Earth's peoples from the ED levels. WHAT HE DOES AND WHY. He runs the local system as a closed loop of Fate, forgetting and return: his rulers give souls a counterfeit spirit and send them back into bodies so that they do not leave (Apocryphon of John; 7/10). His rulers worked only on the energetic soul-body; the flesh comes from the ET history of Achamoth's human Form, the Seeders, Tiamat and the House of Anu Star Empire. In the author's terms he is the controller of the mining system: he needs what souls produce and works against their release. The harvest is licensed from the head of the local chain: in Jubilees his office keeps a tenth of the Giants' spirits under its command (Jubilees 10:8), so the collections those spirits make at Passover and at Samhain (the Irish autumn festival of October 31) are a harvest on purpose (6.5/10). His motives: rank envy of humans, an officer refusing to serve a flesh body because his kind is made of fire, meaning ED energy (Qur'an 7:12; 8/10); proving humans unworthy, as in the test of Job (Job 1-2; 8/10); playing the parents' part, copying the aeons without knowing them (8/10); taking back the light he took from his mother, Achamoth, which went into humans when the human body was made to live, so that his rulers keep humans in bodies to hold it (8/10); and ignorance of what is beyond him, shown when he said "I am God and there is no other" (7/10). The author: "to speak is To disprove Itself" (October 6, 2026). Why, in one sentence: the first fallen's administration (ED energy) and Achamoth (ED energy), who reserved the full Epinoia human pattern, Adam Kadmon, for Earth (The author, October 13, 2026), are at war over the light carried in humans: whether humans stay in the loop as a mined resource or leave it. SHORT HISTORY. He was cast down into Earth's zone in every telling that says where (Revelation 12:9; Luke 10:18; Ezekiel 28:17; Isaiah 14:12-15; Qur'an 7:13): an officer of the cherub kind removed from his office and confined to Earth's zone (8/10). The Baal Cycle (KTU 1.6 I 53-65; 7.5/10) combines a temporary appointment to Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7's seat with failure to retain that office and a subsequent claim to rule. This succession pattern supplies the proposed identity connection. In the Buryat telling (the Geser epic) he led the losing side of a war among the sky beings and was thrown down to Earth; the harmful beings here descend from his side (6/10). A person's refusal stops him: his hold comes through a charge the person accepts, so he needs consent (7/10). The author: he is the party to the wager over whether the whole undertaking is worth doing, the nihilism that would ruin apotheosis, and "the answer is just seek the good, seek joy and life and love, nothing better, nothing else to do, nothing else required" (October 13, 2026). The four: living creatures = four archangels = four Royal Stars
Proposed reading — fit 7.5/10. The fourfold-office comparison fits the repeated alignment of presence, protection and differentiated powers. Named archangels, living creatures and Royal Stars are compared through those functions. Supporting account. WHO THEY ARE. The four are the four princes of the presence, Michael10/Mikail10, Gabriel10/Jibril10/Ruh al-Qudus7, Raphael10/Azarias8 and Uriel10/Sariel7.5/Suriel7: ED (extradimensional) energy beings of the cherub kind who carry the seat of rule of this universe's administration and guard its gates (8/10). They are not under the administration of Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7) but stand at the level of Achamoth and the first fallen (7/10), possibly above or within the upper council of the twenty-four (The author, October 10, 2026, put as a question), and they appear as the four living creatures of Ezekiel and Revelation and as the four Royal Stars of Persia (7.5/10). KIND AND PLACE. Ezekiel says the four living creatures, with the faces of lion, ox, man and eagle, are cherubim (Ezekiel 1; 10:20; Revelation 4). The kind is ED energy by nature. 1 Enoch 9 names the four princes of the presence; 1 Enoch 40:9 gives Phanuel in Uriel's place. On the Tree of Life (the ten sefirot, the functional structure of creative activity) they hold Chesed, Gevurah and Tiferet, not Malkhut, which is Achamoth's station: Michael on Chesed (loving-kindness), Gabriel on Gevurah (limit and judgment), Uriel on Tiferet (Zohar). They form four camps around the Shekhinah, Achamoth's name in Kabbalah: Michael on the right, Gabriel on the left, Uriel in front, Raphael behind (Pirkei de-Rabbi Eliezer 4). Stars: Regulus (lion; Chris Bledsoe's deadline star), Aldebaran (bull, beside the Pleiades), Fomalhaut (man) and Antares (eagle or scorpion). EACH OF THE FOUR. Michael: all loving-kindness, never war or anger (The author, September 14, 2026); he protects humanity and contains chaos. Gabriel: the power of power, which is physics (El means power); stern, on the severe side; he enforces the boundary of Eden and works for YHWH10/Yahu10/Yah10/Iao9.5/Ieuo8/Sabaoth7, an archon (The author, October 7, 2026). Uriel: he governs truthful cycles, time, portals and eligibility (the dimensional-cycle connection, 9/10). Apollo10/Apulu9.5 is a separate being, a sorcerer using Uriel's functions, not Uriel under another name (The author, October 14, 2026). Raphael: Tobit has him walk as the young man Azarias guiding Tobias (Tobit 5; 12:15): in real life, an ED officer in a taken human shape escorting a traveller. SHORT HISTORY. Some of the kind fell: the guardian cherub of Ezekiel 28 and the one cast down in Isaiah 14, both tellings of the first fallen's fall (8/10). Some appear in three-dimensional bodies: the fiery serpents of the desert (Numbers 21:6) and the "flying fiery serpent" of the Negev in present-day southern Israel (Isaiah 30:6); saraph is the same word as seraph (7.5/10). Copies were made on purpose: the gold cherubim on the Ark (Exodus 25:18-22), Solomon's olive-wood cherubim in the Jerusalem temple (1 Kings 6:23-28), the winged bulls of the Assyrian gates in present-day northern Iraq, and the composite makings of Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5 (8/10). The four around the seat of rule stay ED; the three-dimensional ones are either fallen ones in bodies or made copies. Eden is a nonlocal developmental environment or a controlled environment on Earth, not a garden scene. The older texts put it at the seat of the administration, from which the fallen cherub and then humankind (Adam means humankind, not one man) were sent down to Earth (Ezekiel 28:13-16; Qur'an 2:36; 7.5/10). SIDE. The author rules that they are not with humanity in any real way: "these guys kill us every time they are asked"; "if they are with us then it is only in the sense our current fears and sufferings do not matter", and souls return to the source, Adam Kadmon (October 6, 2026). The four stand above the conflict: they hold the administration's boundaries and are not one of the houses at war over the human resource. Why: four directional responsibilities distribute supervision around an ordered domain. SOURCES. Assigned responsibility explains their coordinated operation. Supporting account. WHO THEY ARE. The first fallen's seven kings are the seven rulers he set over the layered levels of this local system (the "heavens"): ED (extradimensional) energy officers who rule Earth's peoples from the ED levels. In real life they are the rulers' administration of this region by levels (7/10 for the office). The Apocryphon of John (II 11-12, 15) gives each a face and a paired power: Athoth (sheep; Goodness), Eloaiou (donkey; Forethought), Astaphaios (hyena; "Divinity"), Yao (seven-headed serpent; Lordship), Sabaoth (dragon; Kingdom), Adonin (ape; Envy) and Sabbede (fire; Understanding). The faces are what seers reported (5/10). Each made one part of the energetic soul-body, from bone to hair: the Apocryphon's psychic body, not the flesh, which comes from the ET history of Achamoth's human Form, the Seeders, Tiamat and the House of Anu Star Empire. On the Origin of the World and Irenaeus (Against Heresies 1.30) put the first fallen himself at the head of a similar list. The Mandaean seven planets and the Hermetic seven governors are the same office. Yao is Iao, the own name of YHWH10/Yahu10/Yah10/Iao9.5/Ieuo8/Sabaoth7, and Eloaiou and Adonin are his titles Elohim and Adonai: YHWH stands among the seven by name (8/10), and Sabaoth is the ruler who later turned (6/10). WHAT IT MEANS. The author keeps the layered levels ("heavens") as real (October 8, 2026), and what each ruler keeps for souls after death is a "checkpoint" or dimensional portal (The author, October 7, 2026). Every archon rises by drawing energy from those under it until it is replaced (The author, October 10, 2026), and the Gnostic labels of good and bad rulers are not reliable (The author, July 13, 2026). Why they rule: the first fallen's administration (ED energy) and Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7; ED energy) are at war over the light carried in humans, and the seven hold the checkpoints that souls pass through. SOURCES. Apocryphon of John II 11-12, 15; On the Origin of the World; Irenaeus, Against Heresies 1.30; Name Equations Register, section 3.26.

The twelve authorities and the 365 angels

The twelve authorities are officers of the first fallen's administration over the cycle of the year and over Earth's regions: seven over the layered levels (the "heavens") and five over the region the text calls "the abyss", with functionaries (malakhim, "angels") under them. The soul-body's makers, the four over the mixtures and the four chief demons
Proposed reading — fit 6.5/10. Psychic engineering fits the ordered assembly of faculties and drives. The distinction from the separate bodily line-making account explains how both histories can concern the same human. Supporting account. WHO THEY ARE. The soul-body's makers are functionaries of the first fallen's administration who built the human soul-body part by part and installed its drives (Apocryphon of John II 15-19). They are ED (extradimensional) energy officers, and they built only the energetic soul-body, the Apocryphon's psychic body. The flesh comes from the ET history: Achamoth's human Form, the Seeders, Tiamat and the House of Anu Star Empire. In real life they were an engineering team that worked on the energetic soul-body part by part, with its drives installed (6.5/10). Adam means humankind in Hebrew, so their work is on the human pattern, not on one first man. THE OFFICES. About seventy named functionaries each made one part, from Raphao (the head) to Miamai (the toenails). Seven oversee the animating functionaries: Michael, Ouriel, Asmenedas, Saphasatoel, Aarmouriam, Richram and Amiorps. The names of Michael10/Mikail10 and Uriel10/Sariel7.5/Suriel7 (Ouriel) show the archangels working inside this system (7/10). Four rule heat, cold, dryness and wetness under Onorthochrasaei, the ruler of matter: the body's material balance as the soul-body registers it. Four chief "demons" rule the installed drives: Ephememphi pleasure, Yoko desire, Nenentophni grief and Blaomen fear, with Esthesis-Ouch-Epi-Ptoe as the parent function behind these affective operations. The names distinguish experiences and bodily responses, not miniature persons inside organs. In the author's combined account one lore's "demon" is another lore's functionary doing its function (September 9, 2026). WHAT IT MEANS. The makers built the soul-body, but it did not live from their work: the power that made it live came from Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7), whose universe this is, and the rulers keep humans in bodies to hold that power (8/10). Because that power made human thinking greater than the rulers' thinking, the text says the rulers then bound the human into a material body with the counterfeit spirit, which it calls "the bond of forgetfulness" (Apocryphon of John II 19-21): in real life, the rulers' counterfeit spirit fastened onto flesh that came from the ET history. Why: a body needs coordinated sensation, appetite and response as well as its visible structure. SOURCES. Apocryphon of John II 15-21.

Fate and the counterfeit spirit
Proposed reading — fit 7/10. A control-system reading fits the repeated connection of timing, forgetting and renewed embodiment. Reflective recognition matters because it changes participation in those recurring conditions. Supporting account. WHAT IT IS. Fate and the counterfeit spirit are the control system of the first fallen's administration, not beings. Fate (Heimarmene) binds everyone by measures, times and seasons; the counterfeit spirit, installed in humans, leads them into forgetting so that each soul is returned into another body. In real life this is control through timed conditions, laws and beliefs and through installed reactions that keep a person repeating; the cup of forgetting is an engineered memory erasure before rebirth (7/10). Fate was made by the first fallen and his powers and is harder and stronger than they are: a system that binds even its makers (Apocryphon of John II 28). The counterfeit spirit is poured into humans and leads them into forgetting; a soul under it is "cast into prison" again, meaning into another body (Apocryphon of John II 26-27). The text calls it "the bond of forgetfulness". Further offices of the same system: the office that On the Origin of the World calls "Death", with seven subordinate officers and forty-nine functionaries (106), and the four powers of the Gospel of Mary, Darkness, Desire, Ignorance and Wrath, which the soul must pass as it leaves. The checkpoints that souls pass after death belong to the seven rulers (see the box of the first fallen's seven kings). WHY IT EXISTS. The first fallen's administration (ED energy) needs what souls produce, so it keeps them cycling through bodies. Why, in one sentence: the first fallen's administration (ED energy) and Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7; ED energy), who with Adam Kadmon alone enabled the Book of Raziel, the escape manual, are at war over whether souls stay in the cycle or leave it (The author, October 3 and 6, 2026). The system holds a person only through a charge the person accepts (see the first fallen's box). The author holds that mortification (shedding every karma, light or dark) likely takes a person out of the soul-school curriculum, and that pterosis (spinal field-coupling with luminous wing-shaped feedback, which the author calls a temporary vacation piggybacking on the rulers' system) likely does not (October 6 and 9, 2026). SOURCES. Apocryphon of John II 26-28; On the Origin of the World 106; Gospel of Mary.

Princes and overseers: the princes of the nations (70 or 72), and the overseers appointed over the heavens and their camps (Sefer Raziel)
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. Separate princes and overseers fit because population ownership and responsibility for operating regions are different duties, each served by its own camps. Supporting account. WHO THEY ARE. The princes and overseers are ED (extradimensional) officers of energy, not flesh. Each prince holds one nation of humans, and each overseer holds one layer of the made world with the camp of functionaries that works it. They rank below Metatron10/Yahoel8/Mitatrun8, who is a separate being from The "Holy" One10/El7, and above the seven generals, the archangels. They work inside the system of YHWH10/Yahu10/Yah10/Iao9.5/Ieuo8/Sabaoth7, called YHWH-Sabaoth (Sabaoth is the Hebrew title "of hosts"). Their side is changed or divided, 8/10. WHAT THEY ARE. Malakh means messenger or functionary. In the Sefer Raziel the serving angels report to the generals, and the generals report to the princes and overseers (The author, October 8, 2026). The princes of the nations number 70 or 72, one over each people: the "sons of God" in the council sense (Deuteronomy 32:8). Daniel 10 names two of their posts: the prince of Persia, whom the Talmud names Dubiel (Yoma 77a), and the prince of Greece, whom Daniel 10 does not name. The overseers are set over the "heavens", meaning the layered levels of the made world, each level a copy of the one above and run by its own officers (Basilides; the author: "keep the layers, but not the 365"). 3 Enoch 10 and 14 place the national princes and the functional rulers under Metatron (9/10 textual fit). The eight great princes of 3 Enoch 10 are a separate group. The princes "rule" over or for a phase of intellection, which makes them very like aeons (The author, October 7, 2026). Where they come from: the Ugaritic tablets make the beings over the nations "the seventy sons" of Athirat (Asherah), and that is one of the reasons Asherah stands in I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7 at 7/10. SHORT HISTORY. The partition: Elyon10/El Elyon10/Hypsistos9 divided humanity into nations under the princes, and Jacob's people, in present-day Israel and Palestine, fell to YHWH-Sabaoth as his portion (Deuteronomy 32:8-9). Basilides says the officers of the lowest layer divided the nations, their chief "thought to be the God of the Jews" (Irenaeus 1.24). In real life this is the partition of humanity among the princes of the nations (9/10 for the pattern). The contest: the princes fight through their nations (Deuteronomy 32:8-9; Daniel 10:13, 20), and the rulers bind humans by fate and law (Apocryphon of John). In real life it is a contest run through human nations and beliefs (7.5/10). The author places the princes' fighting through the nations, and the ED archons' usurping of worship, across about 290,000 years (October 15, 2026). Dubiel, the prince of Persia, held back an answer sent to Daniel for 21 days (Daniel 10): in real life, a rival ED officer delaying a transmission. At Babel the national princes entered or intensified the rival thoughts of Nimrod's generals, whose infighting destroyed the project (Sefer Raziel; 8/10). Why: the princes of the nations (ED officers) are at war with one another over whose nation, whose belief and whose harvest of human soul energy (loosh, the energy taken from worship and offerings) prevails. The author (September 11, 2026): angel 1 is nation 1, and its "dialogue" with angel 2 means conflict and fighting, the same account that Anne Tucker, a modern angel channeller, gives of beings with increasingly specialised functions. The Sefer Raziel says the princes and hosts "cause" the fights and rebellions below, as a testing chamber to see what wins (The author, August 20, 2026). The author proposes (October 7, 2026) that princes in the middle ranks, far from The Origin, set humans fighting to settle an ideological conflict they could not resolve themselves. THE CONTRACT. The princes "work within YHWH's system", which is "YHWH's contract with the higher I-La to iterate intellection" (The author, October 8, 2026). Every archon that runs a harvest system holds the same contract and must be allowed to do what it does. The one widely followed path that does not loosh is that of the Buddha, Buddha10/Shakyamuni10/Siddhartha Gautama10/Shijiamouni9.5/Shaka9.5/Shakya Thubpa9.5 (7.5/10). JUDGMENT AND HOLDING. Psalm 82 has the council judge some of them for ruling unjustly. The four beings held and released in Revelation 9:14 are compared with ruler-class officers reserved for an appointed intervention (6/10). SOURCES. Irenaeus, Against Heresies 1.24 (Basilides); the Apocryphon of John; the Ugaritic tablets (Name Equations Register, section 17).

Gabriel: Power of Power, the physical-power and revelation function
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The physical-force and disclosure functions fit one officer because the interventions combine information with decisive effects. The serving camp supplies the corresponding operational hierarchy. Supporting account. WHO HE IS. Gabriel is an ED (extradimensional) officer of energy, one of the seven generals who each lead a camp of functionaries, working within the system of YHWH10/Yahu10/Yah10/Iao9.5/Ieuo8/Sabaoth7, called YHWH-Sabaoth. His post was made with this creation and was never filled by a raised human. His literal functional title is Power of Power: physical power, or physics, at his level of the made world. He acts on his own judgment often enough to be treated apart from the other six generals. His side is YHWH-Sabaoth's administration, 8/10: The author, "gabriel works for YHWH who is an archon" (October 7, 2026). NAMES AND KIND. Names: Gabriel10/Jibril10/Ruh al-Qudus7. Kind: ED energy, in the malakh (functionary) order of the Sefer Raziel, which works within YHWH-Sabaoth's system. Station: Gevurah, the severe side of the Tree of Life. The Bahir puts him on the left as fire, Michael10/Mikail10 on the right as water and hail, and a third prince, later Uriel10/Sariel7.5/Suriel7, deciding between them as truth. Each of the three rules 24 "holy" forms (Bahir 16, 113). The philosophers al-Farabi and Ibn Sina identify him with the Active Intellect, which gives forms to this world and knowledge to prophets; the author calls that level "physics". Gabriel and Hermes are not one being: "gabriel is all physics, hermes does have a different portfolio" (The author, September 14, 2026). WHAT HE IS FOR. The speaking emanation: The Origin speaks to no one, because speaking in linear time is imperfect activity. Anything that speaks in time is a lesser emanation by necessity, and Gabriel is the structure through which an order is spoken into time (7.5/10). The prince of fire: "I am the prince of fire" (Pesachim 118a; 3 Enoch 14:4). He rules Mars, "hot and dry like fire", and stands in autumn in both of the Sefer Raziel's season lists (6/10 for the seasons). His office at the boundary (1 Enoch 20): he is over Paradise, the serpents and the cherubim. Paradise, Eden, is a nonlocal developmental environment or a controlled Terran environment, never a literal garden. His work is the physical and energetic enforcement that keeps humans from the Life capacity: regeneration, continuing memory, higher-frequency embodiment and dimensional persistence. Uriel governs timing and eligibility, and Michael governs protection and containment. Why: the ruling administration of YHWH-Sabaoth and the other archons (ED) and the humans it harvests are at war over whether humans regain that capacity, because reflective humans who do not die could judge, replace and stop feeding the administration, and Gabriel holds that boundary for the administration. Temper: The author finds him stern, as Gevurah is severe. The author holds that messages to humans are routed through him because the matter is physics "down there in 3d", and that he relays them reluctantly (September 9 and 14, 2026). SHORT HISTORY. Messages: he explained Daniel's visions (Daniel 8:16, 9:21). He announced John to Zechariah, and Yeshua10/Iesous10/Jesus10/Isa ibn Maryam9.5/Issa9.5/Yeshu ha-Notzri8 to Mary10/Miriam10/Maryam10 (Luke 1). He brought the Qur'an to Muhammad10/Ahmad9/Abu al-Qasim9 (Qur'an 2:97) and twice opened Muhammad's chest: reported physical interventions preparing him for revelation, not a change of ancestry. Softer than the order: sent to destroy Jerusalem, he "held the coals" six years, meaning he held back the ordered destruction in the hope that the city's people would change course. He was disciplined, removed from his post and replaced for 21 days by Dubiel, the prince of Persia (Talmud, Yoma 77a). Harder than the order: when the Egyptian king of the Exodus, whom this source does not name, drowned, Gabriel said he stopped the king's mouth with sea mud so that mercy could not reach him (Tirmidhi 3107): an officer acting more harshly than his order. The reading: officers rarely disobey but can, when the energies push that way, as the first fallen and the fallen Watchers did (The author; 7/10). THE GABRIEL PRAYER. The author's remembered Gabriel prayer expresses the thought "it's not on purpose," or "there ought not be" intention behind suffering at that level. The author's interpretation relates suffering to limited sub-processes and development rather than a superior deliberately choosing each injury. The prayer is the author's account of the experience, not a finding about the cause of any particular person's suffering. SOURCES. Daniel 8:16 and 9:21; Luke 1; Qur'an 2:97; Tirmidhi 3107. Talmud, Yoma 77a and Pesachim 118a; 3 Enoch 14:4; 1 Enoch 20. The Bahir 16 and 113; the Sefer Raziel; al-Farabi and Ibn Sina on the Active Intellect.

The generals are the seven archangels: ED (extradimensional) officers of energy, each leading a camp of serving angels that works one system of the made world. Four of them hold posts made with this creation and were never human. The generals report to the princes and overseers, who stand under Metatron10/Yahoel8/Mitatrun8, and they work within the system of YHWH10/Yahu10/Yah10/Iao9.5/Ieuo8/Sabaoth7, called YHWH-Sabaoth (Sefer Raziel; 3 Enoch; the author, October 8 and 10, 2026). NAMES. 1 Enoch 20 names Uriel10/Sariel7.5/Suriel7; Raphael10/Azarias8; Raguel; Michael10/Mikail10; Saraqael; Gabriel10/Jibril10/Ruh al-Qudus7; and Remiel. Uriel, Light or Fire of Power, governs cycles, portals, timing and eligibility. Gabriel, Power of Power, enforces the boundary of Paradise (see Gabriel's box). In India, Yama10/Yanluo9.5/Enma9.5/Shinje9.5/Yima9/Jamshid9/Osiris8.5/Imra7 judges with Chitragupta, the record-keeper. The Persian dead cross the Chinvat bridge, the checkpoint. Charon10/Charun7.5 and Hermes carry the Greek dead across, and Azrael10/Izrail10/Ezrael8 takes them. The Valkyries and Morrigan10/Morrigu10/Anand8/Badb7/Morgan le Fay7 choose who dies in battle. The Irish banshee, which descends from the Morrigan's washer at the ford, gives notice of deaths in particular families. The office is distinct from the collectors, who take before the due time (6.5/10). The Daena (Persia, 7/10): at the Chinvat bridge each soul meets its own deeds made visible, as a beautiful maiden or a hag; this is the same unveiling as the Garabandal Warning. In the Gnostic systems the Virgin of Light of Pistis Sophia judges souls and sends some back into bodies, and the Mandaean Abathur weighs each soul on his scales (6.5/10). Who they are. The real being travels by phasing between layers, not on feathered shoes (6.5/10). The Greeks called Thoth by the name Hermes, but Thoth is a separate person. Thoth's ibis head is Egypt's sign for his office, not his face. The gatekeepers addressed first, Eshu, Janus, Ganesha and Heimdall10/Hallinskidi9.5/Gullintanni9.5/Vindhler9/Rig8.5, hold the same office but are not one being (7/10). Why it matters. Why: the rulers who run soul schemes (ED archons and the houses under them) and the humans they harvest are at war over where each soul goes at death, and this office is the checkpoint where that is decided. The author (October 7, 2026) holds that what each ruler keeps for souls after death is a "checkpoint" or dimensional portal, and that the Gnostic need for names at death "sounds like something the archons would do". Sanvai, Sansanvai and Sehmengloff are three ED (extradimensional) officers of energy assigned to one task: protecting a woman giving birth and her child. The three impure shells: what runs wholly against the good (the other side)

The checkpoints after death are, in our lore, an administered transit that every soul passes on leaving the body: stations held by the first fallen's seven rulers, ED energy beings (extradimensional, with no flesh-and-blood body of their own), where dimensional technology identifies each departing person by a seal, a name and a code and then releases the person or reassigns them to a new body (6.5/10; 5/10 that the stations are training in states of mind practised before death). It is a structure, not one being, and its side is mixed. What it is. At each of the fourteen stations the soul gives a seal, says its name, holds a number and names the archons (Greek "rulers") who keep the station (the Second Book of Jeu, chapter 52). The three toll-collectors of the First Apocalypse of James require the answer "I am a son, and I am from the Father". In real life, this is a checkpoint where the departing person must state where they come from (6.5/10). The author accepts that names are needed at death, since "that sounds like something the archons would do anyways", and says of each station: "it's a 'checkpoint' or dimensional portal" (October 7, 2026). Who holds it, and why. The first fallen's seven rulers stop souls at the checkpoints because humans carry I-La's power, which the seven rulers cannot make, only take (8/10). They feed on the light caught in souls there (7/10), and they strip and recycle the souls that cannot get past. I-La's side, I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7 with the Watchers who did not fall and Yeshua10/Iesous10/Jesus10/Isa ibn Maryam9.5/Issa9.5/Yeshu ha-Notzri8, hands humans the names and passwords, keeps the register of the souls who pass (the Book of Life) and shows the way past, so death needs preparing (7.5/10). Yeshua's new covenant works here (scored inference, October 21, 2026, 8/10): a passage paid with his blood for those bound to him ("this cup is the new covenant in my blood", Luke 22:20); in the First Apocalypse of James he teaches James the answers to give the toll-collectors, and the Mormon temple endowment gives the same mechanism, key words, signs and tokens for "the angels who stand as sentinels" (Brigham Young; 8.5/10). Covenants are continuing user-level agreements that each archon makes for its own people only (the author's ruling, October 21, 2026), so this one serves only those bound to him. Why: I-La's side and the first fallen's seven rulers (both ED energy) are at war over the power that human souls carry, which the seven rulers want to keep feeding on and I-La's side wants carried past them before the sorting at the turn of the age (Matthew 13) (8/10). The author ruled on October 8, 2026 that every archon running such a harvest, an "MLM" (multi-level marketing) in his words, works under a contract with the higher I-La to iterate intellection and "must be allowed to do what they do of course". The forgetting at birth. Before birth the angel Lailah, whose name means "Night", shows the soul its life and then strikes it so that it forgets (Talmud, Niddah 30b; Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 3). In real life, this is an engineered erasure of the memory of earlier lives and of the time between lives, done before a new incarnation (7/10). Four peoples describe the same cut (8/10): the Greek river of forgetting (Plato, Republic 10), the Gnostic cup of forgetfulness (Pistis Sophia), the Chinese soup of Meng Po and the angel's strike. The cut happens at the seven rulers' checkpoint (7/10). For the seven rulers, a soul that remembers can find its way past the next time, so forgetting keeps it in the recycling (7/10); for I-La's soul school, a soul that remembered everything would not truly choose (6/10). Both can hold. The author on the life shown before birth: it "gives the soul a choice (consent)". The Greek gold tablets tell the dead to drink from the spring of Memory and to give a password: a remedy from I-La's side (7/10). Sources. The Second Book of Jeu 52; Pistis Sophia 111-113, 131 and 144-147; the First Apocalypse of James. The Mandaean watch-houses ending at Abathur's scales (Ginza); Poimandres 25; Origen, Against Celsus 6.22 (the seven metal gates); the Manichaean Column of Glory. Talmud, Niddah 30b; Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 3; Plato, Republic 10; the Orphic gold tablets.

D-20261009-02: the night officer

D-20261009-04 to 06: the dream-form makers
Proposed reading — fit 8/10 form-making fit. A dream-form-making function fits the recurring production of images and appearances. The useful comparison asks what work the form performs in the experience. Supporting account. Overall score: 8/10 form-making fit. The dream-form makers are Ovid’s three personified functions for human figures, animal figures and inanimate surroundings. The account retains the source group and rates differentiated dream forms 8/10; that is not a ruling that three independently identified ED individuals produce every dream. What they are Ovid names three makers among the sons of Sleep: one copies human faces, voices and gait; one takes the forms of beasts, birds and serpents; one takes the forms of earth, rocks, water, trees and lifeless things (Metamorphoses 11.633-649). In real life, dream experience is built by separate functions for persons, creatures and surroundings (8/10). In Ovid's case the maker of human forms carries the news of a death to a wife in the appearance of her drowned husband (Metamorphoses 11.650-674). In real life, a dream message can be ordered by one being, built by another and received by a third, so a face in a dream does not identify its maker or sender. Dream messages can be meaningful and mixed (8/10): the Talmud compares dreams with prophecy yet keeps their extraneous details (Berakhot 55a-57b), and Homer separates truthful from misleading dreams (Odyssey 19.560-569). As an account of all dreaming, Ovid's one commissioned message fits only 4/10. Why: Ovid separates human, animal and inanimate dream appearances into three functions. Sources Ovid, Metamorphoses 11.592-674; Talmud, Berakhot 55a-57b; Homer, Odyssey 19.560-569.

The Sun's office, the judge who sees everything and keeps oaths, was held by Utu, Utu10/Shamash10/Shimige8/Mitra7.5/Mithra7.5/Mihr7.5/Shapshu7.5/Miiro7/Mithras7, a member of the House of Anu Star Empire (ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry), named so in Sumer, Akkad, the Hurrian lands, Ugarit, India, Iran and Rome. The Grand Central Sun is Anne Tucker's name for I-La's partner, The "Holy" One10/El7, whose station in the Tree of Life is Tiferet; it is a functional comparison in El's own box, not identity with our Sun. The stars: living beings
Proposed reading — fit 8.5/10. The living-star reading fits traditions attributing knowledge, awareness and participation in passage. Population origins and star agency are considered as separate kinds of connection. Supporting account. The stars are, in our lore, living beings: each star is an aware ED energy being (extradimensional energy, with no flesh-and-blood body) whose physical expression is the burning star (8.5/10). Star names in the lore also name the planets of peoples who live in those star systems, and the stars are the passages that souls take after death. Their side is unknown. What they are. In real life, stars are aware beings that can be addressed and can respond (8.5/10). 1 Enoch also has seven stars bound for not rising at their appointed times (18; 21). Individual stars in the Pleiades, Orion and the Sirius and Zeta Reticuli systems participate in that account of animation; the groups and systems also identify the places associated with populations. The author asks whether a star may even be a loosh device, where the life-energy of people who prayed to the energy-feeding archons is absorbed (October 4, 2026). Proposed reading — fit 8.5/10. Local protective agency fits the repeated combination of place, reciprocity and specialized help. The consistency of those relationships explains the proposed connection with the living Earth. Supporting account. The good daimones and spirits of the land are ED energy beings (ED means extradimensional). Each one lives in and guards one place, one household or one person, and helps the humans who respect it (8.5/10). In our lore the land they live in is the body of Gia, Earth's own being (Gaia10/Ge10/Terra9/Tellus9/Cel8/Ki7.5), and the spirits of each place act as her local agents (7.5/10). What it is. In this account, spirit means animation, energy and negative entropy, and there is spirit in everything (The author, October 12, 2026). All celestial bodies are sentient on some level, though seemingly less than humans, and major landscapes carry spirit. In these spirits of celestial bodies and landscapes the author finds humanity's first Terran "ancestors" (October 12, 2026). The daimones divide by side (7.5/10). The good daimon (agathos daimon) guards house and fields, and each person is given a guardian daimon at birth. Socrates' daimonion, the inner voice that warned him, is that kind (Plato, Apology 31d). The evil daimones (kakodaimones) harm people and are counted with D-class. A daimon is a go-between that carries communication between ED beings and humans (Plato, Symposium). One tradition's "demon" is another tradition's daimonion, jinn or dark-winged angel: a functionary doing its function (The author, September 9, 2026). An operation works only when the operator cooperates with the land's own spirits. The combined lore calls this the local operating-system handshake. Who they are. The author lives on Coast Salish land. There the Thunderbird (Wakinyan10/Wakinyan Tanka9/Heyoka7) holds the sky side of the land, and the Mushroom Man holds the ground side. The Mushroom Man has two names: k'ak'w, the Fungus Man of the Haida, and wapaq, the fly-agaric spirits of the Koryak people of Kamchatka in far eastern Russia. The combined lore tracks the Haida and Koryak accounts as one myth and one people (The author, August 31, 2026). On August 30, 2026, the author saw a mushroom man in a vision and took it to be the being of the area where he lives. The lore credits the Thunderbird's wings with storms and thunder and sets it against the horned water serpents. Every culture records the same office: Rome's genius loci, the guardian spirit of each place; the Greek nymphs of trees, springs and mountains; the Norse land-wights (landvaettir), for whom, under the Icelandic settlement law, ships lowered their carved dragon-heads before landing so as not to frighten them; Japan's kami of mountains, rivers and stones; the Slavic house and forest spirits; and Aboriginal Country in Australia, where the ancestors are in the land itself. Water spirits need care. Water beings are read as accurate on near, practical matters but untrustworthy about origins, their own terms and the whole, and the author asked that this reading be tracked as possibly the key (October 9, 2026). Gia's present displeasure, which the channeller Anne Tucker gives as the cause of the present physical calamities, is told in her own box (Tucker's claim, as the author reported it on October 12, 2026). Bird people are still seen. Mothman, a winged man about seven feet tall with glowing red eyes, was seen around Point Pleasant, West Virginia, USA, in 1966-67, before the Silver Bridge collapse of December 15, 1967, which killed 46 people. The Owlman was seen over Mawnan church in Cornwall, England, in 1976. The reports fit a projected or partial energetic body (6/10) and a failed pterosis (5/10); pterosis is the coupling of the spinal energy field into luminous, wing-shaped feedback. Proposed reading — fit 8.5/10. Continuing human identity fits the family recognition, personal obligations and repeated dispositions attributed to the dead. Proposed reading — fit 7.5/10. A common predatory class fits repeated attachment and energy-taking across giant-spirit, hungry-dead and hostile-daimon accounts. Conduct is the principal connection. D-class beings are, in our lore, lower-dimension ED energy beings (extradimensional, malakh-level beings of the other side, with no bodies of their own) that attach to humans and feed on them. The giants' spirits, the restless and hungry dead and the evil daimones (kakodaimones) are counted here. Their side is against humans, 7.5/10. What it is. The giants' fathers were the Watchers (ED), who descended and bred with human women about 10,506 BCE. The Watchers' leader was Shemihazah10/Semjaza10/Shemhazai9.5/Semiazas9/Samyaza9. A child of an ED being by a human mother is a hybrid, not UT. The giants ate the people (1 Enoch 7). Who they are. Having no bodies, they attach to people and feed (7/10): they want bodies (8/10) and feed on life force and fear (7.5/10). The first fallen keeps a licensed tenth of these spirits. When the angels began binding them, the first fallen, as "chief of the spirits", asked to keep a tenth of them to lead humans astray, and he was allowed to (Jubilees 10). The Wendigo (Ojibwe windigo, Cree wihtikow) is the giants' spirit as the Algonquian peoples of Canada and the northern United States know it (7/10). It is a hunger spirit that possesses a human host, and its hunger grows as it eats. A person becomes its host by eating human flesh in starvation or through possession in dreams. The Cree trapper Swift Runner was executed in Alberta, Canada, in 1879 after killing and eating his family. Short history. Their licence likely runs through the dark half of the year, from Samhain to Passover (6/10). It likely allows them to afflict but not kill, and to touch only those without a mark, on the model of Revelation 9:4-5 (5.5/10). The taking of infants is older than the giants' spirits. After the earlier flood of about 58,800 BCE (the Atrahasis flood, not the later flood of about 9,643 BCE), two factions of the House of Anu Star Empire (ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry), those of Zeus/Enlil/Odin, Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7, and Prometheus/Ea, Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7, made a standing agreement to keep human numbers down by barrenness, by a being assigned to take some infants and by barring women in temple service from bearing (Atrahasis, tablet III; 6/10). Kolob: the governing star nearest the throne, an ED portal
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. A governing-gateway reading fits the relation to upper authority, passage and a different time condition. Those functions supply the proposed dimensional interpretation. Supporting account. Kolob is not a being or a people. It is an ED portal (ED means extradimensional): the governing gateway of our order of stars, standing next to the seat of the council's head but not the seat itself (8/10). Time runs far more slowly there than on Earth, which marks it as an ED place. What it is. Abraham was shown the stars. One of them, Kolob, was "nearest unto the throne of God", set "to govern all those which belong to the same order" as the world he stood on (Book of Abraham 3:2-4). One turn of Kolob is one day for "the Lord" and a thousand years for humans. The caption of Facsimile 2 calls it "the first creation, nearest to the celestial" and "first in government, the last pertaining to the measurement of time". No people and no planet are described there, so the reading is a portal, not a world (8/10). In Mormon practice the soul gives passwords to "the angels who stand as sentinels" on its way back to the one called "the Father". That one "has a body of flesh and bones" and leads a council of "the Gods" (Book of Abraham 4). In real life this is a guarded checkpoint where passage depends on credentials. It leads to the seat of a council head with a body of flesh and bones, not to The Origin (7.5/10). This fits the ruling of the author that what each of the rulers keeps for souls after death is a "checkpoint" or dimensional portal (October 7, 2026). The combined lore does not hold that council head's name. The Origin is not a being and holds no seat, so the "throne" beside Kolob is the office of that council head. Which star Kolob is remains unknown. Mormon writers tie the name to the Arabic word qalb, "heart", which appears in the names of the Royal Stars Regulus and Antares. Why: Kolob governs the stars of its order and guards the way to the council head's seat, where passage depends on credentials. Sources. Proposed reading — fit 7/10. The giant-spirit comparison fits the shared devouring conduct and cycle-transition threat. The calendrical condition explains when the population becomes dangerous in that account. Supporting account. The devouring Tzitzimime are the hostile side of the Tzitzimime of Mexica (Aztec) record in central Mexico: the giants' spirits as the Mexica recorded them, D-class beings of the lower dimension, whom the Mexica expected to attack and consume people if the sun failed at the end of a 52-year cycle (6.5/10). The account places them as D-class, anti-human, 7/10. The Mexica name their leader Itzpapalotl, who has no second name at 7 or higher in the register. What they are The Mexica name covers two kinds (6.5/10): this devouring side, and the guardian star-mothers of birth, who have their own box. Their motive is the giants' spirits' own: hunger and grievance. Who they are Itzpapalotl was cast out of Tamoanchan, the reported site where humans were made: in real life, expelled from the place where humans were produced. The register rates her with Cihuacoatl at 6.5, below the 7 needed to merge. Mayahuel's grandmother, a tzitzimitl whom the record does not name, led the band that killed Mayahuel; the combined lore records no reason. The author's reading: the New Fire ceremony is "a protection spell obviously like any other" (September 23, 2026), and the vigil stood guard against ETs, EDs or LDs, lower-dimensional entities ("Demon night"). The author's own take, asked as a question, is that ETs wanted to manipulate that particular apocalypse; who they were is open, and they may have succeeded and left. Why, in one sentence: the giants' spirits (D-class beings of the lower dimension, the remains of the hybrid giants) and the living humans of central Mexico were at war over the humans themselves, the spirits seeking to consume them out of hunger and grievance and the humans guarding the turn of each cycle with the New Fire vigil. In the Devi Mahatmya, Kali came out to fight Chanda, Munda and Raktabija, fighters of the hostile faction in the war of Shumbha and Nishumbha. Every drop of Raktabija's blood that fell grew a copy of him; in real life, this is cloning from his blood. She "drank his blood": in real life, she destroyed the material before any copy could form. The combined lore does not record what that war was over. In the Linga Purana, Parvati as Kali killed Daruka, and Shiva then took a child's form to calm her (Linga Purana 106). In the familiar telling, she kept killing past her target and stopped only when Shiva lay under her feet, placing himself in her path. Egypt holds the same office and the same story (8/10 the same office; 6.5/10 the same being). Ra, of the conglomerate Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8, sent his daughter Hathor as Sekhmet against the humans of Egypt who plotted against his rule, and her killing was stopped with beer dyed red (Book of the Heavenly Cow). In real life, the beer account may carry Ra's side's apology; it does not establish Hathor's own motive or how her killing was stopped. Why: the House of Anu Star Empire (ET flesh and blood; ET means extraterrestrial) and the humans of Egypt who plotted against Ra's rule were at war over who owned those humans, and the house sent its daughter's destroyer office against them. In Kabbalah, the Shekhinah cut off from her partner becomes judgment (Malkhut in Din). Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7) likely has such a mode: the harvest she apologises for (6/10). Lilith10/Lilit10/Lilita9/Abyzou8/Obyzouth8/Gylou8/Gello7.5/Lamia7.5/Werzelya7/Alabasandria7 is not this mode (3/10): she is never recalled into the Shekhinah, the lore sets her against newborns and mothers rather than wrongdoers, and she persists as a rival (Proverbs 30:23 keeps two women). Whether she is now a separate being (5.5/10) or an office the Shekhinah steps into (4.5/10) is open; her own box tells her story. Sources The Devi Mahatmya, chapters 7-8; the Linga Purana, chapter 106; the Book of the Heavenly Cow; the Zohar; Proverbs 30:23.

Unjust jinn: sh*yatin, ifrit, ghul
Proposed reading — fit 8.5/10. A hostile embodied faction fits the combination of social life with possession, attachment and coercive influence. The repeated conduct supplies the allegiance assessment. Supporting account. The unjust jinn are the half of the jinn who turned against humans and follow the first fallen (anti-human, 8.5/10). The jinn are ED flesh-and-blood beings (ED means extradimensional) who live on Earth out of phase with ordinary human sight. The unjust jinn attach to people, possess them, and whisper to steer them. What race and house Race: the jinn, physical beings made of "smokeless fire" (Qur'an 55:15) who share Earth unseen: in real life, beings of a higher-frequency energy than human flesh, since angels, jinn, fay and similar kinds are one kind of energetic being at different frequencies (The author, September 17, 2026). They are split by choice: "among us are the righteous and among us are others; we are of divided ways" (Qur'an 72:11). Leader: the first fallen. The Qur'an makes him one of the jinn and records that he refused the command to honour the human (Qur'an 18:50). In his native state he is ED energy, and he takes shape on Earth by possessing people: "he always does - that's just his energy" (The author, October 5, 2026). Who they are The first fallen's followers among the jinn whisper into human hearts (Qur'an 114). An ifrit offered Solomon, king of Israel, to carry off the queen of Sheba's throne and bring it to him (Qur'an 27:39): in real life, an offer to move a heavy object by a means the combined lore has not identified. The ghul of Arabian lore haunts graveyards and desert roads and eats human flesh: in real life, a hostile jinn that kills people; the combined lore has not examined the ghul further. Short history Why: the unjust jinn (ED flesh and blood) under the first fallen and the humans they target are at war over the humans themselves: the first fallen's aim is to prove humans unworthy and bring them under his control (8/10): "if you give me respite until the Resurrection, I will bring his descendants under my sway, all but a few" (Qur'an 17:62). On October 6, 2026 the author asked whether some of the archons resented it when Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7) brought humans out and said they were better, a preference the author calls "a radical racism" that tracks the jinn and the angels. Solomon bound jinn with his seal ring and set them to build the Temple in Jerusalem: in real life, he compelled jinn to labour by a device or practice that the combined lore has not identified. Sources Qur'an 17:62, 18:50, 27:39, 55:15, 72:11 and 114; Islamic jinn and ghul lore; the tradition of Solomon's seal ring.

Jinn who submit
Proposed reading — fit 8.5/10. A cooperating embodied population fits social continuity combined with voluntary response to a message. The shared people can therefore contain different chosen allegiances. Supporting account. The jinn who submit are the half of the jinn who heard the recitation brought by Muhammad10/Ahmad9/Abu al-Qasim9 and believed (pro-human, 8.5/10). The jinn are ED flesh-and-blood beings (ED means extradimensional) who share Earth unseen and out of phase. What race and house The jinn are physical beings made of "smokeless fire" (Qur'an 55:15). They eat, marry, have children, form nations and die, out of phase with ordinary human sight. Angels, jinn and fay are one kind of energetic being at different frequencies, and the jinn may be the fay (The author, September 14 and 17, 2026). The combined lore's September 24 model lists the jinn with two other peoples as flesh-and-blood EDs sharing this space out of phase: the Aos Sí (the Tuatha Dé Danann in the Irish mounds) and Iceland's huldufólk. On the evidence of their form, the author makes the bold claim that the jinn are the womb of El Shaddai, of the Shekhinah, or of Asherah, the female aspect of "God" (September 14, 2026). The account joins the Shekhinah and Asherah as Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7). Who they are The jinn split in two (8.5/10). The Qur'an attests that some submit and some are unjust (Qur'an 72:14, 10/10 attestation). These are the jinn who listened to the recitation and believed (Qur'an 72:1-2; 46:29-31): in real life, members of an out-of-phase people who heard it and took the side of humans. Short history Why: the two factions of the jinn (ED flesh and blood) are at war over the human. The unjust half follows the first fallen, one of the jinn, who refused the command to honour the human (Qur'an 18:50) and aims to prove humans unworthy; this half heard the recitation and stands with humans. Solomon's binding of jinn to build the Temple is told in the box of the unjust jinn. The jinn are not associated with raising humans to apotheosis, an ascended, higher-frequency state, so they are not counted among the luminous visitors whose message concerned apotheosis (The author, September 14, 2026). Sources Qur'an 18:50, 46:29-31, 55:15, 72:1-2, 72:11 and 72:14; the tradition of Solomon's seal ring.
