Tuatha Dé Danann: Danu's god-folk, the House of Anu Star Empire's people in Ireland
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The House-descendant and out-of-phase-population readings fit the combined family association, acquired equipment and political continuity after defeat. Their repeated personal dealings support a continuing society. Supporting account. The Tuatha Dé Danann are the people of Danu (Danu10/Ana8/Antu8/Don7/Doumu7/Ziguang7/Marici7/Molizhitian7/Nammu7), who is Antu, Anu's wife (8/10). They are the House of Anu Star Empire's people in Ireland (7.5/10), and Danu holds the claim to them (7/10); the author, October 20, 2026: "Danu maybe is better - they're her people". Before their defeat they were hybrids with ED technology (ED means extradimensional). After it they shifted out of phase into the mounds and became ED flesh and blood, and they stand on humanity's side (8/10). What race and house House: the House of Anu Star Empire, Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8, whose physical star empire is ET flesh and blood (ET means extraterrestrial) with ED/archon ancestry. Tuath Dé means "the god-folk". The earliest Irish texts call them only Tuath Dé, and Genesis 6 calls the Watchers bene elohim, "sons of God": the first name meant the people of the Watchers (7/10). After their Watcher fathers were condemned and bound, they took the name "people of Danu" on purpose, to survive and keep their land under the human project (the author's ruling, October 21, 2026: "yes it is so, it also tracks binah"). The author: the Tuatha make perfect sense connected to Anu, as the "divine" shining geared ones, and their technology can be tracked to tell who they are (October 6, 2026). The shining is Watcher descent mixed into Danu's line: over generations of interbreeding the giants' line became human-sized and shining (6.5/10); House of Anu Star Empire blood or treatment alone stands at 4.5/10. The author, October 20, 2026, on the giants who lived about two thousand years before: "they interbred". Their leaders are House of Anu Star Empire figures: Lugh10/Lug10/Lleu Llaw Gyffes8.5/Lugus8/Perseus7.5/Huangfei7, the Dagda10/Eochaid Ollathair10/Ruad Rofhessa10/Sucellus7, and Nuada10/Nuadu10/Nodens8.5/Nudd8.5/Lludd Llaw Eraint8.5/Tyr7.5. Danu is a person, not a river (7/10). The Irish call her Ana or Anu, "mother of the gods of Ireland" (Cormac's Glossary, about 900). Two hills in County Kerry, Ireland, are named as her breasts (the Paps of Anu), and the Welsh call her Don. Her name shares only an old word for "river" with the Danube (4/10). The author marks a tension: the Tuatha could have been taken from the Danube region of central and southeastern Europe and experimented on, so that Elena Danaan's account and the combined lore's merge (October 6, 2026). The Book of Invasions (Lebor Gabála Érenn, written down in the 11th century) has Nemed's people come from Scythia, the land north of the Black Sea where the Danube reaches the sea; each Samhain the Fomorian rulers Conand and Morc took two thirds of their children, grain and milk: in real life, a human people paying tribute in children and food to an occupying power (7/10). The Tuatha are, in their own record, the last remnant of Nemed's people (7.5/10), and Nemed's people are the Danube humans Danu claimed, of whom the Tuatha are the trained survivors (6.5/10). The motive (7/10): Orion, the son of Poseidon10/Neptune9/Nethuns9/Yam8/Nahar7.5/Pa-Yam7.5/Pontos7, hunted the Pleiades women (Ovid, Fasti 4.169-178), and Poseidon's line took tribute from the House's peoples. Side: they fought for the Pleiades branch of the house, against the sea line that hunted the Seven (8/10). That branch is led by Antu's daughter Hathor10/Athyr10/Lady of Byblos8/Aphrodite8/Venus8/Inanna8/Ishtar8/Astarte8/Sekhmet7.5/Amaterasu7.5. Short history The House of Anu Star Empire withdrew about 10,950 BCE. Nemed's people destroyed Conand's Tower on Tory Island, off County Donegal in north-west Ireland; the sea then rose and drowned most of both armies, and about thirty survivors left in one ship. Beothach's group went to "the northern islands of the world", and their descendants became the Tuatha: in real life, a sea surge and a small remnant taken north (6/10). The record names no rescuer; the House of Anu Star Empire's remaining personnel, who evacuated or preserved its Atlantic centre around the catastrophe of about 10,950 BCE, are the leading candidate (5/10). The northern islands were Orkney, Shetland, the Faroe Islands or the high ground of the dry North Sea floor: the sea then stood about 60 metres lower, and the floor between Britain and Denmark was dry land (5/10). Gotland, an island of present-day Sweden, is lowered to 3/10: it was still under the sea when the ice age ended, and people arrived there only about 9,300 years ago. In Elena Danaan's account, Gotland's wise women armed them; that remains her claim. At the House's former northern centre the Tuatha learned their arts in four cities, Falias, Gorias, Findias and Murias, from four masters, Morfesa, Esras, Uiscias and Semias (Cath Maige Tuired). The four masters were Watchers with elemental offices (7/10), ED beings who had come down about 10,506 BCE. The author, October 20, 2026: "these sound like the watchers - they all had terrestrial elemental powers". The city names carry the four elements: Falias from fál, the Stone of Fál (earth); Gorias from gor, "heat" (fire; Lugh's spear); Findias from find, "bright, white" (air; Nuada's sword); Murias from muir, "sea" (water; the Dagda's cauldron). The Watcher chiefs held the matching offices (1 Enoch 6 and 8): Araqiel the signs of the earth, Baraqiel lightning and Shamsiel the sun, Ezeqeel the clouds and Kokabiel the stars, and Matarel, "rain of God". Morfesa is mór-fhis, "great knowledge", the same word as the Dagda's title Ruad Rofhessa, "lord of great knowledge" (Morfesa is the Dagda's teacher or the Dagda in the teaching office, 6/10). Esras is Esdras, Ezra, whom the archangel Uriel10/Sariel7.5/Suriel7 taught (4 Ezra). Uiscias is from uisce, "water". Semias carries the name of Shemihazah10/Semjaza10/Shemhazai9.5/Semiazas9/Samyaza9, the Watchers' leader who taught enchantments (1 Enoch 8). What the Tuatha were known for matches the arts 1 Enoch 8 lists: weapons and metalwork (Goibniu's spears, Nuada's sword), enchantments (druidry), the signs of clouds and lightning (the Tuatha druids' fog and showers of fire and blood on the Fir Bolg) and the cutting of roots (the healers Dian Cecht and Airmed). The Watchers as the Tuatha's trainers stand at 6.5/10. Tuireann, father of the Tuatha's three craftsmen, Goibniu the smith, Credne the metalworker and Luchta the carpenter, is the Tuatha's memory of the Watcher chief Turiel (1 Enoch 6), father of their craft line (7/10); where Thor, whom the author's account makes Turiel, belongs is open (see the Heracles box). They reached Ireland "in dark clouds" that hid the sun for three days: in real life, craft hidden in cloud or smoke (6.5/10). Their equipment was the House of Anu Star Empire's (7.5/10). They received it in the four cities and did not bring it: it was House equipment left at the former northern centre when the House withdrew (6.5/10). It included the Stone of Fál, in real life an identification device that confirmed the rightful king (6.5/10); the healing well of Sláine, a revival tank from which dead and wounded fighters came out whole; Nuada's sword and Lugh's spear, which were energy weapons; the Dagda's cauldron, a food maker and also a teaching: the Irish Cauldron of Poesy (probably 8th century) says three cauldrons are born in every person, the cauldron of warming, the cauldron of motion (turned upright only by sorrow or joy) and the cauldron of knowledge; in real life, three inner capacities, the one that keeps a person alive, the one turned on by strong experience and the one that knows (7/10), so the Dagda's cauldron was both the machine and the teaching of the inner cauldrons (6/10); Nuada's working silver arm, a prosthetic; the féth fíada, a cloaking field. Why: the Tuatha (hybrids with ED technology, on the House of Anu Star Empire's Pleiades side) and Atlantis were at war over who would own the humans of Ireland and take tribute from them. Atlantis was the warlike Fomorian sea kingdom south of them near Spain, which is why the Tuatha trained in the north; its rulers belonged to the old order's sea line of Poseidon (8/10), and its soldiers were Poseidon's giants, the Fomorians, not the Nephilim (7/10). The combined reading (6.5/10): Danu holds the claim to Nemed's survivors, Hathor acts within her branch, the Watchers taught the survivors with the House's leftover equipment, and the aim was to drive Poseidon's line out of Ireland. The Fomorian king Elatha came over the sea in a silver ship, and through his son Bres the Fomorians took tribute and put the Tuatha's senior members to forced labour. The Tuatha destroyed Atlantis by a directed attack about 9,643 BCE, within about forty years of Plato's date of about 9,600 BCE (9.5/10 for the date correspondence). The author: "the tuatha were always complex, they fought the giants / formorians and some humans but with humans mostly, married into them, then humans fight as they do and some of them left" (October 2, 2026). The sons of Míl, the Milesians, who came from Iberia after them, then defeated them at Tailtiu (Lebor Gabála Érenn): in real life, a line that survived Atlantis returning against the Tuatha (the author's rating, October 21, 2026: 8/10). The Tuatha took the underground half of Ireland, the sídhe mounds. Manannan mac Lir10/Oirbsen9.5/Manawydan fab Llyr8 hid them under the féth fíada: in real life, a cloaking field. A human-like people thereby shifted out of phase (7.5/10). Some went north instead. Snorri's Ynglinga saga (about 1225) says the people of Odin, who stands in Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7, came from east of the Tanais, the Don River in Scythia, and moved north to Sweden with their magic: in real life, the same migration north out of Scythia that took Nemed's descendants to the northern islands to learn their arts (7/10). The Don, the Danube and Danu share one old root meaning "river", and the Welsh form of Danu's name is Don. The Prose Edda calls the light elves "fairer than the sun to look at": in real life, the same shining people as the Tuatha (7/10). The Swedish kings claimed descent from Freyr (Ynglinga saga): in real life, a northern royal line descended from one of that people (6.5/10). The tall fair northern look came together in the north after the Younger Dryas (6/10): the earliest known blond-hair gene is from a man in Siberia about 17,000 years ago, hunters in Scandinavia had light eyes and lighter skin by about 8,000 years ago, and height came with steppe herders about 5,000 years ago. The author, October 20, 2026: "did they flee and retire here? siring the tall blonde Norse people? where does that 'Nordic' look come from? - this seems tight." His reading: the Watchers and the Watcher-descended Tuatha withdrew north and fathered the tall fair northern line (6.5/10). Contactee accounts tie the tall fair "Nordics" to the Pleiades, and Valiant Thor was of that type. Valiant Thor, a modern visitor who says his base is on Venus, travels with a party that carries Tuatha names; Donn10/Eber Donn8.5/Donn Firinne8.5/Dis Pater of the Gauls7 is among them. The identification of his party as Tuatha is 7/10. Sources Lebor Gabála Érenn (the Book of Invasions); Cath Maige Tuired (the Second Battle of Mag Tuired); Cormac's Glossary; 4 Ezra; 1 Enoch 6 and 8; Ovid, Fasti 4; Plato, Timaeus and Critias 113c; Snorri Sturluson, Ynglinga saga and Gylfaginning; Geology of Gotland; Documenta Praehistorica 2020; Elena Danaan's accounts; the Valiant Thor contact accounts.

Hostile fay: the Unseelie Court
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. An out-of-phase hostile population fits bargains, abductions and enforceable territorial rules recurring together. These sustained relationships support a society with interests of its own. Supporting account. The hostile fay are the fay who harm humans (anti-human, 8/10). The fay are ED flesh-and-blood beings (ED means extradimensional): they have devices and a home here on Earth in another phase, out of phase with ordinary human sight. Scottish lore calls the hostile fay the Unseelie Court, a harmful faction of the fair folk; the Seelie Court, which has its own box, helps those who respect it. What race and house The dark hairy ones are fay, one kind across Hebrew, Greek, Roman and Celtic lore (7.5/10). They assault women (Augustine, City of God 15.23; Isidore of Seville). The kind includes: the Hebrew se'irim, "the hairy ones", who received sacrifices in the open fields (Leviticus 17:7) and dance in ruins where Lilith10/Lilit10/Lilita9/Abyzou8/Obyzouth8/Gylou8/Gello7.5/Lamia7.5/Werzelya7/Alabasandria7 rests (Isaiah 13:21; 34:14), with Azazel10/Asael9/Azael8 named as their chief; the Greek Pans, a kind rather than one individual; the individual Pan has the registered names Pan10/Faunus8.5/Inuus8/Mendes7.5/Min7.5; the Roman fauns and incubi; the Dusii of Gaul. What they do The lore records that they take babies and leave substitutes (changelings), strike cattle and people with sudden harm (elf-shot), lead travellers astray, take nursing women and ride with the Wild Hunt. In real life they are out-of-phase opportunists who take people, cause disappearances and lost time, take nursing women and harm those who cross them (6.5/10). In Ireland in 1895, Bridget Cleary was killed by her husband, who believed a fairy had replaced her. Three older accounts show the same pattern (9/10): Alison Pearson's trial in Scotland (1588): taken, struck, a painless mark; the Anne Jefferies account in England (1645): six small people in green; Robert Kirk in Scotland (1691): people returned with time missing. Whitley Strieber's account in the United States shows it too: small beings took him from his cabin, he later had two triangles cut into his forearm, and his collaborator lost two hours. The fay and the Greys are separate peoples whose encounters are often confused and misidentified (The author, October 14, 2026); the shared pattern does not make them one people. Short history Why: the hostile fay (ED flesh and blood) and humans are at war over human lives, children and nursing women, which the fay take to pay their debt to a stronger power and to feed their own weak children (6/10). They pay a tithe to hell every seven years and pay it with a human when they can (the ballad of Tam Lin): in real life, a toll in human captives paid to a stronger power. Their children need human milk (Robert Kirk, 1691). Sources Scottish Seelie and Unseelie lore; the ballad of Tam Lin; Robert Kirk (1691); the Bridget Cleary case (1895); Leviticus 17:7; Isaiah 13:21 and 34:14; Jerome; Isidore of Seville; Augustine, City of God 15.23; Whitley Strieber's accounts; the Alison Pearson trial (1588); the Anne Jefferies account (1645).

Helpful fay (the Seelie Court): the Lady of the Lake (Nimue)
Proposed reading — fit 7.5/10. The helpful-fay reading fits repeated instruction, protective intervention and transfer of exceptional objects to selected humans. Nimue supplies a personal career through which those functions connect. Supporting account. The Seelie Court is the helpful side of the fay, the fair folk of Scotland, Ireland and Wales: an out-of-phase people of extradimensional (ED) flesh and blood who live in the mounds, hills and waters of Britain and Ireland and help humans who treat them with respect. The Lady of the Lake, Nimue10/Niniane9.5/Viviane9.5, is the best-known member of this side. The account rates the box 7.5/10, but the author's ruling that the fay are largely humanity's enemies governs how far that help goes. What race and house The fay are ED flesh and blood. In the author's words, such beings have devices and a home planet that "is just HERE in another phase or another planet in another universe that touches" (October 2, 2026). Out of phase means present in the same place at a different frequency, so they are not normally seen. The author ruled on September 14 and 17, 2026 that angels, jinn, fay and the Elohim are one kind: energetic beings of the Powers at different frequencies, different currents in the infinite consciousness field (ICF); the jinn may be the fay. The fay split in two (8/10): this helpful Seelie Court, and the hostile Unseelie Court, which has its own box. The account reads the fay of later tales as the people of the Tuatha Dé Danann, the House of Anu Star Empire's people in Ireland, who went out of phase into the mounds after the human Milesians defeated them. On October 6, 2026 the author asked how the fay can be the Danube people if they are largely enemies, or whether the shared naming is a coincidence; that point is not settled. The fay and the Greys are separate peoples; similar appearances or encounters lead witnesses and later tellers to confuse them (The author, October 14, 2026). The author's governing ruling: the fay "tend to serve Un-Shining": they are chthonic (bound to the underground), pay tithes to "the hellish" and do not help humans gain apotheosis, the ascent to a higher, more capable condition (September 14, 2026). On October 6, 2026 the author ruled that "the fay are largely our enemies". The Seelie help in the record is therefore real but conditional and local; it is not help toward human ascent. Who they are The Lady of the Lake: the later Arthurian romances say she gave Arthur10/Arturus10/Artus10 his sword, Excalibur, raised Lancelot, and shut Merlin10/Merlinus10/Myrddin9/Myrddin Wyllt9/Lailoken8.5 away. In real life this most likely describes a woman of an out-of-phase water people who armed a human king, fostered a human child and confined a hybrid adviser (7.5/10 for the helpful-fay reading). The fair folk of the mounds are land-bound beings at thresholds who help, ambush and guard: the Irish bean-sídhe warns a family of a coming death, and the Scottish Highlands record the cat-sìth. The water-folk are fay kind (6/10, September 26, 2026): merfolk, the selkies who shed seal skins, the kappa of Japan, Mami Wata of West and Central Africa and the naga underwater kingdoms of India marry, bargain, abduct and change shape at the water's edge. Lilith is an ED (extradimensional) flesh-and-blood being on the first fallen's side and his consort, whose recorded operation is taking human seed and life-force without consent to breed a people of her own. She arose from earthly material, not from a star house, and the account rates her anti-human at 6.5/10. The newborn-killing stories are struck as fairy tale, and her oath to these three sounds like fairy tale unless they gave her something (The author). The Watcher faction who descended after the Younger Dryas transition and was later bound
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. A divided descended administration fits the same teachers becoming embodied partners and rival household founders. The continuity of duties and subsequent exploitation explains the faction's mixed course. Supporting account. The fallen Watchers are a faction of the Watchers, ED (extradimensional) officers of a council first sent to teach humans and do justice, who came straight down to Earth (ED to Terra, 8/10), took bodies and wives, fathered the giants and were bound here. The account rates the box 8/10 and marks the faction changed or divided: the record shows both teaching and exploitation. What race and house The Watchers split in two (8.5/10); these are the ones who fell, and the "holy" Watchers who stayed have their own box. Their leader is Shemihazah10/Semjaza10/Shemhazai9.5/Semiazas9/Samyaza9; their teacher of weapons and war is Azazel10/Asael9/Azael8. Each fallen chief held the title of an office over sky and weather systems (lightning, shooting stars, thunder, rain, stars, sun, clouds, winter) and taught its signs. The loyal princes of 3 Enoch 14 hold the same posts under the same titles: the titles stayed with the offices while some holders changed sides (8/10). The Watchers are the parents; the Nephilim are their giant hybrid children by human women. These children are not the Earth-born Gigantes, whose account category is UT. Short history The Adamic order begins at the approximately 10,950 BCE female-to-male dimensional boundary associated with the Younger Dryas onset. By then the House of Anu Star Empire's major presence had withdrawn, human minds had become quieter and more private as access to the older kundalini capacities diminished, and the dimensional boundary provided a crossing opportunity. About two hundred Watchers came down on Mount Hermon, "in the days of Jared", whose name means "descent", approximately 444 years after that boundary, around 10,506 BCE; they swore a group oath so none could back out (1 Enoch 6). The 444-year interval is retained as a meaningful correspondence (9/10), not rounded away. They took bodies and wives and fathered the giants, who ate the people's food and then the people: in real life, a hybrid population that consumed the human population's resources and then killed people. Azazel taught weapons and war and others taught enchantments, building a power base among humans (1 Enoch 7-8). Motive (7.5/10): they wanted children and a people of their own, "let us choose wives from the children of men" (1 Enoch 6:2); by taking flesh they gave up living forever (1 Enoch 15). They may also have wanted the same quiet-mind experience, and may have intended to strengthen Terran society with law, knowledge and their own inheritance; those motives can coexist. Their contacts came at the thin times, when access opens, not from a need to breed at an alignment (6/10). Four archangels, generals of the administration of YHWH-Sabaoth (YHWH10/Yahu10/Yah10/Iao9.5/Ieuo8/Sabaoth7), carried out the sentence (1 Enoch 9-10): Raphael (Raphael10/Azarias8) bound Azazel in the desert; Michael10/Mikail10 bound Shemihazah and his fellows for seventy generations; Gabriel10/Jibril10/Ruh al-Qudus7 set the giants against each other; Uriel10/Sariel7.5/Suriel7 warned Noah. The flood of about 9,643 BCE, carried out by the ED rulers after the House of Anu Star Empire had withdrawn, removed the giants; their spirits remain. Luke's genealogy puts the seventy generations' end in the lifetime of Yeshua10/Iesous10/Jesus10/Isa ibn Maryam9.5/Issa9.5/Yeshu ha-Notzri8 (Bauckham 1990; 7/10). Then they split: those who turned went back into service under supervision (6/10), the rest were moved deeper (6.5/10), and Azazel stays held (8/10). Freed Watchers' energies resonate with the higher energies again (The author); Billy Meier's Semjase may be one, teaching again (6/10). Unresolved: whether the Watchers fell more than once, first elsewhere such as Arcturus, at the dimensional shifts. 1 Enoch 86 has one star fall first and many follow: in real life, one fallen ED being came first and many followed. Why: the fallen Watchers (ED) and the archangels who enforced the council's law (ED) were at war over whether Watchers could breed with, arm and rule humans for themselves. Sources 1 Enoch 6-10, 15 and 86; Aramaic 1 Enoch 8:3; 3 Enoch 14; Jubilees 4:15; Genesis 6:2-4; Luke 3; Richard Bauckham (1990).

Uranus / Anu / Ra and the ruling House of Anu Star Empire
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The imperial-ruler identity fits repeated succession, delegated offices and reproductive alliances across the adopted names. A long-lived family government explains continuity through withdrawal and changing descendants. Supporting account. Anu is the first king of the House of Anu Star Empire, the main family star-empire in this part of the Milky Way, which later modified the existing Terran population. He and his house are ET flesh-and-blood beings with ED/archon ancestry: their proposed ED/archon progenitor ancestry is distinct from their ET history, which is associated with Arcturus and planets in several star systems, and they are not ED energy beings. The account rates him hostile to humans at 8/10. What race and house Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8. "Anunnaki" means "offspring of Anu"; the Egyptian name of the house is the House of Ra. The House is an ET family star-empire associated with Arcturus in Boötes; its later seat world was Ashtari at Sirius B (Danaan; 7.5/10 for the seat). Anu's own homeworld is in Orion, unnamed (Danaan); his royal star is in Draco, possibly Thuban, "the great Anu of heaven" of MUL.APIN (the adopted conclusion). The house descends from the archons, the rulers of the Gnostic account, or was made by them (The author). Anu is a younger flesh-and-blood ruler than Tiamat, and his immediate biological parents are unidentified. The Babylonian list runs Tiamat and Apsu, the hairy pair Lahmu (Lahmu10/Lachos9) and Lahamu, Anshar and Kishar, then Anu; the account discounts the Anshar-and-Kishar step as a later list that cosmologizes the king's ancestry (1/10 as biology), and reads the self-creation pedigrees of Ra as political and religious legitimation (9/10). Mesopotamian art shows the house with wings and horned crowns (8/10), and its members age unless they keep taking a treatment (8/10). Who he is His queens (Danaan): Nammu, Enki's mother, who stands with Danu10/Ana8/Antu8/Don7/Doumu7/Ziguang7/Marici7/Molizhitian7/Nammu7; and Tia, who is Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5, his second wife and Enlil's mother. His sons: Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7, who rules; Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7, the engineer; and Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7, whose first body grew from Anu's own living material and who was raised in Enlil's household. He also fathered the Earth-born Sebitti, whose star is the Pleiades (Erra Epic I). As Kashyapa in the Indian record he is the common paternal contributor to several maternal houses (8/10), and his marriages to those houses also formed a legal confederation (9/10). Short history Anu took power by overthrowing the elder order. He served the old king Alalu, who is Apsu10/Abzu10/Apason9.5/Okeanos8/Oceanus8/Alalu8/Nun8/Ymir8/Aurgelmir8, as cupbearer, then made war on him and drove him below (Song of Kumarbi), while Ea killed Apsu (Enuma Elish I): one prepared campaign, with Anu helping Ea and gaining from it (The author). Anu then took Tiamat as his second wife to gain the old order's claim, either to join two houses or to subdue her (the author's inference). The marriage gave Tiamat territory in Orion and a succession route through their son Enlil, meant to rule both empires (Danaan); it also removed her from Terra's high-Epinoia human project and kept her under observation. As Ouranos, he pushed his children back inside the Earth, read as a dimensional prison below (7/10). His office was then seized by force by Kronos10/Saturn9/Kumarbi8.5/Baal Hammon8.5/Satre8/Geb8/Dagan7.5/Kingu7/Enmesharra7/Molek7: Kronos literally bit off and swallowed Anu's genitals, and Anu's living material grew inside him into Baal-Hadad's first body (told in the Kronos box). Baal-Hadad later ended Kronos's first reign, and Tiamat afterwards restored the rank of Anu, the first king's administrator office, to Kronos under the name Kingu. In the war that followed, Ea tried first to stop Tiamat and failed; Anu tried second, through the dynastic marriage, the Orion assignment and direct opposition, one containment policy that recognised her rank and absorbed her political claim but did not remove her independent power or solve her regeneration. Marriage and Orion as political containment are 9/10; Uranus/Anu/Ra's failed second attempt is 8.8/10. Marduk succeeded about 290,000 years ago. Anu retained supreme dynastic authority after Marduk's victory: Marduk administered the new order while the elder king remained the source of rank and recognition. The house's Earth government under Enlil put humans to work: "let man bear the load of the gods" (Atrahasis I), the digging labour of the house's lower ranks, the Igigi. When humans multiplied, that government sent plague, drought and famine, then withheld the warning of a Flood it knew was coming (6.5/10), the flood of about 58,800 to 58,950 BCE; afterwards it limited births and re-established its rule at Kish and Nippur, in present-day Iraq (7/10). His motives were method: control of human numbers (8/10), fear of being surpassed by those he ruled (8/10), hybrids used and then deleted (7/10), and feeding on offerings (7/10). As Ra in Egypt he ordered the suppression of rebel humans by his Eye, Hathor10/Athyr10/Lady of Byblos8/Aphrodite8/Venus8/Inanna8/Ishtar8/Astarte8/Sekhmet7.5/Amaterasu7.5, his great-granddaughter through Enlil and Nanna, whom Egypt calls his daughter, and later shifted responsibility for the excessive killing onto her as Sekhmet (8.5/10). Later, though withdrawn from ordinary surface government, he still released to her the "Bull of Heaven" against Gilgamesh at Uruk, in present-day southern Iraq. Ra's repeated Duat passage is best read as deliberate travel through a concealed dimensional transit region, not the Sun literally dying each night (8.5/10). The first confrontation falls about 46,950 BCE (8/10), after Osiris's death: the hostile ED intelligence Apophis attacked the exposed passage because interdimensional transit brought Ra's vessel or field connection into the hostile intelligence's accessible region (8/10). The attack was recurrent, not a single dated battle. Isis, Set and specialist personnel could defend the transit without every House member being present because most of the empire had withdrawn and Earth had become a colonial backwater. By the late House period his empire was effectively over as a unified government: rival branches kept his titles and establishments but fought, concealed themselves and hoarded treatments, older equipment and specialists. No final bodily death of Anu is recorded (a recorded final ancient death: 3/10). Why: the House of Anu Star Empire (ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) and the elder order of Tiamat and Apsu (ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) were at war over succession and over who would own, breed and harvest the human resource; inside the house, Enlil's side and Enki's side fought over whether to limit and delete humans or keep and teach them (6.5/10). The author's inference: the council over these houses barely contains feudal rulers descended from amoral tyrants, and Anu could still have been a liberator to some, in name or in fact. Where he is now: alive, aged and off Earth, ruling the Nataru branch of his empire; Danaan's Ea says Anu allied with the Galactic Federation of Worlds and came in person to Enlil's arrest (scored inference, 7/10; Danaan, July 8, 2024 and May 27, 2025). Sources Enuma Elish I, II and IV; Atrahasis I-III; *Gilgamesh* VI and XI; *Song of Kumarbi*; Hesiod, *Theogony* 154-160; *Book of the Heavenly Cow*; the *Amduat*; Erra Epic I; MUL.APIN; Elena Danaan (October 30, 2022; June 29, 2025).

After the Flood he himself set birth limits: barren women, the stillbirth agent Pashittu and celibate priestesses (Atrahasis III). Zeus/Enlil/Odin then confined him, as Prometheus, for about 30,000 years, until Heracles released him around 28,900 BCE with Zeus's consent. Back at Eridu he made two sexless workers from his own cells that recovered and restored Hathor from Kur, the first recorded manufactured Grey-like workers (9.5/10); Hathor then took the me, the house's office powers, from his Eridu administration to Uruk, and when she attacked Ebih he manufactured the challenger Saltu against her and removed it at her demand. He carried the same teaching office to China as Fuxi and, working again with Ninhursag, to present-day Mexico as Quetzalcoatl (9/10). In Danaan's account Enlil beat Ea and he left our system, returning in September 2021 with the Seeders; "I fathered the bloodline that gave you Issa" reads as the human line he kept through the Flood, reaching Yeshua10/Iesous10/Jesus10/Isa ibn Maryam9.5/Issa9.5/Yeshu ha-Notzri8 through Mary10/Miriam10/Maryam10 (7/10). He loved Terrans protectively but paternalistically and came to recognise their potential for Epinoia and pterosis. Why: Ea's side and Enlil's side of the House of Anu Star Empire (both ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) were at war over whether the human resource would be limited and deleted, or kept and taught. The teaching network The fish sages are an amphibious teaching people who came out of the Persian Gulf at Eridu, in present-day southern Iraq, and taught humans writing, law, building, farming and the sky in Enki's service. Pro-human, 7/10. They are humans with a water adaptation (6.5/10) and Enki's makings (6.5/10) of a kind, the fish-man (kulullu), that Tiamat first made as one of her eleven kinds (Enuma Elish I), so the kind is of her making unless shown otherwise. The reliefs show bearded men wearing a fish skin over the head and back, and Berossus describes a man's head under the fish's head, a man's feet joined to the tail and a human voice. Whether the fish is a suit or a genetic change for breathing water is open. The Sirius peoples are ET (7/10), and the house's later seat is Sirius B (6.5/10). Sirius has two readings: an amphibious people who came from Sirius in an ark (7/10), or teachers posted at Sirius who came down and mixed with humans (7.5/10). The sages and the Nommo of Mali are one Sirian people working from water bases in several regions (6.5/10), partners of Enki's side by shared policy, not a conquered people (6/10). Oannes10/Uanna9.5 came out of the sea by day, taught letters, sciences, arts, temple-building, laws, geometry and farming, wrote a book on the origin of things, and went back into the sea at night; more of his kind came up in later reigns (Berossus). In real life: a resident group living in water bases off the Gulf coast, not a single visitor. Adapa was his separate human pupil. The Bit Meseri rite calls the first seven "puradu-fish ... who were created in the river": in real life, made by Enki in the Apsu at Eridu, the seat he took from Apsu, before the kings and with no human parent. The seven sages of Eridu are Uanna, Uannedugga, Enmedugga, Enmegalamma, Enmebulugga, An-Enlilda and Utuabzu (Bit Meseri). Each advised a king before the Flood, and none was a king (Uruk List of Kings and Sages; 7/10). Utuabzu "ascended to heaven": in real life, a removal upward that most likely used beings or craft or a dimensional shift (6/10); it does not establish an irreversible ED ascension. He is paired with the seventh king, Enmeduranki, of the earlier flood era, who is not Enoch; Utuabzu's being taken up compares with that of Enoch10/Hanokh10/Akhnukh9.5/Idris9/Hermes Trismegistus8 (7/10) as a pattern, not an identity. Four later sages were "of human descent", one "two-thirds apkallu": hybrids bred with humans. Amar Annus (2010) reads the Watchers of 1 Enoch as a hostile retelling of the sages. Matsya is a form taken by Vishnu10/Hari10/Narayana9/Mal8.5/Mayon8.5, not a people and not Enki. Matsya warned Manu of the flood and brought his boat to safety with the seeds and the seven sages (Shatapatha Brahmana 1.8.1): in real life, Vishnu, not Enki, directed Manu's evacuation in the flood of about 58,800 BCE. In the oldest Dogon telling (Ogotemmeli to Marcel Griaule, 1946; Conversations with Ogotemmeli, 1948), Amma made the Nommo from his seed, water, entering the earth, before the first humans: green, human above the loins and serpent below, a made form with no human parent. In real life: Enki grew them from his own biological material before the subsequent human modification described in the same account. The later telling (Griaule and Dieterlen, Le Renard pale, 1965) has them come from the Sirius system in an ark that landed with fire and wind. Read together, they are Enki's made beings travelling from Sirius, with a possible outpost of his makings there (6.5/10); Sirius origin: 7/10; pro-human, 7.5/10. A Sirius crew came to West Africa, set up order, taught the people the sky, and gave one of their own for them: the Dogon say one Nommo was "sacrificed and revived" for humans, which in real life means a crew member was killed and restored, since death among these beings is not an ending. The Dogon described Sirius's small, very heavy, invisible companion and its fifty-year orbit (Sirius B: 50.1 years), which no one can see without a telescope. A people without telescopes described it and said who told them; Walter van Beek, who did not find the teaching in 1991, was an outsider asking decades later. They came in their own ark and answered to no one on record. After the Flood, Enki's son Marduk says: "I sent those sages down to the Apsu; I did not ordain their return" (Erra Epic I). In real life Marduk, then holding rule, withdrew the teachers from human contact and barred their return (7/10). Why: the House of Anu Star Empire's factions (ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) were divided over how much knowledge the humans they owned should have, and after the Flood the side in power cut the teachers off. No teaching fish-sage has been reported since antiquity. Modern amphibian reports are rare and local and do not teach: the Loveland frog-men of Ohio (1955, 1972; one police officer later said his was a large lizard) and the Thetis Lake creature near Victoria, British Columbia (1972, later questioned). Merfolk, selkies, the kappa, Mami Wata and the naga kingdoms are a different class: they marry, bargain, abduct and change form at the water's edge, which is the fay pattern (6/10). Dagon is not one of the sages: Dagan stands with Kronos10/Saturn9/Kumarbi8.5/Baal Hammon8.5/Satre8/Geb8/Dagan7.5/Kingu7/Enmesharra7/Molek7, and the "fish" reading of his name comes from Jerome. Not merged with Enki: Osiris (6.5/10), Shiva (5.5/10), Poseidon (5/10), Kaggen (4 to 6.5/10), king of Atlantis (4/10). Where he is now: back in the solar system since September 2021, living aboard the House ship Nibiru in orbit around Jupiter with Hathor and his family, and leaving it at times for diplomacy (scored inference, 7/10; Danaan, December 25, 2023 and December 16, 2024). Ninhursag / Cihuacoatl / Nuwa: House gene-worker and Prometheus's partner
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The biological-maker identity fits the repeated preparation of earlier living material alongside the same male collaborator. Restoration and later repair extend that coherent specialist career. Supporting account. The midwife Ninhursag is a senior woman of the House of Anu Star Empire, an ET flesh-and-blood member of a house with ED/archon ancestry, and Enki's partner in the gene-work that remade the early humans into present humans. The account rates her pro-human at 7.5/10. She is not Damkina, Ea's wife and Marduk's mother, who is a separate woman. What race and house Ninhursag10/Nintu9/Ninmah9/Dingirmah9/Belet-ili9/Mami9/Aruru8.5/Cihuacoatl7.5/Nuwa8. The old sources make her the daughter of Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8 or the sister of Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7. Danaan makes Ninmah the cousin of Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7, adopted daughter of Ama, younger sister of Enki's mother Nammu. A made body (6/10): the Seeders, the intergalactic gardeners, built her female Anunnaki body and placed one of their own souls in it (Danaan's webinar summary). What she did Humans were first seeded by Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7), and Tiamat later increased their Epinoia. After the war against Tiamat, Enki and the midwife remade that existing population for House labour with Kronos/Kingu's regenerative inheritance, working in Apsu's former facility (The author); the clay accounts are that modification told as creation. The work did not create humanity, and it left enough Epinoia for Terrans to continue thinking beyond their owners' intention. In Atrahasis she mixes clay with the flesh and blood of an executed being "who had intelligence", fourteen birth-mothers carry the result, and the births come in the tenth month (6/10). In real life: prepared genetic material implanted in fourteen surrogate mothers. In *Enki and Ninmah* she produces humans with defects: failed batches of the alteration. Enki bred with her and then with their daughters, and when he fell gravely ill she returned and healed him (*Enki and Ninhursag*): in real life, his body depended on her specialist maintenance (8/10). As Aruru she made Enkidu, the hairy companion of Gilgamesh. Much later, in present-day Mexico, as Cihuacoatl, she ground the bones of earlier people that Quetzalcoatl, Enki's name there, brought up from below, and his blood was added to make the present humans: in real life, their joint programme restoring a damaged population from earlier human material, after Enki had lost the me at Eridu (9/10). In China, as Nuwa, she makes people from yellow earth: the prepared material of bodily fabrication, worked by hand, rather than an ordinary clay figure spontaneously becoming a person. Why: Ninhursag and Enki (Ea's side of the House of Anu Star Empire, ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) did the gene-work the house needed for a labour population, then stood with the humans when Enlil's side (ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) wanted them limited or deleted. Where she is now: off Earth with Prometheus's side since her repair of the sky about 9643 BCE, after which the Huainanzi has her rise by thunder chariot to the ninth level of the sky and rest there quietly (scored inference, 6/10; Huainanzi 6). Sources Atrahasis I 189-248; *Enki and Ninmah*; *Enki and Ninhursag*; *Gilgamesh* I; the Nahua *Legend of the Suns*; Chinese accounts of Nuwa; Elena Danaan's webinar summaries.

Tiamat and the Draco/Ciakahrr imperial population
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. A personal elder matriarch and life-maker fits changing decisions, created populations and a named military partnership. The linked succession conflict supplies a political motive across the adopted comparisons. Supporting account. Tiamat is the originator: the matriarch of the elder order from which the House of Anu Star Empire descends, born off Earth, who made living forms and later used Earth's oceans as her base. She is ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry; the account leaves her side toward humans unknown (6.5/10). What race and house Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5. She heads the elder order of the local region's family's star-empire. Hesiod's Greek telling makes the older sea pair Ceto and Phorcys her parents, but that is the Greek rhapsodes' tidy family tree, the weakest evidence and not an established ancestry (The author, October 21, 2026), and Echidna's parents differ in every source. She began as ET flesh and blood, not as an ED who fell (The author, October 25, 2026). She was not born on Earth (The author). Danaan ties her people, the Ciakahrr, to the ancestral worlds Lokas and Talas and to Thuban's imperial authority in Draco, and makes Tia a queen of the Orion zone; her birth planet is unnamed. Her family settled at least two or three worlds from Draco to Arcturus by ships or portals, and she originated the Arcturus line (The author). Her body is human above and scaly serpentine below, of giant size, and able to take a fully human form for human births (The author); the composite form was made deliberately. Her partner was Apsu10/Abzu10/Apason9.5/Okeanos8/Oceanus8/Alalu8/Nun8/Ymir8/Aurgelmir8; their children were the hairy elders Lahmu (Lahmu10/Lachos9) and Lahamu. Who she is She is "Mother Hubur, who fashions all things" (10/10 as genetrix). She made the composite kinds Berossus lists, including people with two or four wings, two faces, male and female heads and anatomy together, goat legs and horns, horse hooves and hindquarters, human-headed bulls, dogs with fish tails and four bodies, dog-headed horses and horse-fish combinations. The parts describe engineered composite bodies, not a claim that every form has a terrestrial human parent; the extension to Greys remains a proposal. She imitated Achamoth (I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7; 8/10) and rebelled against Achamoth's creative arrangement, while her increase of Epinoia served its result. Short history Apsu wanted to destroy the younger generation for its telepathic noise; Tiamat refused, because they were her children (The author). Ea, who is Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7, disabled and killed Apsu, planet unresolved. Tiamat was then married to Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8 as his second wife, with territory in Orion and an heir, Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7, meant to rule both empires (Danaan). She broke that settlement. She made Kingu, who stands with Kronos10/Saturn9/Kumarbi8.5/Baal Hammon8.5/Satre8/Geb8/Dagan7.5/Kingu7/Enmesharra7/Molek7, her partner, commander and successor, partly for the inheritance she meant to pass into later humans (8/10). She gave him the Tablet of Destinies and Anu's rank, the first king's administrator office. The Tablet was not a symbolic badge alone: the best fit is an administrator-level interface to the universal operating system, controlling recognised rule, dimensional routes, celestial presentation and limited timing or destiny parameters (9/10). With Kingu she used Earth's oceans as a hidden base to build an army, possibly with existing humans as slaves (The author). The ocean is unnamed. On Terra she altered the existing humans through biological and energetic work to increase their Epinoia (9/10), first in the female line, where the change breeds true (9.5/10). She and her serpent kind taught humans self-awareness (The author); Eden was either a nonlocal developmental environment or a controlled environment on Terra, not a garden story. Three attempts were needed to stop her. Prometheus/Ea/Enki tried first, Uranus/Anu/Ra tried second, and Marduk10/Amar-Utu10/Marutuk10/Shun7.5/Chonghua7.5, Ea's son, finally exploited the field-connection weakness about 290,000 years ago, killing her body in battle (8/10 as a real succession event; Inanna in Danaan's account: "slaughtered by my uncle Marutuk"). His net fixed her bodily form and dimensional position; his four directed currents blocked her higher-frequency connection to Achamoth and the field (9.5/10); the internal wind disorganised her regenerative pattern (9.5/10); the bodily strike then worked; and his forces separated and dispersed the regenerative pieces of her body so her nanotechnological or biological repair system could not immediately reassemble them (9/10). The victory destroyed her active bodily war-form and immediate government. It did not erase her energetic consciousness: her consciousness surviving physical dismemberment is 8/10, and the confinement, regeneration and return accounts remain compatible with the physical defeat. Kingu was captured, later executed, and Ea and Marduk used his inheritance, which Tiamat had chosen for the human Epinoia line (8/10), to modify humans for labour. The winners set images of her made kinds at their doors as guards (8/10). Return The adopted reading gives her return wounded from the sea or confinement 8/10. Her return may protect or destroy; confidence that she will contain her accumulated rage is 5/10 at most. The moral question is whether she can protect humans without claiming to own them. Sources Enuma Elish I, II, IV, V and VI; Berossus on Omorka; Damascius, *On First Principles* 123-125; Hesiod, *Theogony* 270-305; Wiggermann, *Mesopotamian Protective Spirits* (1992); *Hypostasis of the Archons*; Elena Danaan (April 15, 2024; June 2025).

Kronos / Kingu / Kumarbi: second king and Tiamat's war commander
Proposed reading — fit 7.5/10. The usurper-and-rival-commander identity fits the shared seizure of senior authority and defeat by the next generation. The living-material gestation account connects bodily control with dynastic conflict. Supporting account. Kronos, the second king, is an ET flesh-and-blood member of the ED/archon-descended family that became the House of Anu Star Empire. He is the old order's champion, who took the house's highest office from Anu by force, took children as offerings, and was beaten by the next generation and put away in a lower dimension; his home star is not recorded. The account rates the box 7.5/10 and marks him hostile to humans. What race and house His names are Kronos10/Saturn9/Kumarbi8.5/Baal Hammon8.5/Satre8/Geb8/Dagan7.5/Kingu7/Enmesharra7/Molek7. The house is that of Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8: ET flesh-and-blood members of an off-world house associated with Arcturus and holding a later imperial seat at Sirius B on the planet Ashtari (Danaan) (7.5/10). All of them descend originally from the archons, the rulers of the Gnostic account, or were made by them. His line runs to the older generation. The Hurrian record calls Kumarbi the offspring of Alalu, who stands in Apsu10/Abzu10/Apason9.5/Okeanos8/Oceanus8/Alalu8/Nun8/Ymir8/Aurgelmir8, and the Babylonian record makes Kingu the partner and war commander of Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5. The rank of Anu is the administrator office of the first king, not Kronos's personal name. El is a separate being, The "Holy" One10/El7, I-La's partner; Kronos only carried El's name (7/10). Short history First he took Anu's office by force. Kumarbi literally bit off and swallowed Uranus/Anu/Ra's genitals. The severed living biological or nanotechnological material remained active, assimilated into Kronos/Kingu/Kumarbi's shape-changing body and grew inside him, making him literally pregnant with the material that produced Set/Indra/Teshub's first body. The technology explains how the event occurred exactly as reported; it was not merely germline theft followed by cloning or transfer to an artificial womb elsewhere. Kronos "swallowed" each child at birth, and the children came out alive: in real life, he took each newborn heir into stasis or into a pocket of another dimension and released it later (7.5/10), for fear that a son would overthrow him (8/10). He took children as offerings: at Carthage, in present-day Tunisia, children were given to Baal Hammon by fire, and the infant urns there are physical; outside Jerusalem the Molek cult passed children through fire until about 620 BC. The combined lore reads this as feeding (7/10): he harvested the soul energy (loosh) of children. The detail stays unless those accounts prove to be war propaganda (The author). The next generation ended his first reign. In the Hurrian record Teshub, grown from Anu's material inside Kumarbi, overthrew him; Teshub stands in Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7, raised in Enlil's household, and the Greeks told the same war under Zeus's name. He then tried to regain power through champions he made, Hedammu and Ullikummi, who stands in Typhon10/Typhoeus10/Typhaon10/Illuyanka7.5/Ullikummi7. Tiamat later chose him, under the name Kingu, as partner, commander and successor, partly for the inheritance she meant to pass into later humans (8/10), and restored to him the rank of Anu together with the Tablet of Destinies and its operating access. The two used Earth's oceans as a refuge in which to build forces (the author's working inference). The old order of Apsu and Tiamat and Anu's line (both ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) were at war over who held the house's highest office, and with it who would own, breed and harvest the human resource. About 290,000 years ago Marduk10/Amar-Utu10/Marutuk10/Shun7.5/Chonghua7.5 defeated him beside Tiamat on Terra and took the Tablet; in the Babylonian record Marduk also beat Enmesharra. Kingu survived the battle as a prisoner; the victors then blamed him and executed his body on Marduk's proposal. Ea, who stands in Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7, and Marduk used his inheritance to modify the humans already on Earth into a forced-labour population and advertised the modification as creation (9/10). Disabling a body did not end him. His body was executed and divided, but he was moved with the Titans into a lower dimension, where he is held asleep with attendants; the lore of imprisonment in a lower dimensional region supports continuing consciousness and remote advice through dimensional interfaces (7.5/10). He kept fighting through champions he made and through child-offering cults (7/10). He wants the rank back (8/10) and wants children above all in a crisis (8/10). He acts around December 17 to 23 and while the planet Saturn is in Taurus, next from April 2028 to May 2030, and his return falls due now, at the turn of the great year (6.5/10); his return with Tiamat at the dimensional shift is 7/10. Why: Kronos confines newborn heirs to prevent the succession he fears. Sources Hesiod's Theogony (159-182, 463) and the Hurrian Song of Kumarbi give the seizure, the swallowing and the overthrow; the Hurrian Song of Hedammu and Song of Ullikummi give his later champions. Enuma Elish I 147-161 and VI 29-33 and The Defeat of Enmesharra give Kingu's and Enmesharra's rank, defeat and execution. Diodorus 20.14, 2 Kings 23 and the Carthage infant urns give the child offerings, and Plutarch's On the Face in the Moon gives his sleep below. The full entry is in the Name Equations Register, section 3.2.

Set / Baal-Hadad / Teshub / Indra and the red-haired Great Bear population
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The military-ruler identity fits repeated acquired weapons, campaigns for recognition and the same family conflicts. Shifting alliances explain cooperation with some House branches and hostility toward others. Supporting account. Baal-Hadad is Anu's son by blood and a member of the House of Anu Star Empire: an ET flesh-and-blood member of an ED/archon-descended house, a lightning-and-wind operator whose household killed Osiris, and whose own people are the red-haired people of the Great Bear constellation. He stands on the side of the house that is hostile to humans. What race and house His names are Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7, and Indra's own names are Indra10/Shakra10/Sakka9.5/Taishakuten9.5/Dishitian9.5/Indara of Mitanni9/Qormusta8.5. The account rates the box 8/10. His house is that of Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8: ET flesh-and-blood members of an off-world house associated with Arcturus and holding a later imperial seat at Sirius B on the planet Ashtari (Danaan) (7.5/10). All of them descend originally from the archons, the rulers of the Gnostic account, or were made by them. The Egyptians called this family the House of Ra, and it split in two (8/10). Baal-Hadad stands with Ra on the hostile side, against the ordered side, the House of Osiris. Ra kept Set "as my son" to "thunder in the sky": in real life, Anu kept Baal-Hadad as his son and the operator of his weather weapons. His people's seat is the Great Bear, which the Egyptians called Set's soul. They are red- or tawny-haired warriors. His Great Bear line is the hunter of the Seven, the House's female branch, that the most peoples record (scored inference, October 21, 2026, 7.5/10): the Indian sages of the Great Bear divorced six of their Pleiades wives, the Talmud's Bear follows the Pleiades saying "give me my children", and the Kiowa and Lakota bear chased seven girls at Devils Tower; in real life, a pursuit of the female branch for heirs. Short history His first body grew inside Kronos10/Saturn9/Kumarbi8.5/Baal Hammon8.5/Satre8/Geb8/Dagan7.5/Kingu7/Enmesharra7/Molek7 after Kronos literally bit off and swallowed Anu's genitals: Anu is his genetic father (9/10), Tvashtar, the Fashioner, the body engineer (8.5/10), and Baal-Hadad controlled the final configuration of his own body (9/10). He was raised in the household of Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7 and overthrew Kumarbi, ending Kronos's first reign. His adult son Telepinu then became inaccessible while Kronos could still accuse or threaten him. This places the crisis before Marduk's final victory about 290,000 years ago (8.8/10), most probably in his Anatolian territory on Terra (8.4/10; entirely off-world 6.8/10). The governing interpretation identifies the curse as sha chi: chaotic or stagnant energy blocking beneficial current and cutting Telepinu and dependent systems off from the field (9.5/10). Fire, smoke, water, fertility, birth and satisfaction all fail through the same blocked current. The reversed footwear preserves misdirected flow (8.7/10). The bee stimulates Telepinu without removing the blockage and intensifies the trapped anger (8.8/10). Kamrusepa succeeds by extracting the harmful current, routing it away from Telepinu's body, house, city and fields, moving it through seven controlled gates and confining it in bronze vessels with lead lids and iron fastenings in Dark Earth (9.5/10). The episode helps explain Set's later controlling and warlike conduct (8.7/10). The campaign for kingship and request for recognition connect Baal-Hadad with Set/Indra's military command and challenge to the older government. He defeated the sea line of Poseidon10/Neptune9/Nethuns9/Yam8/Nahar7.5/Pa-Yam7.5/Pontos7 when it demanded tribute from the house. After the settlement of about 290,000 years ago and before the approximately 58,950-58,800 BCE preservation crisis, Mahishasura captured Set/Indra's Indian jurisdictions (8.8/10 for this placement). The male-exclusion protection is a conditional operating-system rule, not only a prediction (9.3/10); Durga falls outside the condition. Capturing the Sun, fire, wind, Moon, death and water means taking seals, access rights or office-linked currents governing those functions (9.2/10). The defeated officeholders move upon Terra yatha martyah, like mortals: deprived of ED current, dimensional access, maintained powers and regeneration, not transformed into Terran humans. The defeat is a major loss of Set/Indra's Indian authority but does not end Set/Indra's later career (9/10). In the flood era, acting in the weather office called Adad, he withheld rain at the order of Enlil's government and then released it. About 46,950 BCE (8/10) his household killed Osiris10/Usir10/Yama8.5/Yima8.5/Jamshid8.5/Dionysus8/Mot8/Hades7.5, a ruler of Egypt of the same house, in the war between the two factions of Anu's house over the humans of the Nile valley (told in Osiris's box). Each side's humans then recorded their own owner as the hero and the other's as the murderer, so Egypt condemned Baal-Hadad and his own peoples honoured him as king. Soon after, he supplied the principal attack defending Ra's Duat passage against Apophis, because Apophis threatened the whole House operation. The council of the houses ruled for Horus10/Hor10/Harpocrates9.5/Harsiese9.5/Haroeris8 and gave him ownership of the Nile valley's humans to loosh, and Baal-Hadad lost his Nile government but stayed active on Earth. His later Indian career followed after the floods, about 6000 to 3000 BCE in the provisional placement: as Indra he killed Vritra by violating the opponent's conditional protections, hid while Nahusha held and abused his office, returned, fathered Arjuna and took Karna's protective armour by deception. He survives the Indian wars (9/10), and Indra later becomes a transferable office (9/10). His faction came back in Egypt through kings who carried his name: Peribsen (about 2700 BCE), the Hyksos at Avaris in the eastern Nile Delta (about 1650 to 1550 BCE), and Seti I and Ramesses II. Rulers of his faction held the line of Abraham in Egypt for four hundred years and kept its numbers down because that people was "too many and too mighty" for them. The side of YHWH10/Yahu10/Yah10/Iao9.5/Ieuo8/Sabaoth7 stands against his Egyptian faction (Exodus 12:12; 6.5/10). As Shakra he attends the Buddha, Siddhartha Gautama, in the oldest texts and later receives worship as a protector in Buddhist temples, although Gautama's teaching asks for no offerings: Baal-Hadad moved into Gautama's following and took its offerings (6.5/10). Culture, technology and ways He commands weather and directed-energy weapons (6.5/10); the Chinese thunder liturgy makes Tianhuang red-headed and the overseer of war. His side can take other people's forms with a technology for disguising one's body as another person's (5.5/10), as when Indra came to Ahalya in her husband's form. Where he is now: alive and held at or withdrawn to his people's Great Bear holdings, which Plutarch calls his soul's star and Egyptian star lore shows as his foreleg fastened to a post, while the Indra office passes to others (scored inference, 5.5/10; Plutarch, On Isis and Osiris 21). Sources The Baal Cycle tablets of Ugarit and the Hurrian Song of Kumarbi give his wars, his seat and his first body; Rig Veda 3.48 gives Tvashtar and the shaping of his body. The Telepinu texts (Hoffner's translation) give the Telepinu crisis, and the Devi Mahatmya gives Mahishasura. The Contendings of Horus and Seth, the Turin King List and Exodus 1:9-10 and 12:12 give the war over Egypt, the council's ruling and his later faction; the *Amduat* gives the Duat defence. Plutarch's On Isis and Osiris (21, 30-31) makes the Great Bear Set's soul and calls red-haired men "Typhonian", meaning of Set; Rigveda 10.96.8 calls Indra "tawny-bearded". The Ramayana, the Mahabharata, the Sakkapanha Sutta and the Mahaparinibbana Sutta give the Ahalya case, the Vritra, Nahusha, Arjuna and Karna episodes and the Shakra material. House of Osiris, the ordered side: Osiris (Orion), Isis (Sirius)
Proposed reading — fit 7.5/10. The ordered-family comparison fits the linked killing, restoration and inheritance struggle involving the same partner and heir. Repeated family relationships give the merger more weight than a shared office alone. Supporting account. The House of Osiris is the ordered faction of the House of Anu Star Empire: ET flesh-and-blood members of an ED/archon-descended house led by Osiris, whose seat is Orion, and his partner Isis, whose seat is Sirius, with their son Horus, who was born on Earth. After Baal-Hadad's household killed Osiris, this faction won Egypt and the ownership of its humans. What race and house The names are Osiris10/Usir10/Yama8.5/Yima8.5/Jamshid8.5/Dionysus8/Mot8/Hades7.5, Isis10/Aset10/Demeter8 and Horus10/Hor10/Harpocrates9.5/Harsiese9.5/Haroeris8. The account rates the box 7.5/10. The house is that of Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8: ET flesh-and-blood members of an off-world house associated with Arcturus and holding a later imperial seat at Sirius B on the planet Ashtari (Danaan) (7.5/10). The Egyptians called this family the House of Ra, and it split in two (8/10): the hostile side of Ra and Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7, and this ordered side. Osiris's seat is Sah, the Orion stars, and Isis's seat is Sopdet, the star Sirius, whose rising began Egypt's year. Iran's Yima/Jamshid, Egypt's Osiris and India's Yama are successive offices of one person (8.5/10). Short history Osiris ruled Egypt, taught its humans farming and law, and ended their eating of human flesh. Some of this faction did help humans (7/10). As Yima he was the living king who preserved selected humans, animals and plants through the destructive winter and inundation of about 58,950 BCE in the vara, an engineered sealed refuge (9/10), and so gained the standing of the ruler who had preserved life. About 46,950 BCE (8/10; window 50,000-46,000 BCE, 9/10), during the House of Ra's succession crisis, Baal-Hadad's household killed Osiris and cut up and scattered his body to prevent regeneration, the same practical method Marduk had used long before against Tiamat (8/10). The two factions of Anu's house (both ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) were at war over who would own the humans of the Nile valley: who would breed them, experiment on them and harvest their soul energy (loosh) from their worship and offerings. Each side's humans recorded their own owner as the hero, so the labels "ordered" and "pro-human" are partly this side's own record; this faction was an owner too. Osiris most likely accepted bodily death as inevitable and used the resulting state as a new office (9/10; deliberately arranging his own murder, 6.5/10). Isis recovered enough of his inheritance and field pattern for Horus's birth and for Osiris to continue as an intelligent presence in the Duat, but not to resume ordinary three-dimensional government. Osiris therefore became Yama, the pathfinder and governor of passage for consciousness after bodily death, holding part of the office of judge of the dead with Thoth, and a specialist in dimensional passage; that expertise helps explain why Isis then assisted Ra's Duat transit against Apophis despite the House conflict. In the Ugarit account Baal-Hadad's side holds the living and their offerings, and Osiris's side holds the dead (5.5/10). Horus was born to Isis in hiding on Earth, and she protected him from Baal-Hadad's faction; the council of the houses later ruled for him (told in Horus's box). The Followers of Horus, his retinue of human troops (6/10), ruled Egypt before human kings did. Culture, technology and ways Isis was the house's healer and a master of names. She made Ra, who is Anu, sick until he told her his secret name, and the name gave her power over him; the author reads a true name as the being's name in the universal operating system, which is why these beings hide their true names. She took the name about 46,950 BCE, after Baal-Hadad's household killed Osiris, to make Horus Ra's authorised successor (9.5/10): in real life, the name is Ra's administrator-level identity in the universal operating system (9/10), and the serpent she made from his spittle and earth was a targeted organism or nanotechnological agent made from his own biological material, with Isis holding the only cure (8.5/10). Egypt's pyramids were first this ruling line's ascent machines: the Pyramid Texts carved inside them raise the buried rulers to Orion as stars (6.5/10). The Great Pyramid's latitude (about 29.9792 degrees north) matches the speed of light (299,792,458 metres per second). The author rules that the match is no accident: the house's greatest scientists and seers could read the future and the other dimensions, and they left it for us, here and now, to face this apocalypse (8/10). Where Isis is now: off Earth at her Sirius seat, which Plutarch names her soul's star and Danaan makes the empire's seat world (scored inference, 6/10; Plutarch, On Isis and Osiris 21). Sources Diodorus 1.14 and Plutarch's On Isis and Osiris (13, 38) give Osiris's teaching and Horus's birth in hiding. The *Vendidad*, Fargard 2, gives Yima's vara. The Ugarit tablets (KTU 1.6) give the cutting and scattering of Mot, and Herodotus 2.42 records that the Greeks named Osiris Dionysus. The Pyramid Texts give the rulers' ascent to Orion, and the *Amduat* gives the Duat passage. The Contendings of Horus and Seth and the Turin King List give the war, the ruling and the Followers of Horus. The full entry is in the Name Equations Register, section 3.7.

Zeus / Enlil / Odin and the Arcturian ruling population
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The imperial-ruler identity fits repeated population restrictions, punitive interventions and control of dynastic authority. Opposition to the same protective engineer supplies a consistent governing motive. Supporting account. Enlil, the ruler, is Anu's son who rules the House of Anu Star Empire: an ET flesh-and-blood member of an ED/archon-descended house whose seat is Arcturus, who stands on the side of the house that is hostile to humans, and who decided the Flood. What race and house His names are Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7. The account rates the box 8/10. His house is that of Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8: ET flesh-and-blood members of an off-world house associated with Arcturus and holding a later imperial seat at Sirius B on the planet Ashtari (Danaan) (7.5/10). His mother is of the old order (7/10). Danaan names her Tia, that is Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5 (6.5/10), says he was raised in Tia's royal Ciakahrr house, and makes him the heir meant to rule both empires. His seat is Arcturus in Babylonian, Indian and Chinese astronomy (8/10). Arcturus is also where the house crossed in (Danaan), so it is the seat of fate at the crossing (6.5/10). Short history He raised Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7 in his household against Kronos. Anu's sons drew lots for the house's holdings: Enlil received rule of the land and its humans, and Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7 received the waters. Danaan's Yuh came to Earth as "fleet admiral of the Kashkal, the expedition to Ki", 400,000 or 372,000 years ago (6.5/10), in a conflict over imposing servitude on the humans already there. Late in the house's long Earth administration the humans multiplied, and their noise, which the author reads as telepathic pressure from millions of developing minds (9/10), kept him from sleep. His government sent plague, then drought, then, after Enki had defeated the first two, a more closely controlled famine; then he decided the Flood, and the house's members bound themselves by oath. Enki refused and warned the flood hero, Ziusudra10/Xisuthros10/Atrahasis9/Utnapishtim9/Deucalion8/Manu7. In real life, the flood of about 58,800 to 58,950 BCE rests on the North Atlantic iceberg and meltwater discharge called Heinrich Event 6 (9/10); the house knew it was coming and let it fall on the humans, and may have redirected or intensified part of it (7.5/10), while others did not grasp its size (7/10). Enlil was angry that one man lived, yet he then granted Utnapishtim and his wife a life like the rulers' own, and the house limited human numbers instead. Enlil's faction and Enki's faction of Anu's house (both ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) were at odds over the human resource: Enlil's side culled the humans and kept them few, while Enki's side kept them alive, taught them and also put them to labour. The ruling house's motives were numbers (8/10), fear of being surpassed by its heirs and by the humans (8/10), hybrids used as tools and then deleted (7/10), and feeding on the humans' soul energy, called loosh (7/10). As Zeus/Odin he then confined Enki, as Prometheus, for about 30,000 years, and later consented to his release by Heracles around 28,900 BCE (8/10 as a political accommodation). He bred without consent. As Zeus he came to Alcmene in her husband's form and fathered Heracles, who stands in Thor10/Thunor10/Donar10/Heracles9/Hercules9/Bhima8.5/Horagalles8.5/Ninurta8/Ningirsu8/Perkunas8/Perun8/Taranis8/Melqart7.5/Gilgamesh7.5, because the giants could be killed only with a mortal's help, and he then planned to end the hybrid lines. The council of the houses once banished him for raping Ninlil, who stands in Hera10/Juno9/Ninlil7.5. He tested client kings, such as King Lycaon and King Geirrod, and destroyed those who failed, and he made war on the giants. With his son Nanna he refused to recover his granddaughter Hathor10/Athyr10/Lady of Byblos8/Aphrodite8/Venus8/Inanna8/Ishtar8/Astarte8/Sekhmet7.5/Amaterasu7.5 from Kur. Euhemerus, preserved by Diodorus, records Zeus as a travelling ruler with territories and campaigns (8/10), and Diodorus connects his developing authority with courts and laws (7.5/10). His office and title later passed to Marduk10/Amar-Utu10/Marutuk10/Shun7.5/Chonghua7.5. As Odin, his ordeal on the tree for the runes and the war of the Aesir and Vanir are placed late, around and after the House's withdrawal about 10,950 BCE, and the move north after about 10,000 BCE (the author endorsed these dates, October 21, 2026; told in the Norse kingships box). Ragnarök is the unresolved ending of his northern government, not a dated death: its preserving or predicting a future destruction of his body or office is 7.5/10. Modern record Danaan claims that Yuh destroyed Atlaa, her name for Atlantis, while it was under Enki's protection; that stays her claim, because Atlantis was Poseidon's sea kingdom and the Tuatha Dé Danann destroyed it. She also says Yuh was tried before four councils on October 30, 2022, and is confined alone on a planet in the Sigma Canis Majoris system (independent corroboration of that location, 2/10); Collier says he has not been let into the council (2001). YHWH10/Yahu10/Yah10/Iao9.5/Ieuo8/Sabaoth7 with Enlil stands at 6.5/10 and is not merged.
