Poseidon, the old order's sea lord
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The maritime-house ruler fits tribute demands, inherited authority and a continuing descendant population in the adopted account. The political conflict supplies a more specific connection than the water designation alone. Supporting account. Poseidon, the old order's sea lord, is an ET flesh-and-blood member of the ED/archon-descended family, by birth of the House of Anu Star Empire's family as the son of Kronos. He demanded tribute from the house, bred giants, founded and ruled warlike Atlantis, and was beaten by Baal-Hadad's side; his star is not recorded. What race and house His names are Poseidon10/Neptune9/Nethuns9/Yam8/Nahar7.5/Pa-Yam7.5/Pontos7. The account rates the box 8/10. The house is that of Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8: ET flesh-and-blood members of an off-world house associated with Arcturus, established on planets in several star systems and holding a later imperial seat at Sirius B on the planet Ashtari (Danaan) (7.5/10). He is the son of the second king, Kronos10/Saturn9/Kumarbi8.5/Baal Hammon8.5/Satre8/Geb8/Dagan7.5/Kingu7/Enmesharra7/Molek7, and by deed he stands with the old order. He is hostile to humans and not on the side of Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7; Enki and Poseidon as one being stands at only 5/10. Who he is He demanded tribute from the house's other members (KTU 1.2; the Egyptian Astarte Papyrus). He fathered giants on Earth: Polyphemus, Orion and the Aloadae. Size alone does not assign them to the UT category; the relevant distinction is their parentage. His son Orion hunted the Pleiades women, two of whom, Alcyone and Celaeno, were Poseidon's own partners (Ovid, Fasti 4.169-178). He founded and ruled Atlantis (7.5/10). The author, October 20, 2026: while the rest of the House fought elsewhere, Poseidon "has been siring giants and building Atlantis on the coast away from the action - building his defenses" (7.5/10). The record supports that reading. Poseidon drew the sea by lot (Iliad 15.187-193): in real life, the sea and coastlands fell to him in a division of territory among the House's members. He lost Athens to Athena10/Minerva9/Menrva9/Neith8.5/Anat7 and Argos to Hera10/Juno9/Ninlil7.5 (Apollodorus 3.14; Pausanias 2.15): in real life, two mainland cities went to rival members of the House. He ringed his hill with sea and land "so that it was impassable for men" (Critias 113d): in real life, a fortified island ringed by water-filled defences, built as a defence. He took the island by lot, fathered ten kings on a human woman, the eldest being Atlas10/Aril8.5/Upelluri7, and gave them laws on a pillar of orichalcum (Critias 113c). Atlas is one being: Poseidon's son, the father of the Pleiades and a Titan of the old order who fought Zeus, so the sea line and the old order meet in him. Atlantis was warlike and lay south of the Tuatha Dé Danann, near Spain (The author). The Fomorians' rulers are of his line (8/10). Their king Elatha came over the sea in a silver ship and, through his son Bres, took tribute from the Tuatha Dé Danann and put their senior leaders to forced labour (Cath Maige Tuired). The Fomorians were Poseidon's giants, not the Nephilim (7/10): in the Irish record the Fomorians were already in Ireland before Nemed's people came, while the Watchers came down about 10,506 BCE and the Nephilim were their children, so the Fomorians come first. Poseidon fathered the one-eyed giant Polyphemus, and the Fomorian Balor had one great eye: in real life, the same sea line's giant soldiers, remembered in Greece and Ireland by the same feature (6.5/10). The Fomorian rulers, Elatha and Bres, are described as very handsome: the giants were the soldiers. The children the Fomorians took each Samhain became soldiers and labourers (5.5/10), and the Second Battle of Mag Tuired gathers the Fomorian army "from Lochlann westward": in real life, troops raised from allied islands (5/10). The Irish record puts the Fomorian homeland in the north (Lochlann and Tory Island, off County Donegal in north-west Ireland) while Atlantis lay near Spain: the sea kingdom held outposts along the whole Atlantic edge, as Plato says Atlantis ruled many islands (6/10). Pontos is among Poseidon's names. Hesiod puts Pontus in an elder sea line (Gaia and Pontus, then Ceto and Phorcys, then Echidna, who stands with Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5), but that line is the Greek rhapsodes' tidy family tree, the weakest evidence: it grouped the sea powers together by theme, not by birth, and it does not break the name (The author, October 21, 2026). Poseidon is not Tiamat's ancestor: he is Kronos's son, and Tiamat is older. The sea-born Gorgons and Graeae, Phorcys's children only in that weak tree, connect to the Fomorians by form and deed (6.5/10). On deeds, Poseidon took command of the composite sea forces Tiamat left after her defeat: in the Baal poems Lotan and Tunnan serve Yam, in real life engineered composite fighting beings under his command, and composite beings are Tiamat's making (The author, October 3, 2026). So his giants and sea creatures continued Tiamat's side of the war from his fortified coast (6.5/10). Short history Poseidon's sea line (the old order, ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) and the side of Anu's house led by Baal-Hadad and Enlil (ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) were at war over tribute and over who would rule the sea kingdom's lands and its human peoples. Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7 defeated him when he demanded tribute (KTU 1.2), and Philo of Byblos records the same fight under the name Pontos. Atlantis invaded and was beaten (Plato, Critias), and Critias 121b-c has Zeus gather the house to punish it. Plato's Critias lists the army of Atlantis (chariots, horsemen, archers, slingers, 1,200 ships) and names no giants, so the giants in its army rest on the joining of the Fomorians to Atlantis (6/10). The author, October 20, 2026: "Plato very well might have wanted to distance his account from any mythical sounding account; he was a philosopher not a rhapsode, the first academic, who has a long tradition of denial for this." The record supports that reading (8/10): Critias insists the account is true history, not a made-up story (Timaeus 26e), and the Republic (books 2, 3 and 10) attacks the poets' stories about the gods. The Tuatha Dé Danann destroyed Atlantis by a directed attack about 9643 BCE (The author), within about forty years of Plato's approximate 9600 BCE date (9.5/10 for the date correspondence). Danaan claims instead that Yuh, who is Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7, destroyed Atlaa, her name for Atlantis, while it was under Enki's protection (7/10 as agreement on the ending); that remains her claim. His sea line rejected the council of the houses and has no line to it on the account. Why: tribute and forced labour extend Poseidon's power beyond his immediate household. Where he is now: survived the fall of Atlantis and is held or hidden below with the defeated elders, most likely in a sealed station under the Atlantic; the Baal poems call him dead and then defeated again (scored inference, 5/10; KTU 1.2 IV and 1.3 III). Sources The Baal Cycle tablets of Ugarit (KTU 1.2) and the Egyptian Astarte Papyrus give the tribute demand and Baal-Hadad's victory. Philo of Byblos gives the same fight under the name Pontos. Plato's Critias (113a-c and 121b-c) gives the founding, the ten kings, the laws and the punishment of Atlantis, and says the names were translated twice. Ovid's Fasti 4.169-178 gives the two Pleiades women. Iliad 15.187-193 gives the lot; Apollodorus 3.14 and Pausanias 2.15 give the lost contests for Athens and Argos; Critias 113d gives the rings of sea and land; Timaeus 26e and the Republic (books 2, 3 and 10) give Plato's distance from the poets' stories. Lebor Gabála Érenn gives the Fomorians in Ireland before Nemed. Cath Maige Tuired gives Elatha, Bres and the Fomorian tribute. The full entry is in the Name Equations Register, section 3.6.

The old council of the houses: the mount of assembly in the north
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. A family council fits the repeated need for collective recognition among competing powerful rulers. Negotiation and restraint explain the difference between individual force and accepted jurisdiction. Supporting account. The old council of the houses is the House of Anu Star Empire's own council: an assembly of ET flesh-and-blood members of an ED/archon-descended house that met on the mount of assembly in the far north, judged and restrained its own members, and settled disputes over the human resource. In the author's words it is not a federation but "a council really barely containing the excesses of these fascist feudalists" (8/10). It is not the later Galactic Federation of Worlds. What it is It is an institution, not a being. Its members are ET flesh-and-blood members of the House of Anu Star Empire, and its off-world family star-empire; later colony worlds need not be their first birthplace. The account rates the box 8/10. Its hosts are Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8 and Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7. Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7 owns the mountain, the "Holy" Watchers decide, the princes of the nations are judged there, Thoth10/Djehuty10/Taautos9/Ishka7 is its scribe, and Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7 is a member who dissented. The fallen Watchers, the Atlantis sea line of Poseidon10/Neptune9/Nethuns9/Yam8/Nahar7.5/Pa-Yam7.5/Pontos7 and the first fallen, who tried to seize the council's seat, rejected it. It has ranks: fifty great members and seven who decree fates sit in one assembly (8/10), and the author adds that members changed through wars. What it did The factions of Anu's house (all ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) needed one body to settle who may own, breed, cull and contact the human resource. The council allocated colonies, recognised offices, settled ownership disputes and punished members, but it was made of the same owners and only partly contained their excesses. It judged its own members, charging them "How long will you judge unjustly?" and sentencing them to "die like men". After the Flood, Ea rebuked Enlil before the members for flooding without consulting them; the council banished Enlil for raping Ninlil, who stands in Hera10/Juno9/Ninlil7.5; and the Watchers' decree humbled King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. It ruled for Horus10/Hor10/Harpocrates9.5/Harsiese9.5/Haroeris8 against Baal-Hadad's faction and gave Horus ownership of the Nile valley's humans to loosh, that is, to harvest their soul energy. Today The modern accounts separate the old council from the Galactic Federation of Worlds, a later alliance founded by the Seven's line after the Orion Wars. The account reads the Federation as the treaty institution that followed the war against Tiamat about 290,000 years ago (9/10 that a treaty followed the war; about 300,000 years is Danaan's rounded date for its founding), governing Earthlings' bloodlines, reproduction, compulsory labour, allegiance, access to technology and outside intervention. The old council is one party beside it (7/10): Anu's empire allied with it "as equals", Enki's family was admitted to the Andromedan council (Collier), and Enlil was tried before four councils and confined (Danaan, October 2022). Why: the old council settles disputes among its own ruling households and restrains members without ceasing to be an assembly of those same powers. Sources Isaiah 14:12-15, Psalm 82 and Daniel 4:17 give the mount of assembly, the attempted seizure, the judging of the princes and the Watchers' decree. Gilgamesh XI and Enlil and Ninlil give the rebuke and the banishment of Enlil, and the Enuma Elish gives the fifty and the seven. The Taygetan (Swaruu) account, Alex Collier (2001-2002) and Elena Danaan (2022) give the modern record.

Marduk: Prometheus and Damkina's son and postwar administrator
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The victorious successor fits the connected military bargain, recovery of authority and subsequent reorganization. Parentage and the senior assembly's recognition explain the personal claim to government. Supporting account. Marduk is the firstborn son of Ea and Damkina and a member of the House of Anu Star Empire: an ET flesh-and-blood member of an ED/archon-descended house who killed Tiamat, took the kingship of Anshar's assembly by its vote, ruled from Babylon, and with Ea modified the humans already on Earth into a forced-labour population. The account marks him changed or divided. What race and house His names are Marduk10/Amar-Utu10/Marutuk10/Shun7.5/Chonghua7.5, and Danaan's Marutuk is the Babylonian Marduk (9.5/10). The account rates the box 8/10. The house is that of Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8: ET flesh-and-blood members of an off-world house associated with Arcturus and holding a later imperial seat at Sirius B on the planet Ashtari (Danaan) (7.5/10). His father is Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7 and his mother is Damkina, a separate woman from Ninhursag. He was born in the Chamber of Destinies of the Abzu establishment that Ea had captured from Apsu, whose planet is unresolved; there Ea and Damkina developed him with Apsu's knowledge of Tiamat as a purpose-built countermeasure (9/10). Both parents are of the house, so he is of the house and not UT. Danaan calls him "originally a bright and beautiful entity", and the Enuma Elish gives him a blazing form with four eyes and four ears: doubled perception, an augmented body or apparatus watching and hearing in several directions; Shun's double pupils supply the comparison. Short history Marduk's coalition (Ea's household with Anshar's assembly, ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) and Tiamat's coalition under Kingu (the old order, ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry) were at war over imperial succession and over who would own and develop the humans on Earth. Ea and then Anu tried and failed to stop Tiamat. Marduk made his fighting conditional on authority, and Anshar's assembly voted him king. He returned from the wider House administration to command the campaign on Terra about 290,000 years ago. He combined the evidence from Prometheus's and Uranus/Anu/Ra's failures with captured Abzu knowledge and identified Tiamat's continuing Achamoth and field connection as the weakness that had to be interrupted before her body could be destroyed (9.5/10). The net fixed her bodily form and dimensional position; four currents interrupted the field connection; the internal wind disorganised regeneration; the bodily strike then worked; division and dispersal prevented immediate reassembly. He killed Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5 (9/10), destroying her active physical war-body and government but not her continuing energetic consciousness, captured Kingu and recovered the Tablet of Destinies. The author rates this battle 8/10 as a real succession event that a scribe later recorded as a creation story. Kingu, who stands in Kronos10/Saturn9/Kumarbi8.5/Baal Hammon8.5/Satre8/Geb8/Dagan7.5/Kingu7/Enmesharra7/Molek7, was held as a prisoner, then blamed and executed on Marduk's proposal. Ea and Marduk did not originate humanity (0/10): with Ninhursag they modified the humans already on Earth with Kingu's inheritance into a forced-labour population and advertised the modification as creation (9/10), and they did not remove Tiamat's work. Marduk established the postwar administration, the event after which the later Federation treaty becomes politically intelligible. The office and title of Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7 passed to Marduk, and he built Babylon, in present-day Iraq, and its temple Esagila. As Shun, called Chonghua, he ruled in China as a human-looking king, made king for merit, who drove out Gonggong and the old order's water faction (6.5/10). After the Flood he withdrew the teaching sages from human contact and barred their return (Erra Epic I); that restriction later left his own house dependent on guarded restoration materials and specialists. His statue was carried off to Hatti (central Turkey), Assyria (northern Iraq) and Elam (southwestern Iran), and the Marduk Prophecy has him say he went there himself. He was later held prisoner in the mountain, and Danaan says he was arrested (7/10). Nibiru is his crossing-ship at Jupiter (7/10): neberu means "ferry, crossing", his star Jupiter "holds the crossing", and Danaan's Nibiru is a mothership near Jupiter. Danaan also says he resided on Saturn and signed agreements there with the Orion Nebu Greys. Three readings stay low: that he turned on Ea at Enlil's urging, which is Danaan's alone (4/10), and Danaan's use for him of one of the first fallen's names (6.5/10) and of Amun (6/10), neither merged. Why: Marduk makes rescue conditional on kingship because victory gives him the means to replace the older authority with his own. Sources The Enuma Elish (I 80-104, II, IV, VI, VII) gives his birth, his form, the failures before him, the killing of Tiamat, Kingu's execution, his kingship and the crossing. The Erra Epic (I) gives the sages' removal. The Marduk Prophecy and the Marduk Ordeal give his travels and his imprisonment. The Shiji, the Book of Documents and the Kaiyuan Zhanjing give Shun and Chonghua. Elena Danaan (2024, 2025) gives the modern record. The full entry is in the Name Equations Register, sections 3.26 and 8.

Horus, son of Osiris and Isis, born on Earth
Proposed reading — fit 7.5/10. A dynastic claimant fits the repeated parent–partner–heir relationships and the struggle against the same opposing faction. Trial and fighting supply two means of obtaining the inheritance. Supporting account. Horus is the son of Osiris and Isis, born on Earth: an ET flesh-and-blood member of an ED/archon-descended house of the House of Anu Star Empire's ordered faction, who won the war with Baal-Hadad's faction and received ownership of the Nile valley's humans. What race and house His names are Horus10/Hor10/Harpocrates9.5/Harsiese9.5/Haroeris8; Apollo is out (6.5/10), because Horus rules and Apollo never does. The account rates the box 7.5/10. He was born on Earth to two members of the house, so he is of the house and not UT by the adopted definition (7.5/10). He belongs to Osiris's Orion faction. Short history Isis10/Aset10/Demeter8 bore him in hiding in the marshes of Chemmis, in the Nile Delta of Egypt, after Osiris10/Usir10/Yama8.5/Yima8.5/Jamshid8.5/Dionysus8/Mot8/Hades7.5 was killed about 46,950 BCE, and she protected him from Baal-Hadad's faction and healed him of a scorpion sting. Later in the same crisis of the House of Ra he fought Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7 for rule of Egypt, in the war between the two factions of Anu's house over the Nile valley's humans (told in Osiris's box). Thoth10/Djehuty10/Taautos9/Ishka7 recorded the verdict when the house's court tried the case. The council of the houses ruled for Horus and gave him ownership of the Nile valley's humans to loosh, that is, to harvest their soul energy from their worship and offerings, Baal-Hadad lost his Nile government but stayed active on Earth, and Ra withdrew from ordinary terrestrial government. His Followers, a retinue of human troops (6/10), ruled Egypt before human kings did. Where he is now: off Earth with Osiris's faction since about 10,950 BCE, most likely at the House station by Jupiter; Egyptian astronomy gave Saturn, Mars and Jupiter Horus names (scored inference, 5.5/10, Jupiter 4.5/10; Leitz 2002). Sources Plutarch's On Isis and Osiris 38, the Horus cippi and the Metternich Stela give his birth in hiding, his protection and his healing. The Contendings of Horus and Seth gives the war and the verdict, and the Turin King List gives the Followers of Horus. The names are in the Name Equations Register, section 3.7.

The Galactic Federation of Worlds
Proposed reading — fit 7/10. A political federation fits the repeated councils, allied fleets and shared judgments described by the contact accounts. Common intervention rules explain coordination among otherwise separate peoples. Supporting account. The Galactic Federation of Worlds is a federation of physical ET (extraterrestrial) peoples of our galaxy. Its side is pro-human; the box rates 7/10. Elena Danaan gives its own name as Oraa Nataru Shaari, "the Alliance of the Worlds of the Milky Way", joining over 500,000 interstellar cultures. The Lyran human family founded it after the Orion Wars, about 300,000 years ago by Danaan's count (7.5/10). It is a different and later body from the old council of the houses, such as the House of Anu Star Empire (8/10), whose embodied empire is ET flesh and blood of ED (extradimensional) and archonic ancestry; that old council now sits beside the Federation as one party. Who they are in our lore. They are the Seven's side (7.5/10). Their founders' names carry the line of the Seven, the House of Anu Star Empire's daughters who joined the Lyran family at the Pleiades (Taygeta, Erra and Atlaa), and the Orion Wars are the event behind the old record of Orion chasing the Seven (Hesiod, Works and Days 619-620) (7.5/10). Short history. The Tiamat-Kingu war on Earth was a decisive Earth front of the Orion Wars (8/10); the current working chronology places it approximately 290,000 years ago, and the Federation's 300,000-year date is a rounded tradition that cannot fix the exact spacing between the two. The Federation's formation follows that war closely enough to function as its political settlement: a treaty system designed to restrain the old feudal empires, manage Terra and protect the unusually consequential future Terran population. The treaty governs Earth's humans and their sanguine future: the control and inheritance of human bloodlines, reproduction and population policy, compulsory labour, political allegiance and rival claims of ownership, access to inherited technology, and the conditions under which outside populations may intervene on Earth (9/10). It turned an open war over humans into regulated and contested rule over humans, and it did not end every Orion war (3/10 that it did). The Federation's peoples (ET) and the Orion and Draco powers stayed at war over who would hold Earth and its humans; Danaan says the hold of the Nebu, the Orion-zone power, was dismantled by 2025, and Thuban, the Draco seat, was taken on November 17, 2025. On July 16, 2021, by Danaan's account, the Jupiter Agreements were passed between the galactic coalitions and the military forces of fourteen Earth nations, with the United States organizing Earth's space coalition. In October 2022, by Danaan's account, Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7 lost his authority in a proceeding of four councils and was confined; a later account places him on a guarded planet in the Sigma Canis Majoris system under House custody (2/10 for independent corroboration of that location; 7/10 for the proceeding as the final removal of his Terran authority). Anu's empire is allied with the Federation as equals. Enlil's removal fits the old pattern of a faction taking a seat while its holder is held or absent, as when Nergal10/Erra9/Meslamtaea9/Resheph8 wrecked Babylon while Marduk10/Amar-Utu10/Marutuk10/Shun7.5/Chonghua7.5 was away from his seat (Erra Epic) (6.5/10). Danaan describes a joint human and ET war from 2023 to 2025 with the US Navy's Solar Warden program, and David Grusch reports at least a dozen craft crashes from battles between Greys and reptilians (6.5/10 that such a conflict exists; 4/10 for Danaan's end date). How it is organised. Its High Council had twelve deciding seats in 2020 (the Selosi, the Ashtar Command, Vega, the Laan, the Caryons, the Pleiades, Sirius A and B, Tau Ceti, Andromeda, the Ummites, the Arcturians and Alpha Centauri) and "twenty-four plus one" by 2021, with a rotating lead seat and no single leader. The Thula of Sirius B, bred from Lyran Taal colonists and local Greys, are its second managing people (Danaan, 2026); the Nordics and Greys seen together are partly this hybrid people (6.5/10). Its herald is Shudyn Errata of the Tengri of Trappist-1, a small red star about 40 light years away (ET, 8/10). Its human officers, Thor Han, Ardaana, Jor El, Den Thor, Val Thor and Val Nek, are ET Lyran humans (8/10); several of those names match modern fiction (Tolkien's Arda and Denethor; Superman's Jor-El), so the names are not used as lore (6.5/10). Its station in Earth orbit is the Excelsior. It keeps a non-intervention rule and says its task here is to raise human awareness. In our lore, non-intervention preserves the understanding humans reach on their own, which older beings cannot supply themselves (The author). The Jupiter station. Jupiter and Ganymede count as one meeting location: a meeting station there rates 6.5/10, administration centred on Jupiter 8/10, and the physical station 5.5/10, with no public physical proof. Babylon called Jupiter Neberu, "the crossing". The author's inference is that the station sits so close to Earth because the fighting was over Earth, and that it was built a few thousand years ago for Earth's large dimensional convergence. Shared bases on the Moon, Mars and Venus. These are proposed stations, not beings. The 8/10 rating records the combined lore's interpretation of the contact accounts and of alleged editing in published Moon and Mars imagery. In the current reading ET peoples use them, though the individual occupants are not all identified: the Federation's station near Earth, the Selosi's colonies on Venus and Mars, and the Meton, "on Venus since so long that they are really called Venusians" (Danaan). Craft travel between them by phasing whole, faster than light. At 50-55 km up in Venus's clouds the pressure is about one Earth atmosphere and the temperature roughly 0-50 C, and NASA studied floating habitats there in 2015, so a floating habitat is the practical comparison; a phase-shifted base belongs to the lore's additional technological interpretation. Venus's residents in the contact accounts include the Taal, Lyran refugees (George Adamski's Orthon, 1952; Frank Stranges's Valiant Thor, 1967), described in the Pleiadian box. The author ruled on October 6, 2026 that Inanna is not "the goddess of Venus" unless lore places her base there, so Venus is not given as the base of the branch of Hathor10/Athyr10/Lady of Byblos8/Aphrodite8/Venus8/Inanna8/Ishtar8/Astarte8/Sekhmet7.5/Amaterasu7.5. Mars is the planet of Nergal in Babylonian astronomy, and the Erra Epic makes the Sebitti, the warrior Seven, his weapons: in real life, a strike force under his command (6.5/10). The author holds that Mars was a colony about a million years ago, and asks whose base it was when it took its giant battle scars. What the bases were for. They were a place to wait out the earlier House-era flood, about 58,800 BCE in the current chronology, and to hold stores (7/10). The Gilgamesh epic says the house's members "withdrew up" and "cowered like dogs by the outer wall" (XI), and Atrahasis III says they sat seven days hungry and thirsty because the Flood had cut off the offerings that fed them. In real life the members of the House of Anu Star Empire (ET flesh and blood) left Earth's surface for these stations during that flood and lost the food and the loosh (soul energy harvested from worship and offerings) that human offerings supplied. The author adds a second use: hiding war supply lines, which every war needs. Sources. Elena Danaan: A Gift from the Stars (2020), We Will Never Let You Down (2021), The Seeders (2022), Encyclopedia Galactica (2024), elenadanaan.org, and her sessions published by Michael Salla on exopolitics.org. Alex Collier: the 1994 interview, Defending Sacred Ground, the 1998 Art Bell transcript and the March 18, 2002 talk. David Grusch on Joe Rogan's show. Whitley Strieber's researcher's photograph analysis gives the Moon and Mars bases. NASA's 2015 Venus habitat study, George Adamski and Frank Stranges give the other modern accounts. Enuma Elish VII (Jupiter as Neberu, "the crossing"), Hesiod's Works and Days 619-620, the Gilgamesh epic (XI), Atrahasis (III) and the Erra Epic (I) give the old accounts.

Pleiadian and Nordic descendants: Ahel, Taal, Kahel, Zenetae, Plejaren and Taygetans
Proposed reading — fit 8.5/10. Related human-form off-world populations fit the recurring bodily resemblance, dispersal account and distinct colonies. Different affiliations and degrees of development explain variation within the proposed wider family. Supporting account. The modern Pleiadians and Nordics are an ET (extraterrestrial) human people of Lyran descent (8/10). Many of their ancestors ascended into ED (extradimensional) flesh or energy and the rest are still embodied, which is why the account reads them as "ET ascending": pro-human, 8.5/10. The Lyran human family is one ET people of human form, placed in Lyra, attacked there by the Draco and scattered to several star systems (7.5/10). It is not a branch of the House of Anu Star Empire, though ET peoples may still be of fallen ED origin (The author). Its family line runs through the Seven, women of the House of Anu Star Empire who joined the Lyran family at the Pleiades; the House of Anu Star Empire is ET flesh and blood of ED and archonic ancestry and took planets in many star systems, and the account therefore counts the Greek Seven as ET (7/10). This box joins the named descendant populations: the Ahel of Erra, the Taal of Venus, the Kahel, the Zenetae, the Plejaren and the Taygetans. The Laan are a separate feline-featured branch of the same Lyran dispersal with their own box, and the red-haired Great Bear population stays with Set, Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7, and is not relabelled Nordic. The Seven and their house. The house is that of Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8. The female branch includes the daughters of Atlas10/Aril8.5/Upelluri7, compared with the Krittikas who nursed Kartikeya10/Skanda10/Kumara10/Subrahmanya10/Murugan9/Weituo8. They are many beings, so they form no conglomerate. The Sebitti, the warrior Seven of the Erra Epic whom Anu fathered on Earth, are UT (born on Earth directly of an ET star-empire parent) and stand in their own box; the comparison of the Pleiadian Seven with them is functional, and the two groups are not the same women. The Pleiades sit on the shoulder of Taurus, which the Gilgamesh epic calls Anu's "Bull of Heaven"; the bull is the house's emblem. The author's reading is that the Seven fit a female world, either a breeding harem or a planet that chose to be matriarchal, apart from male-ruled Arcturus and war-ruined Draco. Hathor10/Athyr10/Lady of Byblos8/Aphrodite8/Venus8/Inanna8/Ishtar8/Astarte8/Sekhmet7.5/Amaterasu7.5 leads them, and her tie to the Nordics of Venus is alliance, not birth (6.5/10). In Greek lore they were the unmarried huntresses of Artemis10/Artume9.5/Diana9/Bastet7.5, whom Orion pursued. The Amazons, women warriors who served Artemis and kept only their daughters (Strabo 11.5.1), are the same kind of band living on Earth (8/10). Maia, Electra and Taygete bore royal lines to Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7; Taygete bore him, as Zeus, a son, Lacedaemon (Apollodorus 3.10.3): in real life, Anu's ruling son, Enlil, bred the house's daughters to found royal lines. They are one service with two jobs, nurse and enforcer, not two factions (7/10). Who the Seven are (scored inference, October 21, 2026, 7.5/10): the House's female branch, led by Hathor, holding the office of birth and fate, so that whoever controls them controls who is born and into which line. They were deceived, falsely accused and pursued for breeding, and withdrew to a seat of their own (7/10): in the Mahabharata (Vana Parva 223-226) the Seven Sages, the stars of the Great Bear, believed six of their wives, the Krittikas, unfaithful and divorced them; in real life, the women were deceived, accused and rejected by their Great Bear husbands (8/10). Their hunters (7.5/10) were the Great Bear line, the red-haired household of Baal-Hadad, recorded by the Indian sages, the Talmud's Bear and the Kiowa and Lakota bear of Devils Tower; Orion of Poseidon's line; and a Watcher, in the midrash of Istahar. The hunters wanted heirs, "give me my children" (Berakhot 58b): whoever fathered the Seven's children decided the succession (7.5/10). Individual members did split: Electra withdrew, and Merope stayed with a human: in real life, one woman left the service and one married a Terran man. The peoples and their officers. The Ahel (Errahel) live on the planet Erra in the system Danaan calls Ashaara, which is Taygeta in the Pleiades; they fled there from the Man system in Lyra after an attack. Thor Han Eredyon is one: 6.5 feet tall, fair-skinned, with wavy blond hair and aquamarine eyes, a High Command officer of the Federation's Excelsior station and son of a princess of the Errahel House of Manahu. The Lyran family's officers in modern contact (8/10 as ET) are Thor Han and Ardaana of Erra in the Taygeta system, Jor El, Val Thor of the Taal of Venus, and Val Nek of the Kahel of Epsilon Eridani. The Kahel live at Epsilon Eridani, the Katayy at Sirius A, and the Zenetae in the Andromeda constellation; the Ummites are also of this family. Semjase (Billy Meier's Plejaren) and Swaruu (the Taygetans) are earlier contacts of the same people, and the author rules the Plejaren, Barbara Marciniak and Law of One claims 8/10. The Nordics of the 1950s are Danaan's Taal, Lyran refugees living on Venus (7/10): George Adamski's Orthon (1952), and Frank Stranges's Valiant Thor, who met President Eisenhower's staff at the Pentagon in 1957 with companions including Donn (Stranger at the Pentagon, 1967). In Danaan's account the Taal of Venus include Val Thor, his brother Don Emerys and his wife Jilian Ahura. The author rules their tie to the Tuatha 8/10, through Donn10/Eber Donn8.5/Donn Firinne8.5/Dis Pater of the Gauls7 and a female companion with a Tuatha-related name; the Tuatha-style names in Danaan's account rate 6.5/10: Don is the Welsh name of Danu10/Ana8/Antu8/Don7/Doumu7/Ziguang7/Marici7/Molizhitian7/Nammu7, and Emrys is a name of Merlin10/Merlinus10/Myrddin9/Myrddin Wyllt9/Lailoken8.5. The author's inference: the Pleiadians ended up in the clouds of Venus, waiting for the convergence. Humans look like them because the makers built humans to their own body plan: "let us make man in our image" (Genesis 1:26), with plural makers (6.5/10). The human Form itself is older than both peoples and was carried by the Seeders (see the Seeders box). Short history. The Draco, the Ciakahrr empire, attacked the Ahel, Noor, Taal and Laan populations in Lyra before approximately 300,000 years ago, and the Lyran family scattered. Why: war displacement explains the Lyran family's spread and its protective alliances. The Orion Wars of the modern accounts match Orion's chase of the Seven (7.5/10), and after those wars the family founded the Galactic Federation of Worlds (see that box). The Midrash of Shemhazai and Azael sets Istahar, who is Ishtar, standing in Hathor's names, among the Pleiades (7.5/10), at about 300,000 years ago (The author). The names line up with the Seven (8/10): Taygete is a daughter of Atlas; Erra is a name of Nergal10/Erra9/Meslamtaea9/Resheph8, to whom Anu gave the Sebitti as warriors (Erra Epic I); Ashaara matches Asherah, who stands in I-La10/Shekhinah8/Achamoth8/Asherah7 (6.5/10); and Atlaa is Atlas's Atlantis. Atlantis was the warlike sea kingdom of Poseidon10/Neptune9/Nethuns9/Yam8/Nahar7.5/Pa-Yam7.5/Pontos7 near Spain, of the Fomorian sea line, and the Tuatha destroyed it by a directed attack about 9643 BCE; Plato says it sank in a single day and night (Timaeus 25d) after Zeus called the council to punish it (Critias 121b-c). Danaan's account, kept only as her claim, differs: Thor Han says the Ahel came to Earth when the civilization of Atlaa was flourishing, as a colony under the protection of Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7, and that Atlaa was destroyed by the negative faction of Anu's empire, Yuh, whom Danaan identifies with Enlil (7/10 as a match to Plato's account); her Seeder account makes Atlaa a settlement built from an Altean mother-vessel in the Atlantic (9/10 within her account). Enki's faction and Enlil's faction of the House of Anu Star Empire (both ET flesh and blood of ED and archonic ancestry) were at war over the human colonies on Earth. Diodorus's Atlantioi say Atlas's seven daughters became the first ancestors of the larger part of the human race (Diodorus 3.60), which fits the author's view that this family may have seeded humans in its own image. The Talmud says two stars were taken from Kimah, the Pleiades, to bring the Flood and two from Ayish to stop it, and that Ayish follows Kimah saying "give me my children" (Berakhot 58b). In real life: the Genesis flood of about 9643 BCE, which the ED rulers brought after the House of Anu Star Empire withdrew about 10,950 BCE, was started from the Pleiades' side and stopped from Ayish's side. Ishtar, who is Hathor, "spoke evil in the assembly of the gods, ordering a catastrophe" (Gilgamesh XI 119-120): in real life, Hathor argued in the house's council for the earlier House-era flood of about 58,800 BCE (7.5/10). Why: at that earlier flood the House of Anu Star Empire's factions (ET flesh and blood) were divided over whether to destroy the human stock they owned or keep it, and over who would own the bloodlines the Seven bear. Their gate office. The Pleiades mark Samhain, Beltane and the New Fire, the nights when the Pleiadian-line people, the Tuatha, cross through the opened mounds. In real life the Seven's office schedules and keeps the gates on the nights when crossings between dimensions open (6.5/10). On those nights they protected humans: they gave the timing together with the rules for surviving the night (all fires out, one fire, stay awake), warned Nera, and fought the Samhain tribute of children (6.5/10). The same office also opens the gate through which the first fallen's licensed collectors pass, so it serves inside an administration that permits the harm (5.5/10). Sources. Strabo 11.5.1, the Gilgamesh epic (VI and XI), Talmud Berakhot 58b, Job 38:31-32, Genesis 1:26, the Erra Epic (I), the Irish telling of Nera, Plato's Timaeus 25d and Critias 121b-c, Apollodorus 3.10.3, Diodorus 3.60 and the Midrash of Shemhazai and Azael give the old accounts. Xiwangmu (Queen Mother of the West), Bastet's office and the Laan population
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. The feline-featured ancestral population fits the combined body description, longevity and line-making capabilities in the adopted account. The serpent conflict supplies its place in the earlier colonial sequence. Supporting account. The Laan (Laani) are a flesh-and-blood ET (extraterrestrial) population: a feline-featured branch of the wider Lyran dispersal, with a fundamentally human body plan, thick hair or short fur, feline-looking faces and small tails, long life and advanced body-modification technology. Their side is changed or divided; the box rates 8/10. Their home was Egoria in the Man/Kepler-62 system. Danaan's account says explicitly that they are not literal terrestrial cats; a literal zoological cat species is 5/10 because the same people possessed shape-changing and genetic technology. The Laan and the hairy Lahmu/Lahamu-related population around Arcturus are presently independent populations (8/10); a shared genealogy is 3.5/10. Short history. Before Terra, the Man system held several inhabited worlds with crystalline cities, art, music, poetry, education, diplomacy and genetic knowledge (10/10 within Danaan's account). The Ciakahrr destroyed Egoria and attacked the Taal political centre, and the Laan survivors dispersed. Approximately one million years ago Laani colonists found Terra, established a colony and began genetic work on the existing Terran hominids, as another participant in Achamoth's continuing human-development project, not the origin of the human Form. Laani work on the ancestors of the Vanaras rates 9.5/10. The current highest-scoring account (9.2/10) says the Laani selected an already furred, monkey-looking and tailed Terran population and multiplied and enhanced it partly to resist the Ciakahrr/Nagai invasion; the alternative (8.8/10) says Laani inheritance supplied the fur and tail to a South Asian archaic-Homo base. Kishkindha later became an independent successor kingdom of that population (9/10). Ciakahrr or Draco-side colonists arrived shortly afterward to seize the colony and enslave the modified Terrans, and the Laan-serpent conflict became the first Terran war in that chronology. Danaan's account reports a war of about 7,000 years (8/10 as the principal first campaign); about 70,000 years is retained as a proposed alternative. Early House of Anu Star Empire interests joined after territorial cooperation with the Laan. The war destroyed entire civilizations and ended with one Ciakahrr/Nagai faction withdrawing underground, the later Naga houses, while the remaining Draco forces left the Solar system. A common wartime cause for the Naga retreat, Laani withdrawal and an ancestral human population decline is retained as a working inference. Remembered offices. The ancient Asian record preserves the same opposition through feline or tiger-associated western rulers against serpent and dragon houses: the early Queen Mother of the West, Xiwangmu, is human-shaped with a leopard tail and tiger teeth, while Bastet preserves the Laan's own protective feline office in Egypt. The evidence supports one Laan-derived population and its remembered offices at 8/10. The later cat-versus-serpent memory, the names of the bear-associated Rksa branch among the Vanaras and of Kadru, "Tawny", the Naga matriarch, and the depleted Naga condition after a long war make the early conflict 8.5/10. The Olmec ruling culture of Mexico's Gulf Coast retained knowledge from both sides: its were-jaguar figures preserve the Laan feline transformation beside the serpent forms of the Naga houses (8.5/10). One Laan-derived population later followed the Apex-to-Zeta history and became one Grey lineage (see the Grey box). Sources: Elena Danaan's Laan chronology (Laan and Terran Wars account, August 10, 2021); early accounts of Xiwangmu; Egyptian Bastet material; the Ramayana (Bala Kanda 1.17; Kishkindha Kanda); La Venta Monument 19 and the Olmec were-jaguar figures.

Laani descendants: Apex-to-Zeta Greys, Tall Whites, healing and hostile factions, and small workers
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. Multiple related and engineered lines fit the repeated bodily design alongside different programmes and allegiances. The Laan–Apex–Zeta sequence supplies an ancestry proposal while worker manufacture explains additional similar bodies. Supporting account. The Grey populations are ET (extraterrestrial) flesh and blood: engineered or cloned body types carried by many ET peoples (7.5/10), none of them UT (born on Earth directly of an ET star-empire parent). This box joins one ancestral line descended from the Laan through the Apex-to-Zeta history, the Tall Whites, the healing faction of Hathor10/Athyr10/Lady of Byblos8/Aphrodite8/Venus8/Inanna8/Ishtar8/Astarte8/Sekhmet7.5/Amaterasu7.5, the hostile factions and the small manufactured workers. Their side is changed or divided; the box rates 8/10. The Grey body pattern became a platform used by several populations (9/10), so behaviour and command identify a faction more reliably than body shape. The Greys split into two factions (7/10), the faction that serves Hathor and heals and the hostile faction, and independent hostile Grey factions also exist (9/10). They make hybrids but are not hybrids. One larger mind runs the small bodies, so the loss of one body costs that mind nothing (7/10), and the author holds that Grey bodies can be remote-controlled, so their species lines are weaker than ours. Zeta Reticuli, from Marjorie Fish's reading (1968-1973) of the star map Betty Hill drew after 1961, is one place where Grey bodies are used (6/10), not the home of all Greys (3/10). Origin: the first manufactured workers. The first recorded manufactured Grey-like workers are the kurgarra and galatur (kur-jara and gala-tura) made by Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7 (9.5/10): small, identical, sexless workers grown "from the dirt under his fingernails", which in real life means from his own cells. They are early made workers that Enki, an ET member of the House of Anu Star Empire, grew on Earth (6.5/10), not workers brought from Zeta Reticuli; the Akkadian telling makes one of the pair a being of neither clear sex (the Descent of Ishtar). Enki did not copy an older complete Grey design: the record preserves his own first manufactured implementation. That manufacturing technology contributing to every later Grey line is 8.5/10; literal biological ancestry of every later Grey from the original pair is 8/10. The author reads the pair as an example, if not the start, of the sexless Grey drones, and his side theory reads the clay of the making accounts as Grey nanotechnology or "bioslime". Origin: the Laan line. A population ancestry runs beside that first manufacture. At least one Grey lineage descends from the Laan (8/10), and the Apex-to-Zeta line specifically is 8.5/10. The Prism of Lyra (Lyssa Royal and Keith Priest, 1989) says an Apex population damaged its world, went underground, suppressed emotion, relied on cloning and later moved to the Zeta Reticuli region (7/10 with the author's account). In the combined account that is a Laan-descended population adapting its own body until it became the Grey type: an older people of the same human template who chose technology over ascension, cloned themselves, lost sexual reproduction and were left behind when others ascended (6/10). Feline and Grey morphology share the wedge-shaped head, enlarged dark eyes, small nose and mouth and a highly readable emotional gaze (9/10). The first complete Grey body being built partly from Laan biological stock and technical knowledge is 8/10. Olmec infant and were-jaguar figures preserve an intermediate broad-headed, large-eyed, feline-human form. The 8.5/10 rating concerns the visual-cultural comparison of bodily imagery. Every Grey descending only from the Laan remains 4/10 because later Grey bodies were copied, manufactured and used by several populations. The author's lead is that the Greys may also be of the making of Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5: Hathor wears the composite looks of Tiamat's makings (cow horns, and a lion's head as Sekhmet), and Enki, who took the seat of Tiamat's partner Apsu, carried on her craft of making flesh when he made the first sexless workers. Their vanity and quick hurt are traits carried down from the archons, among them the first fallen's claim to be the only authority (Apocryphon of John) (7.5/10). Hathor and her healing faction. Hathor is an embodied ET woman of the House of Anu Star Empire, not an ED (extradimensional) archon. Her immediate father is Nanna10/Sin10/Ashimbabbar9/Kushuh8/Yarikh8, her grandfather Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7 and her great-grandfather Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8; the Egyptian description of her as the daughter and Eye of Ra records dynastic descent and her appointment as Anu's seeing and weapons authority. In the Book of the Heavenly Cow, Anu, as Ra, sent Hathor as Sekhmet to kill the humans in Egypt who rebelled against him: in real life, the House of Anu Star Empire put down a human revolt against its ownership, with Hathor as its enforcer. In the Descent of Inanna, Inanna10/Ishtar10/Innin10/Inuruanna9/Astarte8.5/Shaushka8/Aphrodite8/Venus8/Turan7.5 goes down to Kur and is turned into a corpse. Enlil refuses to recover her, then Nanna refuses, and Enki makes the two workers, gives one the life-giving plant and the other the life-giving water, and sends them in. They slipped in "like flies" and "like phantoms" and brought her back with "the food and water of life": in real life, Enki's manufactured workers entered the restricted installation by dimensional access, used psychic contact and influence to gain cooperation or access, and restored her body with his restorative materials; no insects are meant. The author rules Kur a dimensional gate and prison and a physical workshop of nanotechnology, cloning and biorobotics. The rescue explains the lasting alliance: Hathor changed from Ra's enforcer to Enki's protective and healing side, and her Grey-associated faction changed sides with her. Hathor's Greys heal, tend human bloodlines and point humans to what they call Source; pro-human, 6.5/10. The faction preserves a Laan-derived lineage at 8/10 while also using manufactured workers and controlled projected appearances. Hathor leads or strongly influences a Grey development and contact programme (8.5/10), monitors Terran bloodlines and dimensional development (9/10) and interacts with military institutions (8/10); that she personally commands every abusive MILAB event is 4/10. Atomic weapons and the approaching dimensional transition together renewed outside attention to Terran activity and help explain her renewed activity (9/10). Her Greys watch and help humans because humans are their source stock and because they were told to (6/10), and they want back emotion, soul, beauty and sexual bodies through hybrids (6.5/10). The Greys and the Nordics serve together under Hathor (7.5/10), or the Greys show a pleasing Nordic image to calm a person; the author never saw a tension there. Hathor's aged body. Her youthful golden humanoid appearance became the aged Grey appearance after approximately 50,000 years without the House of Anu Star Empire's complete nanotechnology, biological materials and specialist maintenance (9/10). Repeated regeneration, cloning, tissue replacement and incomplete maintenance can reduce a long-lived humanoid body toward the small Grey configuration (8.5/10), and her body and the manufactured workers converge on the same reduced form because the same engineering preserves only the systems needed for continued function (8.5/10). Her black ocular surfaces are replacement sensory structures, protective coverings or later modifications rather than proof of a separate naturally evolved species (8/10). Her worn body may be the one revived at Kur (5/10). In Danaan's account she removed her inherited Draco material (8/10 within the combined account) and lives with her family aboard the House vessel near Jupiter (7/10); the youthful golden image as her present unmediated body is 4/10, and as her preferred communication appearance, remembered earlier body or controlled presentation 9/10. Whitley Strieber's female Grey visitor of 1985, whom he compared to Ishtar and who told him she was old, and Chris Bledsoe's luminous Lady, whom Bledsoe calls Hathor, are the same ancient woman or her continuing intelligence (8.5/10): Strieber met the deteriorated physical body, while Bledsoe and Danaan received the preferred, projected or remembered youthful appearance (9/10). When Strieber thought she looked rough, the thought hurt her badly: she has real feelings (7/10), and the same personality runs through all her names (6.5/10). The two recorded occasions on which remarks about her aged appearance hurt her show that the deterioration is unwanted, and she would use complete restoration if it were available (9/10). On the Strieber account the two made beings are the small Grey workers, and the Greys who changed sides serve her branch (9/10). The author's lead is that the Zetas may have sent clones to serve others in the old war. Other contacts. Betty Andreasson's beings called themselves the Watchers and said they had collected human seed "since Adam" (Raymond Fowler, 1979); the author calls this bragging, done under the authority, power and technology of their betters (7/10). The Ariel School children in Zimbabwe (1994) were told to care for the Earth. The Wandjina of the Kimberley in northwestern Australia, with pale faces, large dark eyes, no mouth and a halo, are Grey-type (7.5/10). When children tormented their owl, Dumbi, a flood drowned the people (8/10 for the owl rule): in real life, the owl was an image used by watchers, and mistreating those watchers brought a punishment from their owners (6/10). Strieber's barn owl at his window, a cover image over a real visit, matches Dumbi (9/10). The hostile factions. The hostile Greys are the Grey bodies of the abduction accounts and of the craft recovered by military programmes, with no native Grey homeland. They are the Greys of the Orion empire, with the Draco reptilians (6.5/10) and the tall overseers (6.5/10) as their masters. Anti-human, 7/10. They can include Apex-to-Zeta descendants, later copies and purpose-grown bodies. They take people from beds and cars without consent, examine them, take samples and reproductive material, screen and erase memories, and leave missing time: Betty and Barney Hill (New Hampshire, 1961), Whitley Strieber (Communion, 1987), Budd Hopkins's cases and John Mack's experiencers. Thousands of consistent accounts make them an enemy (7/10). Their technology passed to military and power groups who keep it secret, among them the Zeta Reticuli craft Bob Lazar described (Nevada, 1989). Why (6.5/10): the Grey line wants its own reproduction and access to souls, and its military partners want power and secrecy. Abductees report being told the Greys cannot reproduce well on their own and need hybrids (David Jacobs; John Mack), and that they want human emotion: line-makers trying to obtain soul types they cannot make. The author adds that by some accounts they lack free will like ours, and that taking seed without consent may be rational, though not moral, if their species is dying or they fear ours is. The author's limits on the charge: a Nordic told Strieber never to go to war with the Greys "because they'll never let you win and they will never let you stop fighting" (DEBRIEFED episode 36, May 2, 2025; 9/10 that he said it), and the Nordic is a party to that policy (6/10). The author reads it to mean that the winning side of the endless war is also the Greys. The Tall Whites. The Tall Whites are an ET people (8/10). As a branch of this Grey lineage, the Tall Whites belong with the Laani-derived Grey descendants at 8/10: they share the Grey complex's enlarged dark eyes, narrow face, pallor, telepathy, witness control and joint terrestrial operating environment; their taller body is a branch or engineered presentation. Charles Hall's account rates 7/10. Hall met them as an Air Force weather observer on the Nevada ranges in the mid-1960s (Millennial Hospitality, from 2002): very tall, with chalk-white skin, white hair and large eyes, sensitive to light, with craft and a base there, working alongside the Air Force, and by his account from the star Arcturus, using Earth as a station. Elena Danaan's Vela Kiily-Tokurt match Hall's beings point by point: tall, very thin, very pale, the women with long white hair, working at Area 51 beside Hall's ranges (7/10). Danaan gives them a Federation branch at Alpha Centauri, and she also lists the Vela Kiily-Tokurt among the peoples of the Nebu, the Orion empire allied with the Draco; Hall's Arcturus claim and Danaan's Alpha Centauri and Orion placements remain conflicting location claims inside this one lineage. The good tall white people of the Seeders, the Alteans of the galaxy NGC 7331, are a separate people. In 2 Enoch 1, two very tall men "with faces shining like the sun" come for Enoch10/Hanokh10/Akhnukh9.5/Idris9/Hermes Trismegistus8: in real life, tall, pale beings collected Enoch before Noah's flood, and they have the Tall Whites' look (6/10 as a link). Hall's account gives no motive beyond using Earth as a station and working alongside the Air Force, and the combined lore holds no further reason. Sources. Whitley Strieber's Communion (1987) and DEBRIEFED episode 36 (2025), Chris Bledsoe's accounts, Raymond Fowler's The Andreasson Affair (1979), John Mack's Abduction (1994), Budd Hopkins, David Jacobs, the Ariel School (1994), Betty and Barney Hill (1961) and Betty Hill's star map as read by Marjorie Fish (1968-1973; Astronomy, December 1974), Bob Lazar (1989), David Grusch (2026), Lyssa Royal and Keith Priest's The Prism of Lyra (1989), Charles Hall's Millennial Hospitality (from 2002), Elena Danaan (the Inanna profile at elenadanaan.org, the Vela Kiily-Tokurt and the Alteans), and the Metropolitan Museum and Kimbell Museum records of the Olmec figures give the modern accounts. The Descent of Inanna (Sumerian; ETCSL, lines 217-225 and the Enlil and Nanna refusals), the Descent of Ishtar (Akkadian), the Book of the Heavenly Cow, the Gilgamesh epic (VI), the Apocryphon of John, 2 Enoch 1 and the Worrorra, Ngarinyin and Wunambal Wandjina law give the old accounts. The Council of Five, now seven (the Council of Alnilam, or Zaggarah)
Proposed reading — fit 6/10. An alliance-level council fits its formation against domination, willingness to intervene and participation in joint judgments. Those repeated political functions explain cooperation without collapsing all member peoples together. Supporting account. The Council of Five, now seven, also called the Council of Alnilam or of Zaggarah, is a council of ET (extraterrestrial) peoples with its headquarters at Alnilam, the middle star of Orion's belt (6/10). Its side is pro-human. The Elmanuk of Gliese 832 founded it as the Orion Council of Nine to resist the invasion of the Nebu (Danaan); it is more willing than the Federation to intervene, and its peoples prepare bloodlines and help souls into bodies. What it is. It fell from nine members to five in the Orion Wars, when the Marvo and two others withdrew and the Elmanuk retired, then rose to six when the Elmanuk returned (April 2023) and to seven when the Marvo returned (November 2023). Its seat at Alnilam is Orion's ordered side, the side of Osiris10/Usir10/Yama8.5/Yima8.5/Jamshid8.5/Dionysus8/Mot8/Hades7.5 (6.5/10). It met the Andromedan council at the Ganymede facility in October 2021. The roster first appears in the Russian "Alien Races Book" (2013), which Danaan says she used. Who they are. The Elmanuk of Gliese 832 are very tall and very thin with large eyes. The Egaroth of Meissa and Alnilam are tall, slender and large-headed; their councillor Annax is 7 feet tall, copper-brown and bald. Their name and office match the "Holy" Watchers who kept their place (7/10): the Greek for Watchers is egregoroi, and Daniel 4:17 speaks of "the decree of the Watchers". They are not the same beings: the Egaroth are an ET people, and the Watchers are ED (extradimensional) officers. They develop as both sexes in one body, like the Hermetic first humans (7/10). The Redan are tan humanoids of Bootes, later of Assamay in Orion. Danaan's later book makes them a branch of the House of Anu Star Empire's own people, the Reda clan, which Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8 granted the Assamay system and which later left the empire (8/10 within her account; 7/10 as the house's people of Bootes). The Orela of Ophiuchus are extremely slender, of Grey type, and make bodies that receive souls, as the makers do in the Hermetic Asclepius 37 (8/10 for the process). They match Asclepius10/Asklepios10/Aesculapius9.5/Eshmun9, whose star is Ophiuchus (6.5/10). The Emerther of Tau Ceti are about a metre tall, pale grey, with three fingers; they match the small workers made by Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7 (6/10). The Ginvo of Procyon are of human height with brown skin and large dark eyes, and run a mostly underground facility near Ganymede's north pole; they match Orion's hounds in the star lore, since Procyon is the little dog star beside Orion (6.5/10). The Marvo of Orion are of Grey type with extra arm joints for moving on four limbs. Short history. The council's peoples (ET) and the Nebu, the Orion-zone power whose hold Danaan says was dismantled by 2025, were at war over Orion and its peoples, and the council was founded to resist that invasion. Why: the council unites peoples against the Nebu invasion. Sources. Elena Danaan: A Gift from the Stars (2020) through Encyclopedia Galactica (2024), and her sessions published by Michael Salla on exopolitics.org. The Russian "Alien Races Book" (2013); the Hermetic Asclepius 37 and Poimandres; Daniel 4:17.

The Andromedan council: the Zenetae hosts, the Lygon, the Zelaan
Proposed reading — fit 6.5/10. A multi-population assembly fits the distinction between host peoples and participating delegates. Shared deliberation and judgment explain its role alongside the other councils. Supporting account. The Andromedan council is a council of many ET (extraterrestrial) peoples that meets in the home system of the Zenetae, blue-skinned humans of the Lyran human family who settled two star systems in the Andromeda constellation about 2.5 million years ago (8/10 that the Zenetae are of that family). Its side is pro-human. The Zenetae host the council and do not rule it. What it is. Its size is given as 133 races (Collier, 1994), 173 star systems (Collier, 2002) or 140 species (Danaan). It is in the Andromeda constellation, not the Andromeda galaxy (the adopted conclusion, October 6, 2026); the competing addresses are Titawin, Mirach, and the stars numbered 42 and 44. It is a separate body from the Galactic Federation of Worlds and sits with it at Jupiter. Its aims are spiritual development and stopping a future tyranny that Collier traces to Earth, the Moon and Mars. Who they are. The Zenetae's ancestors left Lyra in a war and, with help from the people of Cassiopeia, settled "star 42" (Zenetae, with two suns) and "star 44" (Tishtae). They turned blue from their food and their double sun, are physical though of the fifth density, and live 1,200 to 2,700 years (Collier). Danaan's Zenae men are blue and the women fairer, sometimes golden-haired. Collier's contacts were Zenetae envoys: Moraney, light blue, hairless and 7.5 to 8 feet tall, and Vasais, bald, white, under 5 feet tall and 4,312 years old. The Lygon are tall, purple-skinned and golden-eyed, and the Zelaan are seven-foot, blue, lion-like beings (Danaan). Short history. In 2001-2002 the council admitted a family of the line of Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7, whom Collier calls Pa'tah, and kept out Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7 (7/10). Enki's faction and Enlil's faction of the House of Anu Star Empire (both ET flesh and blood of ED, extradimensional, and archonic ancestry) were at war over who would own the humans, and this ET council took Enki's family in. Why: preventing a future tyranny connects human development to the council's security. Sky lore. Andromeda's head and breast, with the star Mirach, are the Babylonian figure Anunitum, the warrior form of Ishtar, who stands in Hathor10/Athyr10/Lady of Byblos8/Aphrodite8/Venus8/Inanna8/Ishtar8/Astarte8/Sekhmet7.5/Amaterasu7.5, so the hosts' sky lies in her branch (6.5/10). The blue bodies of Krishna10/Govinda10/Vasudeva9.5/Kanha9.5/Kannan9.5 and of the people of Vishnu10/Hari10/Narayana9/Mal8.5/Mayon8.5 match the Zenetae's look (7/10). Andromeda married Perseus, who stands in Lugh10/Lug10/Lleu Llaw Gyffes8.5/Lugus8/Perseus7.5/Huangfei7: in real life, an alliance of houses by marriage (6/10). The Cassiopeia-Andromeda family is the memory of the Zenetae's bond with Collier's Cassiopeians (6.5/10). Sources. Alex Collier: the 1994 interview, Defending Sacred Ground (1996), the 1998 Art Bell transcript and the March 18, 2002 talk. Elena Danaan: A Gift from the Stars (2020) through Encyclopedia Galactica (2024). MUL.APIN; the Bhagavata Purana 10.23.22 and 3.15.14; Apollodorus 2.4.

Ashtar Galactic Command (Sirius B): the operators of the city in Jupiter's upper atmosphere
Proposed reading — fit 6/10. An allied fleet organization fits the recurring command, bodily operators and maintained installation. The institutional reading explains a name shared by many participants. Supporting account. The Ashtar Galactic Command is a people, not a single being: an ET (extraterrestrial) allied fleet with its own command, made up mostly of T-Ashkeru humanoids from Sirius B, which built and holds the floating city base in Jupiter's upper atmosphere (6.5/10). Its side is unknown. None of its members is UT (born on Earth directly of an ET star-empire parent). What it is. Elena Danaan describes the command as a separatist faction that broke from the Ashtar Collective of Sirius B, took the side of the Galactic Federation of Worlds and gives it "good mercenary service". Its people are mostly T-Ashkeru, "human size of Terra with big eyes, triangular heads" (Myrah) (8/10). Danaan calls the Collective it broke from regressive. Short history. The base in Jupiter's upper atmosphere is a ship under a great dome that "landed a very long time ago". It is a military facility the command shares with the Federation for diplomatic meetings, among them the meetings of July 2021. Val Nek says the base on Ganymede, Jupiter's largest moon, is theirs too, and the combined lore counts Jupiter and Ganymede as one location. George Van Tassel first gave the name at Giant Rock in the Mojave Desert of California in 1952: "Ashtar, commandant quadra sector, patrol station Schare". His "patrol station Schare" is Danaan's "Shar" outpost. In the Baal Cycle of Ugarit, on the Syrian coast, the same name belongs to the being the register places with the first fallen (7.5/10). The succession account combines temporary appointment to Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7's seat with failure to retain that authority and a subsequent claim to rule (KTU 1.6 I). The office transition supplies the proposed connection. In real life: while Baal-Hadad was out of action, the first fallen was installed in his seat of rule over Syria and Canaan, could not hold it, and took direct rule over Earth's peoples instead (6.5/10 for the name and the vacant-seat pattern). Sirius also ties the command to the fish sages of Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7 and to the Nommo, whose "small, very heavy" companion star the Dogon of Mali described (6/10). Why: an independently commanded fleet provides military service and a shared meeting facility while retaining its own chain of command. Sources. Elena Danaan's books A Gift from the Stars (2020), We Will Never Let You Down (2021), The Seeders (2022) and Encyclopedia Galactica (2024), elenadanaan.org, and her emails and sessions published by Michael Salla on exopolitics.org give the command's history. Alex Collier's 1994 video interview, Defending Sacred Ground, the 1998 Art Bell transcript and the March 18, 2002 Global Sciences talk give the council background. George Van Tassel's 1952 Giant Rock messages give the name's first modern use. The Baal Cycle (KTU 1.6 I) and Isaiah 14:12-15 give the vacant-seat account. The combined lore's record 2026-10-05-jupiter-galactic-councils-full-research.md and register section 15 hold the full research.

The Orion pursuers and the Orion empire (the Nebu)
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. A dynastic pursuit programme fits the repeated interest in female lines, children and inherited capacities. Different pursuing factions can share that motive while remaining politically distinct. Supporting account. The Orion pursuers are the Orion branch of the hunters of the Seven, the House of Anu Star Empire's daughters, who are hunted for their children and bloodlines. The hunters are not one faction: the October 21, 2026 reading names three (7.5/10), the Great Bear line of Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7, recorded by the most peoples and standing in its own box, Orion of Poseidon's line, and a Watcher. It began as men of the House of Anu Star Empire, whose embodied empire is ET (extraterrestrial) flesh and blood of ED (extradimensional) and archonic ancestry, and their sons born on Earth, and in modern accounts it operates as the Orion empire that Elena Danaan calls the Nebu, an ET alliance of reptiloid and Grey peoples allied with the Draco (7.5/10). Anti-human, 8/10. What race and house. The house is that of Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8. The House is the ET star-empire; the embodied Watchers' later descent is a separate history. Orion, the chief pursuer in Greek lore, is a son of Poseidon10/Neptune9/Nethuns9/Yam8/Nahar7.5/Pa-Yam7.5/Pontos7 born on Earth, so the house's offspring (7.5/10); Poseidon fathered giants, and Orion is one of them. MUL.APIN calls Orion "the True Shepherd of Anu": in real life, an officer of Anu. The Nebu are the Eban of Betelgeuse, the Grail of Mintaka and the Indugutk of Bellatrix, with the Maytra, the Vela Kiily-Tokurt and the Ciakahrr. The Ciakahrr are the people of Tia, Danaan's Ciakahrr queen for the Orion zone, whom the register equates with Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5. Anu's political marriage with Tiamat gave her territory and a recognised succession route in Orion, which was both a genuine grant and a monitored containment that kept her away from Earth (9/10). The name Nebu echoes Nabu, son of Marduk10/Amar-Utu10/Marutuk10/Shun7.5/Chonghua7.5 (6/10). In Egypt the same Orion stars belong to Osiris10/Usir10/Yama8.5/Yima8.5/Jamshid8.5/Dionysus8/Mot8/Hades7.5, who is on the ordered side and stands in his own box, not in this faction. Who they are. Orion chased Pleione and the Seven for seven years and assaulted Merope: in real life, a sustained pursuit of the House's women, with one assault. Ayish, whom the Latin and King James Bibles translate as Arcturus "with his sons" (Job 38:32), demands Kimah's children (Talmud, Berakhot 58b): the Talmud's Bear, read as Baal-Hadad's Great Bear line hunting beside the Orion branch (7.5/10). Brahma10/Fantian9.5/Bonten9.5/Prajapati9/Ka8.5/Hiranyagarbha8.5, named Prajapati in this telling, pursued his own daughter, Rohini, beside the Pleiades and was shot by Shiva10/Mahadeva10/Rudra9.5/Sharva9/Bhava9/Saurva7.5: in real life, Shiva stopped him by force (6.5/10 for his place here). Wati Nyiru10/Nyiru10/Yurla9/Yurlu9 of the Aboriginal Seven Sisters songlines of central and western Australia takes other forms to trap the Seven Sisters: in real life, he uses disguise. The Arab Dabaran (Aldebaran, "the follower") wooed Thurayya, the Pleiades, was refused, and follows her still with his herd as the bride-price: in real life, the same refused claim on the Seven, still pursued. Why. The House of Anu Star Empire's men (ET flesh and blood, with their ET allies) and the Seven (ET) were at odds over who would own the bloodlines the Seven bear: possession of the mothers means possession of the lines (7/10). These are lines humans come from, so the pursuers are enemies of the human lines (7/10). The author's reading of their ethic is that the Orions were less empathetic from the start and try to cheat their way, which no rule forbids but which is not as good as it could be. Short history. The Greek telling ends Orion with a scorpion, which is struck as fairy tale; death in these accounts is not an ending, and no account ends the chase, so it is still active (8/10). The Orion wars of the modern contact accounts are this same chase. The Tiamat-Kingu war on Earth, approximately 290,000 years ago in the current working placement, was a decisive Earth front of those wars (8/10) and did not end them (3/10 that it ended every Orion war). By Danaan's account the Nebu were dismantled by 2025. Sources. The Greek Orion tellings, Job 38:31-32, Talmud Berakhot 58b, MUL.APIN, the Indian telling of Prajapati and Rohini, the Seven Sisters songlines and the Arab telling of Dabaran and Thurayya give the old accounts. Elena Danaan gives the Nebu. Register sections 3.1, 3.6, 3.7, 3.26 and 4.13 hold the names.

The Selosi of Alpha Centauri and their colony inside the Earth (Telos)
Proposed reading — fit 6.5/10. A continuing off-world people with a local colony fits the shared bodily profile, collective history and maintained agreements. The relation is a population connection rather than a single visitor's identity. Supporting account. The Selosi are an ET (extraterrestrial), human-shaped people from Selo in Alpha Centauri, with a descendant colony at Telos beneath Mount Shasta; their relationship to Earth is rated 6.5/10. Their side is changed or divided. People, home and affiliations. Tall, white-skinned and white-haired, the Selosi are not a Lyran population. Their home system is the nearby Alpha Centauri, about 4.4 light years away. Danaan assigns them a High Council seat and identifies them as the mother population of the Telosi. Neither population is an individual, so neither receives a personal name conglomerate. Settlement and division. Danaan places their settlement before the last Ice Age. In her account, with Pleiadian settlers they founded or led Atlantis, spread into the American continent, western Africa and western Europe, and later established the underground Telos settlement. The movement underground is relocation of a population, not transformation into disembodied spirits. Interbreeding with Terrans makes the colony a continuing biological community rather than a permanently separate visiting crew. Mirkak, the named Telosian speaker, says he was born on Terra and that the Telosians were previously called Selosi. That explains why a person can identify with both names: one names the ancestral people, the other the terrestrial colony. Danaan also calls them Agharians, Shining Ones and Sidhe. The shared Sidhe label does not make them the Tuatha; that proposed identification remains 4.5/10. Their politics divided. One faction joined the Washington-Telos alliance alongside Greys and reptilians; another joined the Federation. Why: settlement made the Selosi participants in Earth's competing alliances, and common ancestry did not force their factions to choose the same partners. Sources. Elena Danaan, A Gift from the Stars (2020), Selosi account; Mirkak communication, August 13, 2020. KOB box SEL, version 116.

The Ohorai: the Arcturian people at the crossing
Proposed reading — fit 6/10. An ascending allied population fits the combination of high-phase descriptions and continuing contact duties. The crossing association supplies the proposed practical function in the wider developmental programme. Supporting account. The Ohorai are Danaan's Arcturian people: an ET (extraterrestrial) population associated with a planet orbiting Arcturus, allied with the Federation rather than belonging to the House of Anu Star Empire; the overall score is 6/10. Their side is pro-human, and the account reads them as ET ascending. An older population at a crossing. Danaan describes the Ohorai as having passed into seventh and ninth densities and as Federation members from its beginning. Here the density language describes an altered mode of embodiment and perception, not a second astronomical measurement. Development beyond ordinary physical form is rated 5.5/10. Arcturus is about 37 light years away: an orange giant roughly seven billion years old, around two and a half billion years older than the Sun. That older setting supplies time for a population's development; it does not date the Ohorai themselves. The claimed home planet has no confirmed astronomical identification. Danaan gives the Ohorai bases inside mountains in many countries and on the Moon. Those are stations through which an older civilization maintains access to Earth. Arcturus and the House of Anu Star Empire. Arcturus was probably an early centre of the House of Anu Star Empire's ancestral population, including the hairy human-shaped lineage (8/10); Danaan's account of the house passing through the region can describe a later migration or political entry. Neither makes the Ohorai members of that house. The separate ruler Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7 is associated with an office of declaring fates there. Edgar Cayce's description of Arcturus as a passage for souls entering and leaving this solar system supplies the crossing function, rated 6.5/10. Why the Ohorai matter: their bases, Federation membership and association with a passage place an older resident people beside the routes used by other populations, without making those populations one house. Sources. Elena Danaan, Arcturian/Ohorai account; Edgar Cayce on Arcturus. KOB box OHO, version 116; Name Equations Register section 3.3.
