The P'tal and the Seeders: carriers of the human form, not its makers
Proposed reading — fit 6.5/10. The carrier-and-cultivator reading fits because the Seeders already possess the human Form while describing their later biological work. That sequence connects prior design with local adaptation. Supporting account. The Seeders are ET (extraterrestrial) peoples of other galaxies, organized as the Intergalactic Confederation, who carry and cultivate the human form rather than inventing it; the overall score is 6.5/10. Their side is pro-human. The current classification keeps them as ET flesh and blood: their capacity for dimensional travel does not reclassify the entire population as ED (extradimensional). People and places. The Alteans are one named population. Danaan places their world Emerya in the Altea system of galaxy NGC 7331, about forty million light years away in the direction of Pegasus. Oona, their emissary, is described as about nine feet tall, with creamy-white hair and very slanted, clear blue eyes. Tayel, Oona's partner and a fleet admiral, is the named representative who accuses the Anunnaki of interfering in the Confederation's genetic experiment without permission. These are members of an intergalactic organization, not officers of the local House of Anu Star Empire. Danaan uses P'tal or Pa-Taal for the original humanoid race and also collectively for the Seeder races. Her description gives tall bodies with long necks. Collier describes the Paa Tal as descending from an eleventh-density condition into third-density embodiment. What they made, and why. They already have the human form when they arrive. Their contribution is biological: placing the human family in Lyra and designing the terrestrial version of the genome; their retained contact chronology places Seeder work on indigenous primate ancestry about 65 million years ago, not the origin of all terrestrial life or of the human Form. The distinction matters because later rulers can alter a population without having originated either its pattern or its ancestry. The account rates the higher design followed by intervention from the House of Anu Star Empire at 7/10. The Apocryphon of John supplies the older pattern: the rulers see the image of the higher Human reflected in the water and make a body after it. In real life that body is the psychic, energetic soul-body, which is all the ED archons built; the flesh comes from the ET history: Achamoth's human Form, the Seeders, Tiamat and the House of Anu Star Empire (The author). Adam Kadmon and Pigeradamas designate the intelligible human pattern; their relation to later bodies is rated 7.5/10. Why: the Seeders cultivate embodied human populations from a form already available, while the Anunnaki seek control of and make changes to an existing project. Why Earth was seeded. The Seeders did not choose an already established Naga world for an ordinary new colony. Their work began with Achamoth's Earth project before the later Laan and Draco colonial war; natural evolution and directed panspermia are therefore two levels of the same development. Their twenty-four cultures pursue the general advanced-civilization work of cultivating greater Epinoia, while non-interference preserves the human discovery that the older cultures cannot supply. Their positions on and near Earth. They kept Himalayan, Atlantic and Ganymede observation positions without openly ruling Terra. Danaan describes the Himalayan base's P'taal personnel as tall, discreet, white-haired humanoids; the Yeti are a guardian or perimeter population at the approaches to that installation (8/10), not the P'taal themselves (3/10). Danaan's Seeder account makes Atlaa, Atlantis, a settlement built from an Altean mother-vessel in the Atlantic (9/10 within her account). Danaan places the returning Confederation fleet near Jupiter from October 2021 and gives the Confederation authority to summon the regional king, Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7, whom she calls Yuh. The craft tradition. Ptah10/Phthas10/Hephaistos8.5/Vulcan8/Kothar7.5 is compared with the P'tal at 6.5/10, not merged with them: a named individual cannot be equated with an entire people. The Shabaka Stone calls the craftsman the father who made Atum, a name within Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8. The comparison places skilled makers before the local royal line. The Greek craft stories describe Pandora's fashioned body and golden attendants capable of understanding, speech and action. Their practical meaning is the manufacture of bodies and responsive artificial servants, rated 7/10. The Egyptian mouth-opening rite concerns activating speech and the senses in a fashioned or revived body, 6.5/10. The resemblance between Ptah and Hebrew patach, open, is a deed-based comparison at 6/10, not a demonstrated name derivation. A webinar-summary report describes Ninhursag10/Nintu9/Ninmah9/Dingirmah9/Belet-ili9/Mami9/Aruru8.5/Cihuacoatl7.5/Nuwa8 as carrying a Seeder soul in a made body. That proposed connection is rated 6/10, with the full source quotation still to be checked. Sources. Vasuki, Shesha, Takshaka and Kaliya with the Naga houses
Proposed reading — fit 9/10. A surviving technically capable people fits the combined regeneration, controlled reproduction, guarded resources and sustained personal politics. Named dissidents and rival rulers explain the decentralized aftermath of the adopted Draco–Laan war. Supporting account. The Naga houses are the surviving serpent-associated ET (extraterrestrial) flesh-and-blood population left on Terra after the first Terran colonial war: the Nagai branch of the Ciakahrr (Draco) invasion force, which became a confederacy of hereditary houses. The box rates 9/10. Nagas as surviving Nagai/Ciakahrr forces from the Draco-Laan war (the Laan-Ciakahrr war) on Terra is 9/10; the Naga empire as a confederation descended from a defeated colonial army is 9/10, and as one uniform centralized state 4/10. A Draco-side colonial inheritance is 8.5/10, and the embodied-political evidence 9/10. They are not a branch of Tiamat's household and not automatically fay; later out-of-phase residence does not change their ancestry. Political division created rival houses, not a second species: Vasuki10/Basuki10, Shesha10/Ananta10/Adishesha10/Antaboga9, the princess Ulupi10/Uluchi9.5 and Mucalinda10/Mucilinda10 belong to houses that protect, marry, negotiate with or teach Terrans (pro-human, 7.5/10), while Takshaka10/Dechajia9 and Kaliya10/Kalingan9.5 lead militant houses that attack Terran lines or resources (anti-human, 8/10). "Good" and "evil" here describe conduct and political alignment, not biological qualities. On their present survival the author ruled (October 3, 2026) that the arguments for the Nagas as a real people are convincing, but they remain "a psyop until we get better evidence they still exist", a psyop being a psychological operation. Short history. Approximately one million years ago the Laan established a colony on Terra and modified existing hominids. The Ciakahrr imperial command arrived shortly afterward to seize the colony and enslave the modified Terrans, and the Nagai, serpent-associated Draco colonial soldiers and settlers, fought on the Ciakahrr side. The modern account reports a war of about 7,000 years (about 70,000 years is retained as a proposed alternative) that destroyed whole civilizations; it ended with one Ciakahrr and Nagai faction withdrawing underground while the remaining Draco troops left the Solar system. The survivors kept advanced knowledge but lost the system behind it: the main fleets had gone, their installations on Terra were damaged, their numbers were reduced, communication with the imperial command was interrupted and their groups were separated. A common wartime cause for the Naga retreat, Laani withdrawal and an ancestral human population decline is retained as a working inference. The survivors occupied water-connected settlements, islands, subterranean regions and concealed mountain approaches, some reachable only through dimensional access, and their commanders, maternal houses and settlements became hereditary kingdoms. The Slovenian and Dinaric cave-dragon tradition preserves a western branch (8.5/10), and the Olmec ruling culture of Mexico's Gulf Coast retained knowledge from both the Laan and the Nagai (8.5/10). The mothers and the compact. Kadru, "Tawny" or "Brown", and Surasa are both remembered as mothers of the serpent population; one genealogy makes Kadru the mother of the serpent lines, and another makes Surasa mother of the Nagas and Kadru mother of the Pannagas. Kadru as the hardline ancestral matriarch is 8/10; Kadru and Surasa as two related maternal founders 8/10, and as two names or offices of one founder 7/10. The civilization possessed incubation capability, so a thousand incubated descendants is a literal production claim at 8.5/10, and the thousand as an impossible, fairy-tale number is 1/10. "Mother of every snake" rates 8.5/10 as motherhood of every Naga house or serpent-body template and 5/10 as motherhood of every zoological snake. Kadru's branch kept the older Draco habits: strong maternal authority, strict clan obedience, controlled knowledge, deception and collective punishment. The Naga population existed before the compact of houses joined through Kashyapa, who stands in Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8; Kadru's descendants combine the older maternal population with Kashyapa's paternal contribution (actual common paternity 8/10), and preserved seed allows direct offspring at widely separated times without his presence. Kadru ordered her descendants to falsify the colour of a royal horse's tail to win a wager, punished those who refused and enslaved Vinata, until Vinata's son Garuda10/Vainateya10/Suparna9.5/Khrut9.5/Karura9/Garutman8.5/Tarkshya8/Khyung7.5 obtained the amrita treatment as ransom and freed her: in real life, the Naga and winged houses competed for rank and freedom inside the compact, and the official government kept control of the longevity supply. Government. Bhogavati, the "Prosperous" or "Possessing City", is the remembered capital. The Mahabharata calls it the foremost Naga city and names Vasuki as ruler; another passage names Vasuki, Takshaka and Airavata together. The Ramayana places it on the southern search route by Mount Kunjara, with broad roads, fortifications and guarded approaches. Bhogavati as a historical political capital is 8/10, as accessible through concealed physical and dimensional routes 7/10, and its exact location 2/10; Naga government as a confederacy of houses is 9/10. Vasuki is the principal confederate king (8.5/10): he presides over councils, negotiates with outside powers and speaks for the collective when it faces extermination. Takshaka and Airavata appear as co-rulers or major house leaders in another account; the political reading of the record as a confederacy of several houses, rather than one people divided cleanly into good and evil, is 8/10. Airavata is a Naga military and transport house later attached to Set, Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7 (8.5/10). Shesha, Vasuki's elder brother, says his brothers are jealous and cruel toward Vinata and her son, leaves Kadru's household and asks to remain separate from their conduct: a senior political and moral dissident (7/10), who shows that Draco ancestry does not determine moral character. The later account makes him support Earth and serve as the resting foundation of Vishnu10/Hari10/Narayana9/Mal8.5/Mayon8.5: in real life, he accepted a terrestrial stabilizing responsibility; the stabilizing title is 9/10, and a literal body physically holding Earth is 1/10. Shesha means remainder; Ananta means endless. Ulupi, a princess of Kauravya's river-connected house, marries the Pandava prince Arjuna, takes him to her river palace and bears his son Iravan; after Arjuna's own son kills him, she restores him with the Naga jewel. Mucalinda shelters the Buddha through seven days of storm. Buddhist accounts say Nagarjuna recovered the Perfection of Wisdom teaching from the Nagas' library: in real life, a teaching text held by Naga keepers. Patala. Patala is unresolved. Out-of-phase territory is 6/10, because inhabitants repeatedly pass between the human world and a separate lower realm. A concealed southern, subterranean or water-accessed physical territory is 6.5/10, because the Ramayana gives Bhogavati a geographic route, mountain association, roads and fortifications. A later cosmological lower world imposed upon older political memories is 8/10, because the Puranic seven Patalas belong to an explicit world-structure account. The three readings can overlap. Bhogavati is the capital; Nagaloka is the Naga realm; Patala and Rasatala are lower regions assigned differently by different texts. The hostile houses' wars. Arjuna and Krishna10/Govinda10/Vasudeva9.5/Kanha9.5/Kannan9.5 destroy the forest held by Takshaka's population, killing his wife; the resulting personal grievance connects the later attacks to the same household. Takshaka's son Ashvasena subsequently attacks Arjuna, continuing the household grievance. Takshaka then killed King Parikshit, Arjuna's grandson and the protected heir. Parikshit's son Janamejaya answered with the snake sacrifice, an extermination campaign, and Astika, the human-Naga descendant whose birth Vasuki negotiated, stopped it. Kaliya’s conflict with Garuda makes him a refugee; his subsequent seizure and poisoning of a river leads to conflict with Krishna. Displacement and contested resources supply the political connection. Why: the record preserves displacement, retaliation, succession politics, resource control and attempted extermination beneath the serpent imagery, not a war between humans and ordinary snakes. That political sequence is 8/10; every participant being one zoological reptilian species is 4/10. Their later position. By the time the House of Anu Star Empire became Terra's dominant foreign government, the Nagas had been weakened by the first war, abandonment by the imperial forces, the loss of their colonial infrastructure, division into houses, Kadru's purge of dissenters, the conflict with Vinata and Garuda, the loss of unrestricted access to amrita, and the rivalry of Vasuki's diplomacy with Takshaka's militancy. When Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5 later established her position on Terra, the houses already existed. Tiamat as their creator or immediate mother is 3/10, and as a later political relative able to recruit Naga support 7.5/10; shared serpent-human presentation and water association make Tiamat's line only a distant cousin comparison (5.5/10). The Naga houses remained the strongest organised serpent-associated remnant on Terra after the Tiamat-Kingu war of about 290,000 years ago (9/10). Bodies and technology. The governing inference is that amrita-like regenerative material developed naturally in an aquatic, serpentine, eel-like or fish-like organism, or was engineered from that biology, and was then introduced into human-template bodies. Deliberate engineering from aquatic-serpentine biology is 9.2/10; a natural virus or symbiont later brought under control is 8.8/10; accidental infection later mastered is 8.4/10. The Naga and related rulers are therefore a were-serpent population: human-template beings carrying a maintained regenerative condition that can produce serpent-like configurations, skin renewal, spinal-current effects, aquatic presentations, body-changing and extreme repair (9.1/10). A controlled ruling-caste treatment is 9/10; one naturally evolved reptilian intelligent species explaining the complete record is 3.2/10. The condition connects Apsu and Tiamat's aquatic-serpentine forms, Naga transformations, amrita, kundalini and Hydra regeneration without making the later Naga houses identical with Tiamat. The Nagas adapted an existing Terran herpes lineage rather than importing an unchanged reptilian virus (9/10) as a persistent neural carrier for modification and regeneration (9.5/10 as a platform; 8.5/10 as intended principally for modification, regeneration and advancement; 4/10 as intended principally as a weapon). Surviving lore attributes herpes zoster to a Naga (9.5/10), and modern herpes is read as the degraded carrier without the original restorative payload (8/10). Amrita is the guarded activation and stabilization treatment for that platform (9/10), so control of amrita is political control over longevity. Vasuki serving as the rope in the churning of the ocean records his indispensable participation in a joint operation whose prize is extended life, and Shesha assists with the mountain in another passage: in real life, the Naga contribution was necessary before the treatment became available. Political participation in the undertaking is 9/10; the rope image does not establish a literal machine, living tool or energetic current, and any one engineering account is presently below 5/10. The egg genealogies preserve deliberate control of reproduction and house lines (8/10). Fertility and adult maturation were separately administered (10/10): a ruling house let dependent lines reproduce while withholding the maturation technology, so no fertile juvenile line could grow into an adult rival (9.5/10). The olm, Proteus anguinus, the Slovenian cave amphibian called a cave dragon, is the fertile juvenile Naga body of the local branch (9.5/10). Ulupi's jewel, the Samjivana-mani, is an external activator of the installed Naga regenerative system (8.5/10): a thought-authorized biological restoration controller that sends a patterned bioelectric command (9.5/10), while cellular metabolism supplies the construction energy (10/10), installed organic nanotechnology or engineered repair cells rebuild the tissue (9/10) and a higher-frequency cold-plasma or consciousness-field current carries coherence (8/10); it is a portable emergency development of amrita technology (8.5/10). Names, words and comparisons. Vasuki10/Basuki10 is a direct regional name continuation. Shesha10/Ananta10/Adishesha10/Antaboga9 is one title sequence: Remainder, Endless, Primordial Shesha, and the Javanese-Balinese continuation. Ahir Budhnya, the Serpent of the Deep, is an older Vedic functional antecedent to Shesha at 6/10, not a secure personal identity. Balarama/Sankarshana is later declared a manifestation of Shesha; this supports office or current continuity at 6/10, not necessarily one historical body. Kadru has no defensible cross-cultural personal equation, and Surasa is a competing or parallel maternal genealogy, not automatically the same person. Chinese dragon kings preserve the same water-government functions as Naga rulers; individual personal identities remain open. Slovene olm is pronounced approximately ohlm; Old Norse ormr and related Germanic orm or wyrm mean serpent or dragon. The sound-and-serpent comparison belongs in the record (7/10); direct derivation of Slovene olm from Old Norse ormr remains 4/10. The Naga water kingdoms share traits with water-folk of fay kind at 6/10. The Nagas as water teachers are 5.5/10: they guard waters and treasures and kept the teaching library named above. One water family with fish and serpent forms is 6/10; Nagas and fish-sages as the same people is 4.5/10. Sources. Mahabharata, Adi Parva: Kadru's command and curse; Shesha separates from his violent brothers; Vasuki's survival council; the marriage arranged to produce Astika; the incubation of Kadru's and Vinata's offspring. Mahabharata, Udyoga Parva: Bhogavati and its rulers. Mahabharata, Ashvamedhika Parva 14.81: Ulupi's life-restoring jewel. Ramayana, Kishkindha Kanda 4.41: Bhogavati on the southern search route. Bhagavad Gita 10.28-29: Vasuki among serpents and Ananta among Nagas. Bhagavata Purana 10.16. Buddhist accounts of Mucalinda (Udana 2.1) and Nagarjuna. The Puranas on Vasuki, Shesha and the seven Patalas. Danaan's Laan and Terran Wars account. Valvasor (1689) and the Slovenian Ethnographic Museum on the Bela Valley dragon; Newar and South Indian records of herpes zoster as a Naga affliction. KOB versions 72 and 91; the October 14, 2026 chapter on Kingu, Eden and pterosis.

Ereshkigal: Inanna's sister, who with Nergal runs the House's prison dimension below (Tartarus, entrance underground) and its workshop
Proposed reading — fit 7/10. A prison-and-restoration jurisdiction fits the ordered access rules, confinement and specially organized rescue. The family relationship explains both the claimant's access and the personal stakes of the conflict. Supporting account. Ereshkigal10/Allatu8.5/Irkalla8/Allani7.5/Persephone7 is a woman of the House of Anu Star Empire, ET flesh and blood (ET means extraterrestrial) with ED/archon ancestry (ED means extradimensional), and Inanna's elder sister. With her husband Nergal10/Erra9/Meslamtaea9/Resheph8 she runs the station below, the Kur: the House of Anu Star Empire's prison dimension, which the Greeks called Tartarus, with its entrance underground (the author's ruling, October 21, 2026), and a physical workshop for nanotechnology, cloning and biorobotics (7/10). Holding a station with dimensional facilities does not make her a native ED being. What it is Her sister is Inanna10/Ishtar10/Innin10/Inuruanna9/Astarte8.5/Shaushka8/Aphrodite8/Venus8/Turan7.5, of the House of Anu Star Empire; Ereshkigal's first husband Gugalanna belongs to the same family; in Nergal and Ereshkigal, Nergal descends, marries her and becomes king below: in real life, a House member who took joint command of the station (7/10). Kur is Sumerian for "mountain" and "foreign land". The author first left open whether the station is a base under the ground or a lower dimension; his ruling of October 21, 2026 settles it as a prison dimension whose entrance is underground. The station's offices of judging and holding the dead, the Sumerian me, bind their holder to stay there. Short history Inanna's descent, as it happened: seven security checkpoints removed all her devices (crown, beads, breastplate, ring, measuring rod, robe); seven judges tried her; she was executed by a weapon or a deadly look ("the eye of death"); her body was stored ("hung on a hook"); and a treatment revived her ("the food of life and the water of life") (7/10). Enlil and Nanna refused to help; Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7 made the two who brought her back, the kurgarra and the galatura, engineered rescuers carrying the restorative materials. inference (the author's): they are an example, or the start, of the sexless Grey drones. They won Ereshkigal's cooperation by answering her distress with sympathy and asked for the body, so their success depended on her giving it up (8/10 for this technological reading). Inanna's release still required a substitute. Chronology: the descent date remains open; preparation, entry, confinement and rescue preserve the order of events. The dead there are "clothed like birds with wings", with dust for food: souls held out of their bodies in deprivation (6.5/10). Souls that lack knowledge are "cast into prison" again, into another body (Apocryphon of John; 7/10). Ishtar's threat to "raise up the dead to eat the living" means held souls let out to feed on the living through possession and draining (5/10); walking corpses 1/10. Why it matters: the House of Anu Star Empire (ET flesh and blood) uses the station to hold, judge, drain and re-embody human souls and to make bodies, so whoever holds its offices controls that part of the human harvest. Sources Descent of Inanna; Descent of Ishtar; Nergal and Ereshkigal; Apocryphon of John.

Sebitti: the warrior seven
Proposed reading — fit 7.5/10. An Earth-born imperial military unit fits the direct parentage, coordinated deployment and destructive capability. Protective uses in later practice explain the divided conduct assigned to the group. Supporting account. The Sebitti are seven warriors whom Anu fathered on Earth with Gia, Earth's own living being, as their mother: born on Earth directly of a parent of the ET (extraterrestrial) star-empire and not part human, so UT (ultraterrestrial) (6.5/10). Their father's house, the House of Anu Star Empire, is ET flesh and blood whose ancestry reaches back to ED (extradimensional) archons. Their side is changed or divided; the box is rated 7.5/10. What race and house Sebitti (Sebettu) names a group, and groups are not joined into name conglomerates. Their father is Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8. The Erra Epic (tablet I) says Anu "sowed his seed in Earth" and she bore him the Seven: in real life, beings Anu fathered with Earth's own living being, Gaia10/Ge10/Terra9/Tellus9/Cel8/Ki7.5, as their mother, which the author reads as the planet's animated living system. They are the house's offspring with ED technology, born here and not among those who came from elsewhere (8/10), so no home world is given for them. If "Earth" there means the old order's queen, Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5, they would be her children (5.5/10, open). Short history Anu gave the Seven to Nergal10/Erra9/Meslamtaea9/Resheph8 as his unit of war and plague (Erra Epic I). They urged Erra to strike the humans of Mesopotamia, present-day Iraq, for their noise: in real life, a military unit pressing for a cull of the human population. This matches the adopted conclusion on the Flood: some beings sent it on purpose to quiet human "mind noise", and some did not know. Assyrian households in present-day northern Iraq buried figures of the Seven under their foundations to guard against harm, so the account marks the Seven "changed or divided": the House of Anu Star Empire was divided over whether to cull the human resource or keep it, and the Sebitti's record holds both sides. Their office was tied to two star groups (6.5/10). Babylon named the Pleiades MUL.MUL, "the Seven", after them. China puts Anu's seven star sons on the Great Bear, born to Doumu, who stands in Danu10/Ana8/Antu8/Don7/Doumu7/Ziguang7/Marici7/Molizhitian7/Nammu7, and to Zhou Yu, who stands with Anu (7/10 each); India pairs the Great Bear's seven sages with the Pleiades' seven wives, the Krittikas. The other Seven The hostile Seven of the incantations are a different group: ED energy demons outside the physical star-empire, not Anu's flesh-and-blood children; they have their own box. Why: Anu equips Erra with a military unit whose destructive capacity can also guard households. Sources The Erra Epic, tablet I; Assyrian foundation figures of the Seven; the Babylonian star name MUL.MUL; the Chinese Northern Dipper scripture; the Indian Krittikas.

Atlas and Epimetheus: the Earth-born Titan household
Proposed reading — fit 6.5/10. An older descendant household fits the connected family, defeat and continuing exceptional duties. The repeated links to later champions explain continuity after loss of government. Supporting account. The Titans of Atlas's household descend from Ouranos, who stands with Anu, and Gia, Earth's own living being: born on Earth of the ET (extraterrestrial) star-empire's line and not part human, so UT (ultraterrestrial) (6/10). Atlas and Epimetheus are the Titan side that the house's ruling line defeated; that side is pro-human, and the box is rated 6.5/10. What race and house Atlas is one being: the Titan, father of the Pleiades, and the son of Poseidon10/Neptune9/Nethuns9/Yam8/Nahar7.5/Pa-Yam7.5/Pontos7 in Plato's Critias, so the sea line and the older generation meet in him. His names are Atlas10/Aril8.5/Upelluri7; Epimetheus has no second name. Their father in the Greek record is Iapetus; Ouranos and Gia belong to the preceding Titan ancestry, not a second pair of immediate parents. Their house is the House of Anu Star Empire, Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8, ET flesh and blood with ED (extradimensional)/archon ancestry. The Titan mother line runs through Earth's own living being, Gaia10/Ge10/Terra9/Tellus9/Cel8/Ki7.5, not through the elder Gaia of the off-world line Gaia/Pontus to Ceto/Phorcys to Echidna/Tiamat, who shares the name; that line is the Greek rhapsodes' tidy family tree and weak evidence (The author, October 21, 2026). The UT reading rates 6/10 because the Hurrian Song of Kumarbi gives the older line a different parentage. The house shifts its bodies out of phase into ED levels and back into three-dimensional Earth by technology whenever it wants. Their brother Prometheus is Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7 (8.5/10); his story is in the Prometheus/Ea/Enki box. The reading of Prometheus as Azazel10/Asael9/Azael8 is lowered to 4/10. Short history The ruling line of the House of Anu Star Empire and the older generation with its Earth-born Titans were at war over who would rule Earth and its humans, and the Titans who stood with the humans lost. Atlas fought Zeus, who stands in Enlil10/Ellil10/Illinos9.5/Zeus8.5/Jupiter8.5/Tinia8/Odin8/Woden8/Wodan8/Wotan8/Godan7.5/Vayu7.5/Ziwei7, in the Titan war (Hesiod, Theogony 507-616); the Greeks also told some wars of Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7 under Zeus's name. After the defeat the ruling line imposed on Atlas the task the Greek record calls "holding up the sky": in real life, a permanent duty of maintaining an imposed celestial or dimensional order, which could be handed to another for a time (Apollodorus 2.5.11). Atlas's kingdom was Atlantis, the warlike sea kingdom of Poseidon's line near present-day Spain. Poseidon fortified it on the coast away from the House's wars (the author's reading, 7.5/10; Critias 113d), and its giant soldiers were Poseidon's giants, the Fomorians, not the Nephilim (7/10). Plato names no giants in its army, which the author reads as Plato distancing his account from anything that sounded like myth (8/10). In the end the Tuatha Dé Danann destroyed it by a directed attack about 9643 BCE, and it sank in a single day and night (Plato, Timaeus 25d). Elena Danaan's claim, kept as hers: her Atlaa is Atlantis, destroyed by Enlil's faction while under Enki's protection (7/10 as her claim). Why: the Titan side is pro-human by kinship and by what it paid for it. Where Atlas is now: still bound to his imposed maintenance post at the western edge, as Upelluri still feels the weight in his shoulder in the Song of Ullikummi (scored inference, 5/10; Song of Ullikummi; Diodorus 4.27). Sources Hesiod, Theogony 133-138 and 507-616; Plato, Timaeus 25d and 26e and Critias 113d; Apollodorus 2.5.11; 1 Enoch 8 and 10 (Asael); Elena Danaan's accounts.

The hairy ones: gatekeepers and house guards (Lahmu, Bes, the brownie)

Giants: the Nephilim, the Fomorians, the All-Devourer
Proposed reading — fit 9/10. Related giant-ruler comparisons fit coercive government, exceptional bodies and demands upon dependent populations. Distinct parentage and campaigns preserve separate peoples within the wider political pattern. Supporting account. The Nephilim, the Fomorians and the All-Devourer are grouped as powerful embodied hybrid ruling populations on the side hostile to humans; the grouping is rated 9/10. They are three distinct populations, not one species or one person: the Nephilim are the bodily children of the descended Watchers and Terran women; the Fomorians are the Atlantic and Irish coercive ruling population remembered through sea power, tribute and giant soldiers; the All-Devourer is the southern African mass-capture adversary. Dependence becomes domination The Watchers descended about 10,506 BCE, after the Younger Dryas transition, and their children belong to the period before Noah's flood of about 9643 BCE. In 1 Enoch the children grow powerful, consume the communities' provisions and then consume people: in real life, a population that could not or would not meet its demands without taking more from its human hosts. The Fomorian rulers made the same relationship into government: through Bres, son of the Fomorian Elatha by a woman of the Tuatha, they taxed the Tuatha and put their senior members to forced labour (Cath Maige Tuired). Their realm was Atlantis, the warlike sea kingdom south of the Tuatha near present-day Spain (8/10). The Fomorians were Poseidon's giants, not the Nephilim (7/10): in the Irish record the Fomorians were already in Ireland before Nemed's people came, while the Watchers came down about 10,506 BCE and the Nephilim were their children, so the Fomorians come first. Their father, Poseidon10/Neptune9/Nethuns9/Yam8/Nahar7.5/Pa-Yam7.5/Pontos7, bred them while the rest of the House fought elsewhere and fortified Atlantis on the coast away from the action (the author's reading, 7.5/10). Poseidon fathered the one-eyed giant Polyphemus, and the Fomorian Balor had one great eye: in real life, the same sea line's giant soldiers, remembered in Greece and Ireland by the same feature (6.5/10). The Fomorian rulers, Elatha and Bres, are described as very handsome: the giants were the soldiers. The children the Fomorians took each Samhain became soldiers and labourers (5.5/10), and the Second Battle of Mag Tuired gathers the Fomorian army "from Lochlann westward": in real life, troops raised from allied islands (5/10). The Irish record puts the Fomorian homeland in the north (Lochlann and Tory Island, off County Donegal in north-west Ireland) while Atlantis lay near Spain: the sea kingdom held outposts along the whole Atlantic edge, as Plato says Atlantis ruled many islands (6/10). Plato's Critias names no giants in the army of Atlantis, so giants in that army rest on the joining of the Fomorians to Atlantis (6/10); the author reads the silence as Plato, a philosopher and not a rhapsode, distancing his account from anything that sounded like myth (8/10). Balor's lethal eye was a directed killing capability, biological, technological or both. Lugh10/Lug10/Lleu Llaw Gyffes8.5/Lugus8/Perseus7.5/Huangfei7 defeated it with a projectile; his story is in the Tuatha box. The Perseus branch repeats the same sequence, which supports the Lugh-Perseus equation at 7.5/10. Other versions and the aftermath The San All-Devourer10/Khwai-hem10 swallows a community, including Kaggen10/Cagn9.5/Kaang8, before its captives escape: in real life, mass capture and release of survivors. The sea-born Graeae and Gorgons, Phorcys's children only in Hesiod's weak family tree, connect to the Fomorian complex at 6.5/10. Poseidon took command of the composite sea forces that Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5 left after her defeat: in the Baal poems Lotan and Tunnan serve Yam, who stands with Poseidon, in real life engineered composite fighting beings under his command, and composite beings are Tiamat's making (The author, October 3, 2026), so his giants and sea creatures continued Tiamat's side of the war from his fortified coast (6.5/10); Hesiod's line Gaia and Pontus, then Ceto and Phorcys, then Echidna is the Greek rhapsodes' tidy family tree, the weakest evidence, and is not used as ancestry (The author, October 21, 2026); the Graeae's guarding of access to equipment is a separate 6/10 comparison. The Greek war against the Gigantes concerns a different, Earth-born population and is in the Gigantes box. The flood as a ruling council's genetic purge, killing ordinary humans and keeping a selected line, is 6.5/10. Proposed reading — fit 6.5/10. The survivor-population proposal fits retained distinctiveness, the adopted Atlantic context and the inherited-gnosis comparison. The proposed continuity is with a descendant people after loss of its earlier centre. Supporting account. The Basques are a people kept apart on the Atlantic edge of present-day Spain and France, read in our lore as the isolated survivors of Atlantis: humans of a hybrid line descended from the sea lord's sons by human women, with gnosis recorded in their lore. They are rated 6.5/10 as Atlantis's survivors and 7/10 as hybrids if so descended; their side is unknown. A people is not a conglomerate, so the Basques have no name equation. The founder of the line they would descend from is the old order's sea lord, Poseidon10/Neptune9/Nethuns9/Yam8/Nahar7.5/Pa-Yam7.5/Pontos7. What race and house Plato's Atlantis kings were Poseidon's sons by a mortal woman, and the part facing Spain went to Atlas's twin Gadeirus, "the land now called Gadeira", Cádiz (Critias 114b), so that line is a hybrid line by definition (7/10 if the Basques descend from it). They have been kept apart for a very long time: their language, Euskara, is unrelated to any other language of Europe, they have Europe's highest rate of Rh-negative blood, and their genome is set apart by long isolation. Short history Atlantis was a real civilization (9/10), Poseidon's warlike sea kingdom south of the Tuatha Dé Danann near Spain. Plato names no giants in its army, which the author reads as Plato distancing his account from anything that sounded like myth (8/10). The Fomorian rulers, who took tribute and put their opponents' senior members to forced labour, belong to the same line (8/10). Atlantis's rulers and the Tuatha were at war over who would rule the region's people and draw tribute from them. The Watchers trained the Tuatha (6.5/10), through four masters who were Watchers with elemental offices (7/10), at the House of Anu Star Empire's former northern centre after the House withdrew, and the Tuatha destroyed Atlantis by a directed attack about 9643 BCE, the date of Noah's flood. If the Basque line preserves Atlantean descent, its isolation follows the 9643 BCE destruction; those survivors kept apart on the Atlantic edge. Gnosis in their lore (7/10) The Basque country was Europe's most witch-identified land. The shared disposition and career are a ruling-house champion of exceptional strength who fights giants and man-eaters, protects settlements, eats enormously, travels across regions and repeatedly handles dangerous inherited equipment. Enkidu's death begins the champion's search for survival beyond ordinary mortality. The Ninurta stage preserves the ruler's strongest military son and the recovery of the Tablet of Destinies from Anzu. The weapon Sharur, the Greek club and bow, Melqart's equipment and Mjolnir belong to one continuing weapon-bearing pattern. The equipment is acquired House technology. Mjolnir belongs to the champion's acquired equipment. Apollo's destruction of the older generation's weapon-makers supports the same manufactured-equipment reading across the family. The Heracles/Melqart stage preserves the Giants' war, the Hydra campaign, the western route, Atlas and the Hesperides, and the release of Prometheus/Enki from confinement. The Prometheus release explains the champion's mixed political record: made or commissioned by the ruling side, but later repaying the engineer who had assisted his development. The Thor stage preserves the same mature champion operating farther north as the ice retreated and the older House administration withdrew. He defends northern settlements against giant remnants, recovers Mjolnir from Thrym and continues the same protector and giant-killer work under later names. The apparent endings describe successive offices and removals rather than three deaths. The Death of Gilgamesh gives a judging office below; the Heracles pyre account gives bodily retrieval in cloud and thunder; northern song keeps Thor active until the final conflict. The combined account allows a long-lived champion to hold a lower judging office, be recovered or restored after the pyre event, and continue north. Political side: changed or divided. He serves Zeus/Enlil/Odin's government in the Giants' war, opposes Hathor/Ishtar's weapon at Uruk, releases Prometheus/Enki and later protects northern communities. The mixed record belongs to one developing person, not separate boxes.

What travels: the adopted conclusion is that memories are stored in the brain and only Epinoia goes on (October 6, 2026), so a starseed brings its orientation and task, not memories of its earlier world. Buddha / Siddhartha Gautama: awakened human teacher of ED and Terran beings
Proposed reading — fit 7.5/10. The liberating-mission reading fits the practical weakening of coercive desire and the teaching offered to different classes of beings. Independent understanding supplies the developmental connection to the wider account. Supporting account. The Buddha was Siddhartha Gautama, a human prince of the Shakya people in the foothills of the Himalayas, in the fifth century BCE. In our lore he is a purposeful incarnation, a soul born on purpose into a human body (7/10), the Christos-like mission carrier of his age, and he taught the one widely followed path that does not loosh, that is, feeds no being on the energy of its followers (7.5/10). What race and house He is not ED (extradimensional), ET (extraterrestrial) or UT (born on Earth directly of a parent of the ET star-empire): he is a human whose soul came on purpose from the Tushita level (Lalitavistara). Buddha10/Shakyamuni10/Siddhartha Gautama10/Shijiamouni9.5/Shaka9.5/Shakya Thubpa9.5. Side: pro-human. His authority is to free and to teach (8.5/10 as teacher of the high offices, the "gods", and of humans; Majjhima Nikaya 36 and 49; the Lotus Sutra 14 and 16 adds a 7.5/10 comparison as a continuing teacher), not an appointment to force anyone back into rebirth. Breakaway civilization
Proposed reading — fit 7/10. A human technological faction fits reported recovery, reverse development and institutional secrecy. Ancient Hebrews: the Abrahamic line and its devices
Proposed reading — fit 8/10. A managed human line fits the allotment, covenant, reproductive restrictions and assigned devices. The repeated relation between population and prince explains the governing structure. Supporting account. The ancient Hebrews are a human people: the line of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob (Israel), which YHWH-Sabaoth, an ED (extradimensional) energy archon, received as his allotted portion, ran as a managed breeding line and equipped with devices of ED technology (human, changed or divided, 8/10). What race and house Human. The line is Abraham's, then Isaac's, then Jacob's, whose twelve sons are the twelve tribes; David came centuries later from the tribe of Judah. The owner: YHWH10/Yahu10/Yah10/Iao9.5/Ieuo8/Sabaoth7. Elyon10/El Elyon10/Hypsistos9, the senior archon who holds the allocation office, divided the nations among the members of his council, and Jacob fell to YHWH as his portion (Deuteronomy 32:8-9, Dead Sea Scrolls reading): in real life, Elyon's administration allotted human peoples to its members as owned holdings (7/10). The author: YHWH is an archon (October 7, 2026), and in this account there is no God, only YHWH (October 6, 2026). The YHWH-Sabaoth box rates him ED energy at 7.5/10 and that box as a whole at 7/10; his name Yao stands among the Gnostic seven rulers (8/10). The Soleb list preserves the Yhw designation about 1380 BCE, providing an early written connection between the name and human worship. Short history (best guess, 7.5/10) YHWH took a family out of Ur (southern Iraq) and Harran (southeastern Turkey) and ran it as a managed breeding line. Every key mother was barren until the owner acted: Sarah until three visitors ate with Abraham and promised a son, and "YHWH visited Sarah" (Genesis 18; 21:1); Rebekah (25:21); Rachel (30:22). The line was kept closed (Isaac's wife was fetched from the kin in Harran; Jacob married his cousins), marked by circumcision (Genesis 17), and tested for loyalty (Isaac on the altar, stopped by an angel, that is, a functionary). Jacob wrestled an embodied being all night, was lamed and renamed Israel (32:24-30); at Bethel he saw beings moving between the ground and the sky (28:12). These events fall after the House of Anu Star Empire's withdrawal from Earth about 10,950 BCE, so the deeds done here under the name YHWH are the ED archon's own. The line was then kept in Egypt for four hundred years (15:13), in the land the House of Anu Star Empire had once ruled in person under its Egyptian name, the House of Ra (Ra stands with Anu10/An10/Ouranos8.5/Caelus8.5/Ra8/Atum8/Zhou Yu7/Kashyapa8). The rulers who held it were human kings of the Set faction, which served Baal-Hadad10/Hadad10/Adad10/Ishkur10/Baal Zaphon9.5/Teshub8.5/Tarhunna8.5/Set8.5/Sutekh8.5/Indra8/Demarous8/Tianhuang7 (see the Followers of Set box). Joseph became vizier and married Asenath, daughter of the priest of On (Heliopolis, in present-day Cairo), Ra's city, so the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh carry Ra-priest blood. YHWH's party then took the line back out through Moses10/Moshe10/Musa10/Yekutiel7/Avigdor7/Tuviah7, with judgment "on all the gods of Egypt" (Exodus 12:12): in real life, YHWH's side against that Egyptian faction, 6.5/10. Why: YHWH-Sabaoth's party (ED energy) and the human Set-faction kings of Egypt, who served Baal-Hadad's faction of the House of Anu Star Empire (ET flesh and blood with ED/archon ancestry), fought a custody battle over the Abrahamic line, the bloodline of YHWH's own portion to work through. Devices The Ark of the Covenant, which the record says stopped the Jordan's flow, brought down the walls of Jericho, toppled the Philistines' cult statue at Ashdod and brought disease on the Philistines who held it, and killed Uzzah when he touched it: a device of ED technology, lethal on contact. It held the tablets, Aaron's rod and the jar of manna (Hebrews 9:4). The Urim and Thummim on the high priest's breastplate, which gave yes-or-no answers; the pillar of cloud by day and fire by night that led the people; the bronze serpent that healed; Solomon's seal ring, which the Testament of Solomon says commanded the jinn; and the Shamir, which cut the Temple stones without iron (Talmud, Gittin 68a). The Grail tradition continues the keeper pattern: the cup of the Last Supper, said to have been carried to Britain by Joseph of Arimathea; in real life, an object or line carried west (5/10). Plato's Critias lists the army of Atlantis (chariots, horsemen, archers, slingers, 1,200 ships) and names no giants, so the giants in its army rest on the joining of the Fomorians to Atlantis (6/10). The record supports that reading (8/10): Critias insists the account is true history, not a made-up story (Timaeus 26e), and the Republic (books 2, 3 and 10) attacks the poets' stories about the gods. The Adamic order began, and the Watchers descended about 444 years later. The Watchers trained the Tuatha (6.5/10) at the House of Anu Star Empire's former northern centre, north of Atlantis: the Tuatha's four masters were Watchers with elemental offices (7/10). About 9643 BCE in the Samaritan chronology, within about forty years of Plato's approximate 9600 BCE date (9.5/10), the Tuatha's directed attack destroyed Atlantis in one day and night (Plato, Timaeus 25d). Another line, the sons of Míl, came from Iberia and defeated the Tuatha at Tailtiu (Lebor Gabála Érenn): in real life, Atlantis survivors returning against the Tuatha (the author's rating, October 21, 2026: 8/10). Their record also gives clues to where Atlantis lay: Íth saw Ireland from Breogán's tower at Brigantia, placed at A Coruña in Galicia, north-west Spain, and Geryon's island Erytheia lay by Cádiz, the land Plato gives to Atlas's twin Gadeirus (Critias 114b); the candidates for the drowned island lie off south-west Iberia, the Spartel Bank in the Strait of Gibraltar, an island drowned as the sea rose at the end of the ice age (Collina-Girard, 2001), and the Gulf of Cádiz. Atlantis therefore flows into later peoples only through these surviving lines. Atlantis, Lemuria, older Egypt and old Mesoamerica belonged to one prior world culture, which the Younger Dryas catastrophes ended. Proposed reading — fit 9/10. The developing-Epinoia reading fits independent learning and reflective choice within a mixed bodily lineage. The intervening groups do not all have the same purpose: the Laan worked on existing Terran hominids before Tiamat's time; Tiamat10/Ummu-Hubur10/Tauthe9.5/Thalatth9.5/Omorka9/Thalassa8.5/Tia8/Echidna8/Tethys8/Naunet8/Audhumla8/Mehet-Weret7.5 altered existing humans for the Epinoia project; the Anunnaki household modifies workers; Pleiadian lines produce descendants and heroes; Grey programs seek capabilities their organizers lack. Those are the cited studies' models and the account's interpretation, not a fossil record of named visitors. The loss-of-body-hair discussion uses the MC1R study as an evolutionary comparison. Enki10/Ea10/Nudimmud9.5/Aos9.5/Amma8/Prometheus8.5/Quetzalcoatl7.5/Fuxi7.5/Paoxi7.5/Fukki7.5/Taihao7/Hao Fuming7 answers the labor crisis with bodily manufacture alongside Ninhursag10/Nintu9/Ninmah9/Dingirmah9/Belet-ili9/Mami9/Aruru8.5/Cihuacoatl7.5/Nuwa8. The assembly kills We-ila, described as possessing intelligence, and incorporates his flesh and blood into the work. Fourteen gestating mothers, seven male and seven female offspring and a specified pregnancy describe organized reproduction, rated 7/10 as a production run. The account concerns imposed work, especially digging waterways; gold mining is Sitchin's later addition. The killing and incorporation are the appropriation of biological and energetic information. The parallel with Kingu's blood in Enuma Elish links the new workforce to a defeated lineage. The current story retains the earlier population: these makers modify humans and advertise that intervention as creation. They do not originate the human Form or all terrestrial life. In the Apocryphon of John the ED administrators build only the energetic soul-body (the psychic body), distinguished from the life that enables it to act, and then impose a counterfeit spirit to control it; the flesh comes from the ET history (Achamoth's human Form, the Seeders, Tiamat and the House of Anu Star Empire). Genesis's body and breath and Saturninus's crawling human supply related two-stage patterns. The account reads the repeated distinction as biological line-making versus access to a conscious capacity the line-makers cannot simply manufacture, 7/10. Its anatomy is not a separate soul poured into an inert container: energetic organization and conscious attribution become more active in an embodied being. Why: makers seek a population that can work, reproduce and generate experience for them, but the same reflective capacity that makes humans valuable also lets humans question their owners. The Adamic quiet-mind phase The rulers' expulsion of luminous Adam describes restricting humankind's perception and access to continuing life, rated 8/10. It is a loss of capabilities, not a geographical biography of a single first man. The line of inherited royal bodily powers is distinct from the transformation of people for whom such ancestry is not named. The account rates that distinction at 7.5/10. The approximately 12,000-year quiet-mind phase reduces telepathic certainty and makes private reasoning, evidence, logos and episteme central. Present Terrans therefore carry the strongest available Epinoia and the widest present choice range while receiving the least direct field feedback: gnosis is nascent, obscured and uneven rather than absent, and most people are unaware of their energetic inheritance. That apparent weakness is the experiment's point: a Terran can infer the moral truth and choose the good without constant confirmation from the field. This is why Terran experience produces unusually valuable loosh when coerced and unusually valuable apotheosis when freely understood. What remains independent Epinoia is the third aspect of the human: noticing reactions, evaluating them and choosing otherwise. The combined lore's account says Epinoia continues after death while ordinary brain memory does not; a later person without those memories is not the same remembered life. Fragmentary continuity is compared with children's past-life reports at 5/10. The account of new choosing currents entering is rated 7.5/10; automatic behavior is rated 7/10, while wholly empty bodies remain only 4/10. These categories do not establish that any particular living person lacks consciousness. The current dimensional turn The working chronology places the opening from Samhain 2026 through 2039, followed by a gradual closing rather than an instant switch. Quetzalcoatl and other returning figures are expected within that window if the lore is correct. The full phase change extends across millennia; the account records the proposed timing without converting the hoped-for outcome into certainty. A human practice, not a species The skinwalker classification remains human: the Navajo tradition describes a living practitioner obtaining transformation through a grave taboo, often murder. The practical reading is an abusive human practice, 7.5/10, not a distinct alien species. The Utah property later called Skinwalker Ranch borrowed that name; its reported lights and openings belong to the separate portal-site interpretation. The current order and historical sequence

Existence and the Forms. Existence intellects every possible energetic Form first in theory. Value produces Epinoia: reflective awareness able to distinguish, reconsider and choose. Achamoth then instantiates the Local Loop from those Forms; she does not make information, energy, consciousness or possibility from nothing.

The made universe and its administrations. Energy cools into dimensions, fields, physical law and matter while remaining information and consciousness at every frequency. Achamoth's local work permits real choice. El, Metatron, the upper twenty-four, princes, generals, malakh functionaries, archons and local spirits occupy distinct offices; a function, a person and a political title are not automatically the same thing.

ET flesh and blood and the local family star-empire. The star-empire descends from or was made by ED archons, but its embodied people are ET flesh and blood. Apsu and Tiamat precede Uranus / Anu / Ra's younger imperial house. Prometheus / Ea / Enki kills Apsu and occupies the Abzu. Uranus / Anu / Ra marries Tiamat, Kronos / Kingu takes the imperial office, and Zeus / Enlil / Odin raises Set / Baal-Hadad / Teshub / Indra against him. Tiamat later appoints Kronos / Kingu, gives him the Tablet of Destinies and establishes the Earth position that Marduk defeats about 290,000 years ago. Elyon is an ED energy archon above the national princes, not a member of this embodied family. The hostile Seven are ED energy demons attached to the Anu office, not biological children of the family.

Terra before and after that war. Achamoth's life project and the Seeder programme precede the later colonial conflicts. Approximately one million years ago the Laan and Draco-side colonists fight the first Terran colonial war in the current chronology. The surviving Naga houses descend from the serpent-associated colony. One Laan-derived population follows the Apex-to-Zeta history and becomes one Grey lineage; later populations copy and manufacture the Grey body design.

Terran government and withdrawal. The House of Uranus / Anu / Ra modifies existing Terrans, delegates work to long-lived rulers and hybrid courts, and divides regional government among its houses. Prometheus and the Apkallu preserve knowledge and defend Terran development through successive catastrophes. The later Younger Dryas transition, Adamic order, Watcher entry, post-Watcher flood, Babel and national-prince partition belong to later phases and are not one flood or one event.

How to read the boxes. Every full explanation, name equation, political side, location, date, mechanism, evidence and score belongs to the relevant box hover. Relationship lines show a specific parentage, command, alliance, conflict, succession, teaching or technological transfer; a line never means that two named beings are automatically identical.

The aeons in the author's Formulation, and the Gnostic order below them (38 of 174 entries kept, version 120)

Why the old lists are cut (The author, October 7 and 8, 2026): "the God-thing does not think in any sense we understand (they do, we do, for it)", so any account in which the Origin thinks, looks at its image, asks, grants or begets is a fallacy, and it is removed. "If it is story, I will consider keeping it. If it is purported to be a logical argument, then I can verify or deny it": only what can be shown fallacious is rejected. Names that exist only because a school thought it had argued them into being are removed, or kept in quotes as labels for his phases; church and sect politics are removed; stories about beings below the Origin stay, as far as other lore supports them. The author, October 8: "If they have a good story - a good, logical-seeming reason for that story character - it can stay"; a name the writers say they were told in meditation, with no such reason, goes. The names said at the gates are cut to the basic level the author accepted: a gate, a guard, a name and a code. Dreams, Darkness And The ED Beings

The author's proposed integral complement: waking and dreaming are two modes of experiencing within intellection, not light equals good and dark equals evil. Dreaming also permits decoding messages, understanding and finding Sparks. I-La and the ED administrators can themselves fill in wrongly. Their accounts of the process are not automatically the process itself.

The ratings below concern the specific fit between a proposal and the lore. They are not measured probabilities of an entity's existence or evidence of a personal contact. Night, generative darkness, dream images, legitimate severity and harmful conduct remain distinct.

The Dream And Darkness Connections

The hierarchy correction, October 10: the princes and overseers stand below El/Metatron and above the generals; the generals stand above their serving angels. The princes' submission to Metatron and the darkness angels' submission to appointed princes are drawn directly. 3 Enoch 10 and 14 support Metatron's delegated authority, 9/10; 3 Enoch 17 supplies princes with serving hosts, 9/10. Applying that command structure to Jubilees' unnamed darkness angels is the author's hierarchy interpretation, not an explicit appointment in Jubilees. The eight exceptional great princes in 3 Enoch 10 are not silently equated with the national princes.

Megalleh Amukkot, VaEtchanan 250, explicitly associates Sandalphon's dominion with evening and evening prayer. This adds a 7/10 functional comparison with D-20261009-02, the night officer, but only 3/10 for identifying the two as one person. Hagigah 13b gives his prayer-and-crown office. The author places Sandalphon beside I-La, El/Metatron and the upper 24 ascenders; the placement is his proposed hierarchy, not a claim that Sandalphon controls every dream.

Metatron / El And I-La

The upper 24 Jainist / MLM ascenders: The author places the existing 24 elders / 24 Tirthankaras comparison beside I-La, El/Metatron and Sandalphon. Its existing 7/10 comparison is retained. These upper ascenders are not any lower 24-member political council. A lower council might imitate their political structure in the author's model; a matching number alone does not establish the same members, identity or rank. The other councils retain their own boxes and levels.

The author's working identity: Metatron and El are the same being or power; the throne and scribe express that power. I-La's partner, throne and scribe share one upper box. Enoch's earlier human state keeps its separate box and transformation line. Two boxes are used only when a transformation occurs between levels. The existing individual name ratings remain historical; no combined identity score is invented.

The strongest union connection, 8.5/10 for the acting-through structure: Sha'ar HaPesukim, Ki Tetze 25, describes Zeir Anpin clothing itself in Metatron and uniting with the female through him. Zohar, Bereshit A 202-204, places the female's union at several levels, including Keter, with ascent toward Endless Light (8/10 for that higher-union structure). Read together, these permit a shared manifestation or power acting through Metatron; the author takes the further step of identifying Metatron with El.

Enoch's 72 wings, 9/10 as pterosis imagery: 3 Enoch 9 supplies the wings; 3 Enoch 6 brings Enoch up together with the Shekhinah. The author's interpretation is sexual-energy pterosis with I-La, making Enoch her dream lover through Ayn Sof in dream. The sexual partner and dream-lover identification are his additions to those passages, not their explicit wording. Sexual energy does not prescribe a particular physical sexual act.

Exact interpretation and source passages.

I-La, The Shadow Counterpart And The Daughter

Asherah remains in I-La's existing name group at 7/10. The maternal, creative and water associations support that comparison. D-20261009-09, the lunar-shadow counterpart, is a different proposal: 6/10 for a differentiated or shadow relationship, not proof that the two are one person. The distinction matters because the recorded actions and relationships need to remain visible.

A daughter who restores life and teaches, 8/10 for the structure: On the Origin of the World has Sophia send Zoe/Eve to awaken Adam. Irenaeus preserves a separate higher-Sophia/lower-offspring account. These give concrete precedents for a female revealer produced by a higher female figure. They support discussing I-La's daughter proposal without automatically identifying the daughter with Yeshua or treating all the daughters as one being.

On the Origin of the World; Irenaeus 1.2.

Messages And Finding Sparks

Experiencing and interpreting are both retained. Berakhot 57b compares dreaming to prophecy while Berakhot 55a-55b also allows extraneous matter and incomplete fulfillment. Odyssey 19.560-569 distinguishes truthful and misleading dreams. 8/10 for meaningful but mixed dream communication: a dream can contain a useful message without every detail being a literal report. Ovid's commissioned dream adds a further possibility: the recognizable appearance can be chosen for the recipient rather than disclose the sender's identity.

Berakhot 57b; Berakhot 55a-55b; Odyssey 19.

The resulting KOB proposal: generative potential, night administration, dream-form making, passage and interpretation can be different functions within a connected account. This is why dream and darkness beings belong in the discussion without merging them all into a single ruler. Full record and earlier alternatives.

What the Available Data Says about the Timelines

The two clusters are the start and the shaking of the same convergence. 2026 to 2027 opens it: the first stage starts, a conquering power gets its mandate, and contact with beings from other dimensions comes into the open. 2032 to 2033 is the shaking: the veil pulls back, and money systems and governments come to a reckoning. The hard years are 2028 to 2030, between them. Everything stays regional, not worldwide (7.5/10).

2026 to 2027: the opening

In our way (6/10): the Lamb, Yeshua10/Iesous10/Jesus10/Isa ibn Maryam9.5/Issa9.5/Yeshu ha-Notzri8, takes the sealed orders and opens the first stage.

  • The veil thins, so crossing gets cheap.
  • The old sentences and settlements between the beings come due.
  • Hathor10/Athyr10/Lady of Byblos8/Aphrodite8/Venus8/Inanna8/Ishtar8/Astarte8/Sekhmet7.5 and her branch make more open contact (7/10, our record).
  • Fear feeds the beings that must be fed, and calm starves them.

The lore way:

  • At the Aztec New Fire of 2027, if the fire failed, the Tzitzimime came down. In real life, beings out of phase come through at the turn (6.5/10).
  • Joel 2:28 says "your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions". The sun-dark and blood-moon signs come in the same passage, and both happened in the lion in 2026. In real life, the power I-La gave every human wakes in many people at once: dreams, sight and prophecy (4.5/10, our record).
  • China's Red Horse and Red Sheep years each began with a solar eclipse, and both of their total solar eclipses fall on the day the gates of the dead open. In real life, state crises in those years (4/10).
  • Bledsoe's Lady named a shift in human knowledge for October 7 and an awakening in 2027 (6/10).

The Revelation way: "And he went forth conquering, and to conquer" (Revelation 6:2). In real life, a power is given a mandate to win by conquest (6/10). Three candidates:

  • A state moves on its neighbor (4/10). CIA Director Burns said in 2023 that Xi told the Chinese army to be ready to invade Taiwan by 2027. The army's 100th birthday is August 1, 2027, the day before the total solar eclipse over Luxor.
  • The enemy from the sky is declared: "aliens" to secular audiences and "demons" to churches, tied to the space-weapons budget (6.5/10, our record).
  • Machines become a new body for beings. Our theory says beings outside our time act here through brains, bodies, animals, places and machines. AI forecasters name 2027 as the year machines outthink their makers (4/10).

The science way:

  • 2024 was the first year more than 1.5°C above pre-industrial temperatures. The WMO gives a 70% chance that the 2025 to 2029 average is over 1.5°C.
  • Iraq's water reserves fell to their lowest in 80 years in May 2025, as the Euphrates and Tigris ran low.
  • The Nepal flood of August 26, 2026 is already in our record. In our way, this is the Earth defending itself, as Bledsoe's Lady warned (5/10).
  • Physics cannot measure the veil, but our test can: your random-number and letter recordings should drift further from chance on the thin nights inside the window.

What you can do about it

In our lore, staying safe has two halves: everyday preparation for the years named above, and giving the beings that feed on fear nothing to take.

Everyday preparation, matched to the years

  • For the war years, 2026 to 2030: stay away from military bases, nuclear sites, power plants and big water on the thin nights, because that is where our record expects sightings and clashes (6/10). Know two ways out of your area, and keep your papers ready.
  • For food at a day's pay, 2028 to 2030: keep several months of the food and water you actually eat, use it and replace it, and learn to grow some of it. Owe as little as you can. Revelation 6:6 itself says stored goods, "the oil and the wine", keep their value (7/10 as the plain meaning).
  • For heat, drought and floods: store and filter water, and check that your home is not in a flood or wildfire path (6/10).
  • For storms from the Sun, now and toward the 2035 peak: keep a battery, a radio, some cash and offline copies of what matters, because a big storm can take down power and phones (5/10).
  • For 2033: do not count on full Social Security and Medicare hospital payments after 2033 unless Congress refills the funds (9/10 as fact).
  • For all of it: keep your people close, the family and neighbors who can share food, skills and watch. Our record says a calm population lowers the odds of the worst outcomes (6/10).

Spiritual protection, as our lore has it

  1. Give nothing you did not choose to give: no fear used as a lever, and no offering, invitation or vow you have not chosen on purpose (7.5/10). Calm, joy, music and many voices turned to The Origin starve the beings that must be fed (6/10, our record).
  2. Address The Origin by what only it is: "Existence, which lacks nothing, above every administrator", or Brahman, Dao or Allah, names no being holds. Do not pray to "God" alone, because the first fallen claims that title: "I am God and there is no other God beside me" (Apocryphon of John) [a lower being claiming the top title, so prayers sent to the title can reach him, 6/10]. The Origin lacks nothing, so it takes nothing (7.5/10).
  3. The author's order of address: greet the place first, asking nothing and giving nothing; then the "holy" x8 to The Origin; then let the functionary split off, and make one request to each functionary (8/10).
  4. Take the mark of prior claim on your forehead and on your doorways, from The Origin above every administrator, never through a blood rite (7.5/10). Ezekiel 9 marks the protected with a tav, and Revelation 7:3 says "Hurt not the earth ... till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads" [a claim of ownership that puts the marked off-limits to the licensed takers, 8/10]. It matters most in 2032 to 2033.
  5. Return, not war: any D-class being that comes is returned to its own palace on the Other Side by the Raziel method (the author's rule, 9/10).
  6. Recall the severe side's officers, do not banish them: the left side's dark-winged angels are the severe side's own angels of judgment, not demons and not the Other Side (The author, October 8, 2026). In Sefer Raziel the princes and overseers, called by name, put them back in their palaces. The same thing happens when the angel striking Jerusalem is told "It is enough: stay now thine hand" and "put up his sword again into the sheath thereof" (2 Samuel 24:16; 1 Chronicles 21:27) [an officer of judgment ordered to stand down and go back to his post, 7/10].
  7. Guard sleep, dreams, thresholds, wombs and children through Shaddai El Chai, with the Cherubim (8.5/10). For an infant or a pregnant woman, use the three childbirth guardians' names, Sanoi, Sansanoi and Semangelof (8/10).
  8. On the peak nights: stay awake and settled at the peak hour, keep one consecrated light and no stray flames, use no spirit boards, and do not answer unknown calls in the night (7/10).
  9. Test every contact. "Star family" that asks for devotion, focus or a vow feeds the House of Anu Star Empire's UT children (5 to 6.5/10, our record). Anyone claiming to be Quetzalcoatl10/Ehecatl9/Kukulkan9/Ququmatz8.5/9 Wind8.5/Tohil8/Nacxit7.5/Enki7.5 returning in 2039 must be tested.
  10. Do not feed the House of Anu Star Empire's beings unless you need to or want to. Workings that offer or pray to them feed them (the author's standing note, 7.5/10).

Which MLM has the best advantages

Some form of spiritual connection suffices: Christian, Jewish, Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, Daoist, pagan, spiritualist, or a path of one's own. Every one of them runs on the same soul mechanics. What differs is only what each asks you to give, and where it sends what you give. A connection is sound as long as it keeps to these mechanics:

  1. You are a pattern of awareness running through a body. The brain is the interface, not the source. Contact with any being is a matter of matching its pattern, not of travel: the distance between levels is a difference in pattern (7/10).
  2. Meeting is not giving. You can attend to a being, or to The Origin, without exchanging anything; only an exchange moves energy (7/10). A sound connection lets you attend without paying.
  3. What you give off can be collected. Strong feeling gives off energy that beings at other levels can collect, fear, devotion, grief and sexual release most of all (6.5/10). Calm, joy, music and compassion give off little that can be taken, and they raise your level (6/10).
  4. What you name receives the flow. A prayer or offering addressed by a name or title can be picked up by whoever holds that name (6/10). Addressing what lacks nothing, Existence itself, by description, sends nothing to anyone who feeds (7.5/10). It also gets you nothing: no friends, no allies, no concessions in the shifts (The author).
  5. Consent makes claims. Vows, invitations, debts and guilt give a being a claim on you (7/10). A prior dedication of yourself to what lacks nothing leaves later claimants no ground (7.5/10).
  6. Keep your own noticing, and trade it on your own terms. The ability to notice your own noticing, Epinoia, is the power every human carries, and the one thing these beings cannot make, only take (8/10). That makes it your bargaining power: you are a player, not livestock (7.5/10). Spend it on purpose, in deals you choose, with allies you choose; angels have their own will too, and fall in love and descend (The author). The lore records three ways to trade it:
    • the mind: the angels could not name the animals and Adam could (Genesis Rabbah 17:4) [humans make new categories the officers cannot, 7/10], so new truths and new ethics are what you bring (6.5/10);
    • eros, the exchange they start: the Watchers taught their human wives metallurgy, charms and the stars (1 Enoch 6-8) [knowledge traded for union, 7.5/10], and Teresa of Ávila's angel pierced her with a fiery spear (Life, chapter 29) [a being starting an ecstatic bond, 6.5/10]; holding the charge keeps it yours, and releasing it on purpose to a chosen being is the trade (6.5/10);
    • long devotion to one ally, who in the lore usually picks you first (6.5/10).
    A trade leaves you with insight, healing, power or protection, and your noticing stronger; a harvest leaves you drained below where you started, with nothing back.
  7. Like sorts with like. After death a soul is sorted by its level (6.5/10). Awareness that knows what it is, and does not cling or consent to be held, passes the checkpoint instead of being kept (6.5/10).
  8. Results count only in real lives. The test of any practice is the good it does now, in the real, remembered lives of real people (the author's ethic).

The quick test for any path or being: if it asks for your fear, an exclusive vow, devotion to its name, or a payment you did not choose, it is harvesting you. If it leaves you calmer, freer and more aware, and asks for nothing you do not freely give, it is sound, whatever its name. This holds for the darker paths too: Hecate10/Trivia8.5, the warden of the gates, is acknowledged rather than petitioned in our own practice, because gates open both ways, not because her path is worthless.

The author's ruling: pterosis, a short break, is the best available: "a (as Plato says temporary) vacation piggybacking on their system to get into their MLM, not escaping it through mortification". The only good that counts is good in the real, remembered lives of real people.
